description.zh_CN: 阿米娅无条件信任失忆的博士
description.en_US: Amiya trusts amnesiac Doctor unconditionally

quote.zh_CN: 如果争端能够避免，那我们应当沉默——如果战斗是必要的，那就战斗到最后！罗德岛的信条从来没有改变过！
quote.en_US: If conflict can be avoided, we should remain silent — if battle is necessary, fight to the end!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅对博士表达信任
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya expresses trust in Doctor

description.zh_CN: 临光与阿米娅并肩作战
description.en_US: Nearl fights alongside Amiya

quote.zh_CN: 耀骑士临光，前来迎接你们了。
quote.en_US: The Radiant Knight Nearl has come to meet you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光加入战斗
context_analysis.en_US: Nearl joins battle

description.zh_CN: 杜宾服从阿米娅指挥
description.en_US: Dobermann obeys Amiya's command

quote.zh_CN: 无论敌人是谁，我们都会完成任务。
quote.en_US: Whatever enemy we're facing, we will complete the mission.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾服从指挥
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann obeys command

description.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特指挥浮士德
description.en_US: Mephisto commands Faust

quote.zh_CN: 我想和各位，来一场祭祀式的竞赛。你们只要活下来，就是胜利！
quote.en_US: I want to hold a sacrificial competition. You just need to survive — that's victory!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特以游戏心态指挥
context_analysis.en_US: Mephisto treats battle as game

description.zh_CN: 弑君者对梅菲斯特不满
description.en_US: Assassin is dissatisfied with Mephisto

quote.zh_CN: 弑君者对梅菲斯特态度冷淡
quote.en_US: Assassin is cold toward Mephisto

context_analysis.zh_CN: 整合运动内部矛盾
context_analysis.en_US: Internal conflict in Reunion

description.zh_CN: 杜宾称塔露拉为暴君
description.en_US: Dobermann calls Talulah a tyrant

quote.zh_CN: 这样的人，是暴君。
quote.en_US: Such a person is a tyrant.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾敌视塔露拉
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann hostile to Talulah

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希与阿米娅跨种族信任
description.en_US: Kal'tsit and Amiya share cross-species trust

quote.zh_CN: 我不是你的同类，但我一直是你的同伴。
quote.en_US: I am not of your kind, but I have always been your companion.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希表达同伴情谊
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit expresses companionship

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：——我太了解你了，所以我不会信任你。这就像过去的你也不会信任我一样。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希表达与阿米娅之间复杂的历史关系和信任问题

description.zh_CN: 临光与Ace是配合默契的战友。临光称呼Ace为"你"并主动感谢他的援助，而Ace则谦逊地推辞说自己"没资格让耀骑士还我人情"。两人在战场上互相掩护，临光更是在被浮士德狙击时感受到Ace的火力支援。
description.en_US: Nearl and Ace are trusted combat partners. Nearl addresses Ace directly, thanking him for his support while Ace humbly deflects credit, saying he isn't worthy of the Radiant Knight owing him favors.

quote.zh_CN: 谢谢你刚才的援助，临光不会忘记这份恩情。请别这么说。我可没资格让耀骑士还我人情。
quote.en_US: Thank you for your assistance just now, Nearl won't forget this kindness. Please don't say that. I'm not worthy of the Radiant Knight owing me favors.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光真诚感谢Ace的援助并表达铭记恩情，Ace谦逊地回应，体现了两人作为战友的默契与相互尊重
context_analysis.en_US: Nearl sincerely thanks Ace and expresses gratitude; Ace humbly responds, showing战友 trust and mutual respect

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德！把她那张嘴给我打穿。——不会让你得逞！
quote.en_US: Faust! Shoot that mouth shut. ——You won't get away with it!

context_analysis.zh_CN: Ace在浮士德狙击临光时挺身而出保护她，展现了战友间互相掩护的战斗默契
context_analysis.en_US: Ace shields Nearl when Faust狙击 her, demonstrating their battlefield trust and cooperation

description.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特对临光怀有强烈的毁灭欲。临光出现时梅菲斯特震惊其战斗力，随即命令浮士德"把她那张嘴给我打穿"并"再来！！把她......打成碎渣"，展现出病态的攻击性。临光则冷静地分析并蔑视梅菲斯特的指挥风格。
description.en_US: Mephisto harbors intense destructive urges toward Nearl. When Nearl appears, Mephisto is shocked by her combat prowess and immediately orders Faust to shoot her down, screaming "do it again! Turn her to pieces!" — revealing pathological aggression. Nearl calmly analyzes and despises Mephisto's command style.

quote.zh_CN: 我想和各位，来一场祭祀式的竞赛。
quote.en_US: I'd like to have a ritual competition with all of you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特将战斗比作"祭祀式的竞赛"，展现了对生命的漠视和病态的价值观
context_analysis.en_US: Mephisto compares battle to a "ritual competition", revealing his pathological disregard for life

quote.zh_CN: 把她那张嘴给我打穿。——再来！！把她......打成碎渣！
quote.en_US: Shoot that mouth shut. ——Do it again! Turn her... into pieces!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特命令浮士德狙击临光，并狂躁地要求将她"打成碎渣"，揭示了对临光的强烈仇恨
context_analysis.en_US: Mephisto orders Faust to shoot Nearl and furiously demands to "turn her to pieces", revealing intense hatred

quote.zh_CN: 屠杀，纵火，围猎......只不过是为了满足你自己残忍的趣味而已吧？会在这时煽动如此不堪之事的人，没可能策划出足以击溃整座城市的方案。
quote.en_US: Massacre, arson, hunting... merely to satisfy your own cruel whims, right? Someone who incites such atrocities at this moment couldn't have planned to collapse an entire city.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光当面斥责梅菲斯特的暴行，分析其行为只是满足残忍趣味而非真正的战略家
context_analysis.en_US: Nearl directly condemns Mephisto's atrocities, analyzing his actions as mere cruel whims rather than true strategy

description.zh_CN: 杜宾与Ace是罗德岛的两位资深战士，在战场上配合默契。杜宾称呼Ace为"Ace！"并在危急时刻依赖他的判断，两人互相认可对方的能力。
description.en_US: Dobermann and Ace are Rhodes Island's two veteran warriors who cooperate seamlessly in battle. Dobermann calls out "Ace!" and relies on his judgment in critical moments, each recognizing the other's competence.

quote.zh_CN: Ace！这里还没到汇合点......怎么只有你一个人？
quote.en_US: Ace! We haven't reached the rendezvous point yet... why are you alone?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾见到Ace时急切呼唤并询问情况，展现了战友间的关切
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann urgently calls out to Ace and asks about the situation, showing战友 concern

quote.zh_CN: Ace......稍等一下。
quote.en_US: Ace... wait a moment.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾主动让Ace稍等，说明她需要与Ace商量战术
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann tells Ace to wait, indicating she needs to consult with him tactically

relation_label.zh_CN: 从质疑到信任的战场搭档
relation_label.en_US: From Skepticism to Trusted Battlefield Partner

description.zh_CN: 杜宾对博士的信任经历了从质疑到认可再到托付的过程。在第0章中，杜宾在战斗中向Ace解释"博士的指挥能力有没有因为失忆受到影响"，并最终表示"做得不错，Dr.{@nickname}，是该客观评价你的能力了"，完成了信任的建立。
description.en_US: Dobermann's trust in the Doctor evolved from skepticism to recognition to entrustment. In Ch00, she asks Ace "has the Doctor's command ability been affected by the amnesia?" and ultimately says "Well done, Dr.{@nickname}, it's time to objectively evaluate your abilities", completing the trust-building process.

quote.zh_CN: 做得不错，Dr.{@nickname}。是该客观评价你的能力了。
quote.en_US: Well done, Dr.{@nickname}. It's time to objectively evaluate your abilities.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾第一次在战斗后称赞博士能力，并表示要客观评价，说明她开始从质疑转向认可
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann praises the Doctor's abilities for the first time after battle, indicating a shift from skepticism to recognition

quote.zh_CN: 博士的指挥能力，有没有因为失忆受到影响？
quote.en_US: Has the Doctor's command ability been affected by the amnesia?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾向Ace确认博士的能力，说明她仍在评估阶段，但已经主动为博士说话
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann confirms the Doctor's abilities with Ace, showing she is still evaluating but already speaking up for him

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与杜宾是上下级关系，但杜宾对阿米娅展现出超越命令的关心。当阿米娅决定信任博士时，杜宾提醒她"做好准备"。阿米娅也经常在危机时呼唤杜宾配合，两人建立了超越职位的战友信任。
description.en_US: Amiya and Dobermann have a commander-subordinate relationship, but Dobermann shows concern for Amiya beyond mere duty. When Amiya decides to trust the Doctor, Dobermann warns her to "be prepared". Amiya frequently calls on Dobermann in crisis, showing their bond transcends rank.

quote.zh_CN: Ace......事情和以前相比，有不小的区别。博士......意外失去了记忆。
quote.en_US: Ace... things are quite different from before. The Doctor... unexpectedly lost his memory.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅向Ace解释博士失忆的情况，展现了她作为指挥官的决策角色和对团队的信任
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya explains the Doctor's amnesia to Ace, showing her role as commander and trust in the team

quote.zh_CN: （阿米娅，准备好，我们可能要强行突围了。）
quote.en_US: (Amiya, be prepared, we may need to break through by force.)

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杜宾在战斗中对阿米娅耳语提醒要做好准备，展现了她对阿米娅的关照
context_analysis.en_US: Dobermann whispers to Amiya to be prepared for possible forced breakthrough, showing her care for Amiya

description.zh_CN: ACE对失忆博士保持信任，断后牺牲时将阿米娅托付给博士
description.en_US: ACE maintains trust in amnesiac Doctor; sacrifices himself, entrusting Amiya to Doctor

quote.zh_CN: 总有一天，你要和阿米娅一起共同面对这片残酷的大地。所以，保护好她，博士。
quote.en_US: Someday, you and Amiya will face this cruel land together. So protect her, Doctor.

context_analysis.zh_CN: ACE临别托付
context_analysis.en_US: ACE's farewell entrustment

description.zh_CN: ACE是阿米娅的保护者，最终断后牺牲
description.en_US: ACE is Amiya's protector, sacrificed holding the rear

quote.zh_CN: 你可以了，阿米娅。你已经很了不起了。把你的重担，也分给我们一些吧。
quote.en_US: You're good enough, Amiya. You're already remarkable.

context_analysis.zh_CN: ACE牺牲前的鼓励
context_analysis.en_US: ACE's encouragement before sacrifice

description.zh_CN: 临光誓言保护博士
description.en_US: Nearl vows to protect Doctor

quote.zh_CN: 至少拉上我一起，让我保护博士你！
quote.en_US: At least take me with you, let me protect you, Doctor!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光主动请求保护博士
context_analysis.en_US: Nearl proactively requests to protect Doctor

description.zh_CN: 塔露拉宣告毁灭罗德岛
description.en_US: Talulah declares destruction of Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: 我将赐予你们一个我十分喜爱的结局。——毁灭。
quote.en_US: I will grant you an ending I find most pleasing. — Destruction.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 塔露拉宣告毁灭
context_analysis.en_US: Talulah declares destruction

description.zh_CN: W对塔露拉不满
description.en_US: W is dissatisfied with Talulah

quote.zh_CN: 你和那个塔露拉龙女可合不来。
quote.en_US: You don't get along with that Talulah dragon girl.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W表达对塔露拉的不满
context_analysis.en_US: W expresses dissatisfaction with Talulah

description.zh_CN: W与阿米娅敌对，对博士好奇
description.en_US: W is hostile to Amiya but curious about Doctor

quote.zh_CN: 我很想知道，你究竟有什么魔力......能让他们都心甘情愿，毫无价值地为你送命？
quote.en_US: I really want to know what kind of magic you have... that makes them willing to die for you so worthlessy?

context_analysis.zh_CN: W对博士好奇
context_analysis.en_US: W is curious about Doctor

display_description.zh_CN: 试探与敌对（好奇博士为何能让人甘愿为之赴死）
display_description.en_US: Curious and hostile (wondering why the Doctor commands such devotion)

description.zh_CN: 银灰与罗德岛合作
description.en_US: SilverAsh cooperates with Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: 银灰作为盟友加入战斗
quote.en_US: SilverAsh joins as an ally

context_analysis.zh_CN: 银灰提供支援
context_analysis.en_US: SilverAsh provides support

relation_label.zh_CN: 试探与好奇（想了解博士的指挥与魅力）
relation_label.en_US: Curious and probing (wanting to understand the Doctor's command)

description.zh_CN: 试探与好奇（想了解博士的指挥与魅力）
description.en_US: Curious and probing (wanting to understand the Doctor's command)

quote.zh_CN: 我很想知道，你究竟有什么魔力......能让他们都心甘情愿，毫无价值地为你送命？
quote.en_US: I really want to know what kind of magic you have... that makes them willing to die for you so worthlessly?

context_analysis.zh_CN: W对阿米娅发问，实际是在探究博士为何能让人甘愿赴死
context_analysis.en_US: W questions Amiya, but is actually probing why the Doctor commands such devotion

description.zh_CN: 陈对罗德岛态度冷淡
description.en_US: Ch'en is cold toward Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: 你们迟到了十四分钟，无谓地浪费了我十四分钟时间。感染者就该清楚，来龙门会有什么下场。
quote.en_US: You're fourteen minutes late, pointlessly wasting my fourteen minutes.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈表现冷淡
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en is cold

description.zh_CN: 魏彦吾是陈的上级
description.en_US: Wei Yenwu is Ch'en's superior

quote.zh_CN: 陈受魏彦吾指派与罗德岛合作
quote.en_US: Ch'en assigned by Wei to cooperate with Rhodes Island

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈服从上级指令
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en follows superior's orders

description.zh_CN: 姐弟/誓死保护
description.en_US: Siblings / Sworn to protect

quote.zh_CN: 你一定要回来...... / 帮我照顾好米莎。
quote.en_US: You must come back... / Take care of Misha for me.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 碎骨与米莎是姐弟，碎骨誓死保护米莎，米莎在碎骨临终时哀求他回来
context_analysis.en_US: Sokai and Misha are siblings; Sokai swore to protect Misha; Misha begged him to return as he lay dying

description.zh_CN: 立场对立/最终之战
description.en_US: Opposing sides / Final battle

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅......大概这就是命运吧。
quote.en_US: Amiya... this is probably fate.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 碎骨与罗德岛最终一战，碎骨战死
context_analysis.en_US: Sokai fights Rhodes Island to the death; Sokai falls

description.zh_CN: 利用关系
description.en_US: Utilitarian / Exploiting

quote.zh_CN: 碎骨，我和你说过吧？只要干掉那个目标，战局就能瞬间逆转。
quote.en_US: Sokai, didn't I tell you? As long as we take out that target, the battle will turn instantly.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W建议碎骨去杀博士，以扭转战局
context_analysis.en_US: W suggests Sokai kill the Doctor to reverse the battle

description.zh_CN: 理念分歧/选择对立
description.en_US: Ideological divide / Chose Reunion

quote.zh_CN: 对不起，阿米娅，对不起......整合运动是感染者......他们，也是感染者啊......
quote.en_US: I'm sorry, Amiya, I'm sorry... the Reunion Movement are the infected... they are infected too...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 米莎在最后关头选择留在整合运动一边，向阿米娅道歉
context_analysis.en_US: Misha chooses to stay with Reunion and apologizes to Amiya

relation_label.zh_CN: 企鹅物流同僚/默契搭档

description.zh_CN: 企鹅物流同僚/默契搭档
description.en_US: Penguin Logistics colleagues / Tight partners

quote.zh_CN: 她可是我们的雇主，稍微礼貌一些。
quote.en_US: She's our employer, be a little more polite.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 德克萨斯与能天使是企鹅物流同僚，德克萨斯吐槽能天使对阿米娅说话随便
context_analysis.en_US: Texas and Exusiai are Penguin Logistics colleagues; Texas chides Exusiai for being too casual with Amiya

relation_label.zh_CN: 黑钢国际战友/默契配合

description.zh_CN: 黑钢国际战友/默契配合
description.en_US: Blacksteel International comrades / Flawless coordination

quote.zh_CN: 雷蛇，你该出场了！麻烦帮我抵挡一下敌人的远程攻击，谢谢！
quote.en_US: Liskarm, it's your turn! Please cover my back against ranged attacks, thanks!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 芙兰卡与雷蛇配合默契，相互掩护
context_analysis.en_US: Franka and Liskarm coordinate seamlessly, covering each other

description.zh_CN: 互相厌恶
description.en_US: Mutual contempt

quote.zh_CN: 我该先把你这个连野兽都不如的杀人狂，丢在雪原里等死。
quote.en_US: I should first throw you, this beast-like murderer, to die in the snow.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星对梅菲斯特的残暴嗤之以鼻
context_analysis.en_US: Frostnova despises Mephisto's cruelty

evidences.quote: 梅菲斯特：霜星？那个霜星？呵呵，她和她的雪怪，难道不是也背叛了吗？
evidences.context_analysis: 梅菲斯特质疑霜星的忠诚

relation_label.en_US: Rhodes Island comrades / Through fire and ice

description.zh_CN: 罗德岛战友/生死与共
description.en_US: Rhodes Island comrades / Through fire and ice

quote.zh_CN: （在我眼里，你也是孩子啊。）
quote.en_US: (In my eyes, you're a child too.)

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陨星与霜叶在绝境中互相扶持，霜叶为掩护她们不惜断后
context_analysis.en_US: Meteo and Frostleaf support each other through desperate odds; Frostleaf stays behind to cover their escape

description.zh_CN: 战友关怀
description.en_US: Comrades / Concern for each other

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅！你......你居然来了！见到你，真是，真是太好了......
quote.en_US: Amiya! You... you actually came! Seeing you is really, really great...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 杰西卡与陨星共同被困废城广场，陨星安慰杰西卡
context_analysis.en_US: Jessica and Meteo trapped in plaza; Meteo comforts Jessica

description.zh_CN: 战友/被保护者
description.en_US: Comrades / Protected by

quote.zh_CN: 站起来吧，杰西卡。你不用再害怕了——因为你现在，和我们在一起。
quote.en_US: Stand up, Jessica. You don't have to be afraid anymore — because you're with us now.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜叶与陨星营救杰西卡，阿米娅鼓励她站起来
context_analysis.en_US: Frostleaf and Meteo rescue Jessica; Amiya encourages her to stand

description.zh_CN: 整合运动领袖与队员
description.en_US: Reunion leader and soldier

quote.zh_CN: 我该先把你这个连野兽都不如的杀人狂，丢在雪原里等死。/哼。我要去追击罗德岛了。
quote.en_US: I should throw you away first... / Hmph. I'm going to pursue Rhodes Island.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星是雪怪小队领袖，听命于塔露拉
context_analysis.en_US: Frostnova leads the Snow雪怪 squad, under Talulah's command

evidences.quote: 霜星：但她已经背叛我们了。我所认定最坚定最执着的战士，居然只是种假扮出来的面貌......
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星明确表示塔露拉的背叛和对她的敌意

evidences.quote: 霜星：去拯救她。不。去帮助她。和我们那无数的感染者同胞一起......那个真正的......走在泥泞土地上的......塔露拉......
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星表示想要帮助真正的塔露拉，说明二人现在的对立关系

evidences.quote: 霜星：如果她要带着感染者向那最黑暗的未来走去......去完成她最恶毒的计划......那她的邪恶就必须被摧毁。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星决心对抗塔露拉，认定她必须被阻止

description.zh_CN: 上下级/指挥关系
description.en_US: Superior and subordinate / Command relation

quote.zh_CN: 是时候了————让这腐败的城市，化为灰烬。
quote.en_US: The time has come — let this corrupt city turn to ashes.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 塔露拉作为整合运动最高领袖，指挥梅菲斯特行动
context_analysis.en_US: Talulah as Reunion's supreme leader commands Mephisto's operations

description.zh_CN: 上下级/特殊信任
description.en_US: Superior and subordinate / Special trust

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德和弑君者已经破坏了一处防御——这样就万无一失了。
quote.en_US: Faust and Patriot have destroyed a defense — this makes everything foolproof.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 塔露拉信任浮士德执行破坏防御任务
context_analysis.en_US: Talulah trusts Faust to execute the defense sabotage mission

relation_label.zh_CN: 领袖对干员的关怀/鼓励

description.zh_CN: 领袖对干员的关怀/鼓励
description.en_US: Leader's care for operators / Encouragement

quote.zh_CN: 站起来吧，杰西卡。你不用再害怕了——因为你现在，和我们在一起。你不孤单，你身边永远有我们。
quote.en_US: Stand up, Jessica. You don't have to be afraid anymore — because you're with us now. You're not alone, we're always here for you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅鼓励害怕中的杰西卡站起来
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya encourages the frightened Jessica to stand up

relation_label.zh_CN: 表面政敌·实则青梅挚友

description.zh_CN: 陈与诗怀雅是童年挚友，曾一起玩耍，塔露拉也曾是她们的朋友。陈小时候性格刚烈、总是冲在最前保护大家，却从不肯向人求助；诗怀雅一直崇拜她、害怕她、又心疼她。长大后两人在龙门近卫局成为职场竞争对手，互相指责对方的决策，但私下诗怀雅对陈的安危极度关心，甚至在陈受伤时急切拿出消毒湿巾帮她处理伤口，星熊评价陈"心口不一"——嘴上强硬，内心柔软。这是一段极度复杂的青梅关系：竞争外表下藏着深厚信任，嘴上互不相让，行动却彼此牵挂。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Swire are childhood friends who once played together with Talulah. Young Ch'en was aggressive but always protected others without asking for help; Swire adored, feared, and pitied her. As adults they became workplace rivals in the Lungmen Guard Bureau, publicly criticizing each other — yet privately Swire panics over Ch'en's safety, rushing to treat her injuries with disinfectant wipes. Hoshiguma describes Ch'en as 'saying one thing, meaning another.' This is a deeply complex青梅 relationship: beneath fierce professional rivalry lies profound trust and mutual care.

relation_complexity.core_nature: 青梅挚友因职场竞争而互相指责，但内心深处彼此牵挂
tension_points: 陈擅自离开近卫局导致失守
诗怀雅担心陈会变成第二个塔露拉
两人对城市发展方向理念不同
bond_points: 陈小时候保护过诗怀雅
诗怀雅私下向星熊承认担心陈的安全
陈受伤时诗怀雅立刻拿出消毒湿巾

quote.zh_CN: 小时候我也和塔露拉一起玩过。虽然记不太清了，但我知道......我很喜欢和她做朋友。就算她又盛气凌人又坏脾气，但她会挡在我们身前来着。一句话也不说，一点也不懂撤退。什么事情都自己冲在第一位，从来不向我们寻求帮助......
quote.en_US: When I was little I played with Talulah too. I don't remember much anymore, but I know... I really liked being friends with her. Even though she was overbearing and bad-tempered, she'd stand in front of us to protect us. Never said a word, never knew when to retreat, always charged ahead first, never asked any of us for help...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅回忆童年与陈（和塔露拉）一起玩耍的情景：陈虽然脾气坏但会挡在朋友前面保护，从不求助——这解释了诗怀雅现在对陈复杂的情感：既敬畏又心疼。诗怀雅用'她'指代陈，说'很喜欢和她做朋友'，证实了青梅关系。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire reminisces about playing with Ch'en (and Talulah) as children: Ch'en was aggressive but would stand in front to protect them, never asked for help — explaining Swire's complex feelings: both revering and pitying Ch'en. 'I really liked being friends with her' confirms childhood bond.

quote.zh_CN: ......星熊，我很害怕，我害怕她......
quote.en_US: ...Hoshiguma, I'm scared, I'm scared of her...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅私下向星熊坦承她'害怕'陈——不是恐惧，而是担心陈会像塔露拉一样被黑暗吞噬。这是深藏的关心，而不是敌意。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire privately admits to Hoshiguma she's 'scared' of Ch'en — not terrified, but worried Ch'en will be consumed by darkness like Talulah. This is concealed concern, not hostility.

quote.zh_CN: 你受伤了？！......怎么会是小事！我这里有消毒湿巾，过来。......伤口不大，不过很深。好像......还有一点法术的痕迹。
quote.en_US: You're hurt?! ...How can it be nothing! I have disinfectant wipes here, come over. ...The wound isn't big but it's deep. Looks like... there's traces of arts damage too.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅看到星熊脸上的伤（陈打的）后立刻紧张询问，并拿出消毒湿巾要帮星熊处理。她对战友受伤的关心是真实的——联系上下文，这'害怕她'的担忧也包含着害怕失去陈的心情。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire panics seeing Hoshiguma's face injury (from Ch'en) and immediately offers disinfectant wipes. Her concern for the wounded is genuine — this fear of 'losing' Ch'en runs deeper than rivalry.

quote.zh_CN: 我说啊，老陈这个人，心口不一。她可是龙门的陈。就算她嘴上这么说，但她的梦想，她的目标，她的一生，都在这里。
quote.en_US: Look, old Chen here — she's all talk and no action, two-faced. But she's Lungmen's Chen. Even if she says these things, her dreams, her goals, her whole life — it's all here.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 星熊评价陈'心口不一'——嘴上说着强硬的话，心里却装着龙门和身边的人。这是理解陈的关键：她不是真的冷漠，而是表达方式刚硬。这是诗怀雅和星熊都理解的默契。
context_analysis.en_US: Hoshiguma says Ch'en is 'all talk' but has her heart in Lungmen. Key insight: Ch'en isn't truly cold, just expresses herself harshly. This is the shared understanding between Swire and Hoshiguma.

quote.zh_CN: 我怎么能担那个能力？我又不是她......
quote.en_US: How could I possibly have that ability? I'm not her...

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅向星熊坦白她觉得自己'不适合近卫局'，因为她不是陈——她羡慕陈的魄力和能力，却不认为自己能做到。这说明在诗怀雅心中陈是近卫局的标杆和偶像般的存在。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire admits to Hoshiguma she feels 'unsuited for the Guard Bureau' because she's not Ch'en — envying Ch'en's courage and capability. Ch'en is Swire's benchmark and idol in her heart.

quote.zh_CN: 龙门失守了，整个近卫局都被整合运动控制着，这是你的错。当龙门需要你的时候，你为什么不在龙门？我替你感到羞耻，陈警司。
quote.en_US: Lungmen has fallen, the whole Guard Bureau is under Reunion control — this is YOUR fault. Why weren't you in Lungmen when it needed you? I'm ashamed of you, Inspector Ch'en.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅当众激烈指责陈，言辞尖锐。但联系level_st_07-03的回忆，这种'指责'背后是诗怀雅对陈'擅离职守'导致城市陷入危险的恐惧和愤怒——她不是真的恨陈，而是害怕失去她。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire publicly and harshly accuses Ch'en. But combined with level_st_07-03 memories, this 'accusation' masks Swire's terror at losing Ch'en — not genuine hatred, but fear disguised as anger.

quote.zh_CN: 命最重要。不要为了眼前事把命搭上，你还有很多人可以依靠。
quote.en_US: Life matters most. Don't risk your life for immediate concerns — you have many people you can rely on.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 诗怀雅在陈即将独自上天台对决梅菲斯特前真诚地叮嘱她安全第一。这不是政敌的嘲讽，而是真心的关心。
context_analysis.en_US: Swire genuinely tells Chen to prioritize her life before facing Mephisto alone. This is not rivalry taunt but sincere care.

quote.zh_CN: 靓饮茶餐厅——还记得吗？那家三文治里肉排很酥的那家。我请你。
quote.en_US: The Liangi Tea Restaurant — you remember? The one with the crispy pork chop sandwiches. My treat.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈主动提起与诗怀雅的共同回忆，并承诺请她吃三文治。这是陈罕见的主动缓和姿态，说明尽管嘴上争吵，她内心珍视与诗怀雅的友谊。
context_analysis.en_US: Chen proactively mentions their shared memory and promises to treat Swire. This is a rare conciliatory gesture from Chen.

quote.zh_CN: 想挨打的话，建议去整合运动后面排队。
quote.en_US: If you want to get beaten up, I suggest joining the back of the Reunion Movement line.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈对诗怀雅的挑衅回应以威胁式的玩笑话，语气虽强硬但实际是两人日常互怼模式，说明两人关系足够亲密。
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en responds to Swire's provocation with threatening banter — their relationship is close enough for such joking.

description.zh_CN: 陈与梅菲斯特在近卫局天台展开生死对决，陈以赤霄斩击梅菲斯特及其护卫，最终梅菲斯特在浮士德帮助下逃离。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Mephisto battle on the Guard Bureau rooftop; Ch'en slashes Mephisto and his guards with Chi Xiao, but Mephisto escapes with Faust's help.

quote.zh_CN: 多说无益，齐上吧。这里不是整合运动该来的地方！
quote.en_US: Enough talk — come at me together. This is no place for Reunion!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈拒绝梅菲斯特的对话提议，宣示死战
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en rejects Mephisto's dialogue offer, declaring total war

quote.zh_CN: 你也逃不掉。
quote.en_US: You won't escape either.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈用赤霄斩击浮士德，阻止梅菲斯特逃走
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en uses Chi Xiao to slash Faust, preventing Mephisto's escape

evidences.quote: [近卫局成员] 别让他们走！击杀他们的指挥核心！
evidences.context_analysis: 近卫局的目标包括击杀梅菲斯特

evidences.quote: [陈] 不要放松警惕，这些感染者远比之前的整合运动敌人难缠。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈评价整合运动感染者的威胁

description.zh_CN: 陈与煌在近卫局天台配合作战，共同击败梅菲斯特的护卫。煌亲眼目睹陈以赤霄一剑斩杀十余人，对陈的实力深感震惊。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Blaze fight together on the Guard Bureau rooftop against Mephisto's guards. Blaze witnesses Ch'en cut down over a dozen enemies with one Chi Xiao slash, deeply impressed.

quote.zh_CN: 他们要上了，姓陈的！
quote.en_US: They're coming, you Chen!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌与陈联手面对梅菲斯特的护卫
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze teams up with Ch'en against Mephisto's guards

quote.zh_CN: 你刚才是不是拔剑了？一剑？十几个这种东西？全灭？
quote.en_US: Did you just draw your sword? One slash? A dozen of them? All dead?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌对陈用赤霄一剑斩杀十余人护卫表示震惊
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze is shocked by Ch'en slaying a dozen guards with one Chi Xiao slash

description.zh_CN: 陈是龙门近卫局长官魏彦吾的直接下属。魏彦吾制止陈对罗德岛的过激言论，陈服从命令。魏彦吾指定陈全权负责与罗德岛的对接。陈称魏彦吾为'魏长官'，忠诚执行命令。
description.en_US: Ch'en is the direct subordinate of Lungmen Guard Captain Wei Yenwu. Wei stops Ch'en's rampage against Rhodes Island; Ch'en obeys. Wei assigns Ch'en full authority over Rhodes Island coordination.

quote.zh_CN: 冷静些，陈警官，他们是客人。——我的客人。
quote.en_US: Calm down, Officer Ch'en. They are guests — my guests.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 魏彦吾制止陈对罗德岛的过激言论，陈服从命令
context_analysis.en_US: Wei stops Ch'en's outburst; Ch'en obeys

quote.zh_CN: 陈警官将全权负责和你们的对接事宜。
quote.en_US: Officer Ch'en will have full authority over your coordination.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 魏彦吾指定陈全权负责与罗德岛的对接
context_analysis.en_US: Wei assigns Ch'en as the liaison to Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: ......是。在他们违反龙门法律之前，我会容忍，长官。
quote.en_US: ...Yes. I will tolerate them — until they violate Lungmen law, sir.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈服从魏彦吾的命令，承认龙门法律底线
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en obeys Wei's authority, acknowledging the legal boundary

evidences.quote: 魏彦吾：你们已经就位了？魏彦吾：对，没错。我知道。只是，近卫局有他们该做的事，你们有你们该做的。
evidences.context_analysis: 魏彦吾确认近卫局的部署，显示出对行动的整体指挥权

description.zh_CN: 陈与凯尔希在龙门会议室激烈交锋。陈质疑罗德岛、反对感染者参与龙门机密。凯尔希反击陈的立场，魏彦吾介入阻止冲突升级。陈言辞激烈但最终服从上级安排。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Kal'tsit clash fiercely in the Lungmen conference room. Ch'en questions Rhodes Island and opposes infected involvement in Lungmen affairs. Kal'tsit counters Ch'en's position; Wei intervenes to prevent escalation.

quote.zh_CN: 龙门目前没有将相关机密行动的方针通知罗德岛的义务。
quote.en_US: Lungmen currently has no obligation to inform Rhodes Island of classified operational plans.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈坚持龙门保密原则，与凯尔希针锋相对
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en insists on Lungmen secrecy, directly opposing Kal'tsit

quote.zh_CN: 如果陈小姐认为龙门的安危，尚不如对感染者进行盲目的惩罚来得重要。
quote.en_US: If Miss Ch'en believes Lungmen's safety is less important than blindly punishing the infected.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希反驳陈的立场，表达强烈不认同
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit rebuts Ch'en's stance with strong disagreement

description.zh_CN: 煌与陈在龙门战役中并肩作战。煌联手对抗梅菲斯特护卫，震惊于陈的赤霄斩击。煌评价陈是值得尊敬的战士。
description.en_US: Blaze and Ch'en fight side by side during the Lungmen campaign. Blaze teams up against Mephisto's guards, amazed by Ch'en's Chi Xiao slash. Blaze respects Ch'en as a warrior.

quote.zh_CN: 混账白发小子！！他又干了什么！
quote.en_US: That damn white-haired kid!! What did he do now!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌与陈共同对抗梅菲斯特制造的局面
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze and Ch'en face Mephisto's creation together

evidences.quote: 陈：你还没有调查我合作伙伴的权限。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈公开承认煌为合作伙伴，在监察司面前维护煌

evidences.quote: 陈：煌，收手吧，这三位贵人不是你我该伺候的。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈提醒煌注意局势，共同应对危机

evidences.quote: 煌：刚才谢谢你了。没别的。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌向陈表达感谢，显示双方建立默契

description.zh_CN: 煌与霜星在战场上相遇。煌震惊于霜星身上渗透出的源石结晶，共情于霜星的痛苦。煌称霜星为'白兔子'，感叹她'难道感觉不到疼吗'。霜星临终时，煌试图让阿米娅去救她。
description.en_US: Blaze encounters FrostNova on the battlefield. Blaze is shocked by the Originium crystals渗透ing from FrostNova's skin, feeling deep empathy. Blaze calls her 'white rabbit' and asks if she feels no pain. At FrostNova's death, Blaze urges Amiya to save her.

quote.zh_CN: 她不疼吗！她难道感觉不到疼吗！！
quote.en_US: Does she not feel pain?! Does she feel no pain!!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌震惊于霜星身上渗透出的源石结晶，产生强烈共情
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze is shocked by FrostNova's Originium seepage, feeling intense empathy

quote.zh_CN: 赢得漂亮，罗德岛。
quote.en_US: Well fought, Rhodes Island.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星临终前向煌说'赢得漂亮'，展现战士间的相互认可
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova acknowledges Blaze at death: 'Well fought'

evidences.quote: 我想试试用我的温度和你的温度打一次
evidences.context_analysis: 煌主动挑战霜星，双方使用冷热法术对决

evidences.quote: 我劝你一句。别再战斗了，白毛兔子。再这么强撑着用法术，你会死得很快。
evidences.context_analysis: 战斗后煌发现霜星身体状况恶化，警告她过度使用法术会导致死亡

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与霜星在战场上相互认可。霜星临终前将最后一点生命交给阿米娅，说'凭你的头脑，应该也考虑到这点了吧？'。阿米娅能感知霜星情感的倒灌。霜星说阿米娅'很像当时的塔露拉'。
description.en_US: Amiya and FrostNova recognize each other as warriors. At death, FrostNova entrusts her remaining life to Amiya, saying 'With your mind, you should understand.' Amiya can sense FrostNova's emotions flooding in. FrostNova says Amiya resembles young Talulah.

quote.zh_CN: 凭你的头脑，应该也考虑到这点了吧？
quote.en_US: With your intelligence, you should understand this too, right?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星临终前将生命托付给阿米娅
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova entrusts her life to Amiya at death

quote.zh_CN: 很像啊。和当时的塔露拉，很像。
quote.en_US: She resembles... the Talulah of that time. Very much so.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星评价阿米娅很像当时的塔露拉
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova compares Amiya to young Talulah

evidences.quote: 霜星：我们迟早会是敌人，小兔子。只是，现在还不是。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星表明当前不是敌人但终将敌对，展现复杂关系

evidences.quote: 阿米娅：霜星小姐，他们经历过什么，我清清楚楚。
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅表达对雪怪小队经历的理解和同情

evidences.quote: 霜星：那就祈祷我们别再见面吧。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星表达不愿与罗德岛为敌但立场对立

description.zh_CN: 浮士德与霜星同属整合运动。浮士德牺牲后，霜星评价'浮士德是个好战士'。
description.en_US: Faust and FrostNova were Reunion comrades. After Faust's sacrifice, FrostNova says 'Faust was a good warrior.'

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德是个好战士。
quote.en_US: Faust was a good warrior.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星听闻浮士德牺牲后给予的评价
context_analysis.en_US: FrostNova's evaluation upon learning of Faust's sacrifice

evidences.quote: 浮士德：霜星一定会来支援我们。浮士德：霜星不会背叛。我们不是说好了，要自己去看到真相？
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德坚信霜星会来支援，不会背叛

description.zh_CN: 煌与阿米娅是罗德岛同事，煌称呼阿米娅为「小兔子」，两人关系亲密，阿米娅委托煌保护博士
description.en_US: Blaze and Amiya are Rhodes Island colleagues. Blaze calls Amiya 'little bunny', they are close. Amiya entrusts Blaze to protect the Doctor

evidences.quote: 小兔子！！阿米娅：别一见面就把我抱起来啊！！煌：怎么会有这么软的脸蛋......怎么会！
evidences.context_analysis: 煌与阿米娅重逢时热情拥抱，展现亲近关系

evidences.quote: 我会联系煌，让她保护你。会合前这一小段时间，也麻烦你，照看一下煌。
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅委托博士照顾煌的心理状态，说明两人信任关系

description.zh_CN: 煌对灰喉说过的歧视感染者言论表示不满并警告她
description.en_US: Blaze is dissatisfied and warns GreyThroat about her discriminatory remarks against the infected

evidences.quote: 下次你再对我们感染者同胞说那种话，我会撕掉你半张脸。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌警告灰喉不要歧视感染者同胞，语气强硬

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅尝试引导灰喉理解感染者的处境，认为她需要机会认清自己
description.en_US: Amiya tries to guide GreyThroat to understand the situation of the infected, believing she needs a chance to recognize herself

evidences.quote: 她没理由用那时的事情去批评现在的你。灰喉：谁知道呢，我真的改变看法了吗？我自己也不知道。阿米娅：（她的情感里没有恶意。她只是需要机会认清自己。）
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅理解灰喉的困惑，认为她需要机会认清自己

description.zh_CN: 浮士德与灰喉在战场上相遇，两人都累了，浮士德对灰喉的幼稚想法有所批评，但最终没有互相射击
description.en_US: Faust and GreyThroat encounter each other on the battlefield. Both are exhausted. Faust criticizes GreyThroat's naive thoughts but ultimately does not shoot each other

evidences.quote: 浮士德：罗德岛怎么会有这样幼稚的人？灰喉：是的，我很幼稚。我只会按命令做事。
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德批评灰喉幼稚，但语气中带有某种认可

evidences.quote: 灰喉：你很累了。只要是用弩的人，都能看出你的疲劳。弦绷得太紧，这样下去一定会断掉。
evidences.context_analysis: 灰喉理解浮士德的疲劳和压力，两人产生某种共鸣

evidences.quote: 你没有射击我，我也没有。下次不会了。如果你没射杀我，我就会射杀你。
evidences.context_analysis: 两人约定下次相遇时会互相射击，但这次互相放过

description.zh_CN: Rosmontis与Scout是罗德岛同事，Scout关心Rosmontis，称呼她为小猫
description.en_US: Rosmontis and Scout are Rhodes Island colleagues. Scout cares about Rosmontis, calling her 'little cat'

evidences.quote: Scout：你会见到的，小猫。
evidences.context_analysis: Scout安慰Rosmontis会见到博士，称呼她小猫

description.zh_CN: Rosmontis与Ace是罗德岛同事，Rosmontis提到Ace的胡子很硬
description.en_US: Rosmontis and Ace are Rhodes Island colleagues. Rosmontis mentions that Ace's beard is very hard

evidences.quote: Rosmontis：Ace，胡子很硬。
evidences.context_analysis: Rosmontis与Ace有亲近的互动，评价Ace的胡子

description.zh_CN: Ace培育灰喉数月，认为她绝对没有恶意，只是需要表达的机会
description.en_US: Ace has mentored GreyThroat for months, believing she absolutely has no malice, just needs an opportunity to express herself

evidences.quote: Ace：我清楚。但她可能真的只是很疑惑，她想要去问这个问题。我没资格要求干员立即明白我们的处境，而且，灰喉从没质疑过罗德岛的命令。
evidences.context_analysis: Ace为灰喉的行为辩护，认为她只是疑惑而非恶意

description.zh_CN: Ace与煌是罗德岛精英干员同事，Ace资历比煌老，被煌调侃
description.en_US: Ace and Blaze are Rhodes Island elite operator colleagues. Ace has more seniority than Blaze and is teased by her

evidences.quote: 谁叫Ace资历比我老呢。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌承认Ace资历比她老，语气中有调侃

description.zh_CN: 塔露拉对弑君者发号施令，利用她铲除异己
description.en_US: Talulah commands and exploits Stalker to eliminate her enemies

evidences.quote: [塔露拉] 剩下那个叛徒的位置，我已经知道了。她就在龙门，去刺杀她，去巩固你的名字，去让你的敌人感到恐怖。
evidences.context_analysis: 塔露拉命令弑君者去刺杀敌人，巩固势力

description.zh_CN: 霜星告诫弑君者注意真正的敌人，展现战友关怀
description.en_US: FrostNova advises Stalker to be mindful of the real enemy, showing comradeship

evidences.quote: [霜星] 杀完你的仇人，然后呢，你又该做什么？别忘了谁是真正的敌人。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星提醒弑君者不要忘记真正的敌人是谁

description.zh_CN: 林雨霞是鼠王（林）的女儿，她在贫民区执行任务时内心挣扎
description.en_US: Lin Yuxia is Lin Kerui's daughter; she mentions her father while carrying out missions in the slums

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 爸爸，如果当时的你是现在的我，你也会这么做的，对吧。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞内心独白，提及父亲魏彦吾

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 这支队伍，你知道他们在贫民区里做什么？[林雨霞] 他们有好好帮你们消灭整合运动啊。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞执行父亲的意志，维护龙门秩序

description.zh_CN: 林雨霞与诗怀雅在贫民区问题上存在严重分歧，诗怀雅反对林雨霞的做法
description.en_US: Lin Yuxia and Siege have serious disagreements over the slums issue; Siege opposes Lin Yuxia's methods

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 臭老鼠！你在干嘛！是不是你！
evidences.context_analysis: 诗怀雅怀疑林雨霞与贫民区事件有关

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 近卫局有近卫局该做的，我们有我们该做的。魏彦吾想你们维护龙门的秩序，而我们去除那些龙门不需要的东西。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞解释自己与近卫局的不同职责

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 你父亲的一切心血都在那里！
evidences.context_analysis: 诗怀雅强调林雨霞父亲的努力都在贫民区

description.zh_CN: 陈发现林雨霞的特殊部队在贫民区的行动，对立态度明显
description.en_US: Chen discovers Lin Yuxia's special forces operations in the slums, showing obvious hostile attitude

evidences.quote: [陈] 龙门的特殊力量私下出动了。这片区域内的所有居民都生死不明。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈意识到林雨霞的特殊部队在贫民区活动

evidences.quote: [陈] 别蒙我，你心里有底。至少你听过，你绝对知道。
evidences.context_analysis: 陈明确表示知道林雨霞与特殊部队有关

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 黑蓑们被陈逼走了？
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞提到陈逼走黑蓑一事

description.zh_CN: 魏彦吾信任诗怀雅，让诗怀雅维护龙门秩序
description.en_US: Wei Yanwu trusts Siege to maintain order in Longmen

evidences.quote: [林雨霞] 魏彦吾想你们维护龙门的秩序，而我们去除那些龙门不需要的东西。
evidences.context_analysis: 林雨霞传达魏彦吾的意志，让近卫局维护秩序

description.zh_CN: 灰喉与梅菲斯特敌对，灰喉代表罗德岛参与战斗
description.en_US: GreyThroat and Mephisto are hostile; GreyThroat fights on behalf of Rhodes Island

evidences.context_analysis: 灰喉参与战斗

description.zh_CN: 霜星和爱国者都教过浮士德，浮士德信任霜星会将部队指挥权交给她
description.en_US: Both FrostNova and Patriot taught Faust; Faust trusts FrostNova to take command of the troops

evidences.quote: [幻影弩手] 爱国者和霜星都教过他。他成了我们的队长。
evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手回忆浮士德的成长经历

evidences.quote: [浮士德] 我信任霜星。如果她来了，你们都能幸存。
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德临终前信任霜星会照顾他的部队

description.zh_CN: 浮士德是幻影弩手们的队长，领导他们作战
description.en_US: Faust is the leader of the Phantom Crossbowmen, leading them in battle

evidences.quote: [幻影弩手] 浮士德！我们知道，别用！你的感染器官会破裂的！
evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手们关心浮士德的健康

evidences.quote: [幻影弩手] 浮士德把梅菲斯特托付给了我们......这是他最后的命令。我们会做到。
evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手执行浮士德的遗愿

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与诗怀雅在龙门战役中合作，双方互相认可
description.en_US: Amiya and Siege cooperate in the Longmen battle, showing mutual respect

evidences.quote: [诗怀雅] 哎，这只小兔子，好厉害啊。
evidences.context_analysis: 诗怀雅对阿米娅表示赞赏

evidences.quote: [阿米娅] 那是诗怀雅小姐的声音吗？
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅认出诗怀雅的声音

description.zh_CN: 煌与梅菲斯特敌对，煌要参与最后一战
description.en_US: Blaze and Mephisto are hostile; Blaze participates in the final battle

evidences.quote: [煌] 看来没法在这闲着了。走了，博士，这就是最后一战了！
evidences.context_analysis: 煌准备参与对抗梅菲斯特的战斗

evidences.quote: [煌] 果然，当时在天台上就该把那小子直接收了。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌后悔没有早点解决梅菲斯特

description.zh_CN: 灰喉遇到神秘人物（林雨霞？），对其保持警惕
description.en_US: GreyThroat encounters a mysterious figure (possibly Lin Yuxia?) and remains vigilant

evidences.quote: [？？？] 他是你的朋友吗？[灰喉] ......我不知道。你是谁？
evidences.context_analysis: 灰喉对这个神秘人物保持警惕

evidences.quote: [？？？] 和感染者做朋友是很危险的。
evidences.context_analysis: 神秘人物对灰喉与感染者的关系表示担忧

description.zh_CN: 霜星对浮士德表示敬意，称他是个好战士。浮士德为让其他小队顺利撤退而留在贫民区外
description.en_US: Frostleaf expresses respect for Faust, calling him a good warrior. Faust stayed outside the slums to allow other squads to retreat safely.

evidences.quote: 浮士德他为了让我们和其他小队顺利撤退，留在了贫民区之外。那种情况下，很难生还。浮士德是个好战士。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星对浮士德的牺牲表示敬意

description.zh_CN: 九（原近卫局成员）三年前已脱离近卫局，她认为原本应该是她命令陈。陈试图说服九回来帮助龙门
description.en_US: Nine (a former Guard Bureau member) left the Guard Bureau three years ago. She believes she should have been the one giving orders to Chen. Chen tries to convince Nine to help Lungmen.

evidences.quote: 九：三年前起，我就不属于近卫局了。再说，原本，理应是我命令你。陈：九......！
evidences.context_analysis: 九透露自己三年前离开近卫局，并表示自己原本是陈的上司

evidences.quote: 九：龙门就拜托你了。陈：什么？我不理解你的意思。
evidences.context_analysis: 九表示要将龙门交给陈，暗示她要离开

description.zh_CN: 弑君者认为凯尔希是背叛科学家研究所的叛徒，凯尔希试图向她解释真相，揭示真正的背叛者是乌萨斯帝国
description.en_US: The Assassin believes Kal'tsit betrayed the scientists' institute. Kal'tsit tries to explain the truth, revealing the real traitor was the Ursus empire.

evidences.quote: 弑君者：叛徒......叛徒！找到你了，叛徒！凯尔希：你是......伊利亚的女儿，柳德米拉？
evidences.context_analysis: 弑君者与凯尔希对峙，揭示弑君者真实身份

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：你的父亲是我带过最好的研究员之一，他的无私和专注本可以将乌萨斯前推五年。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希解释她与弑君者父亲伊利亚的关系

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：一个人能活多少年岁，又能走过多少路？我们被蒙蔽的时间，总比我们看清事实的时候更多。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希试图让弑君者认清真相

description.zh_CN: 红是凯尔希的下属，协助她追捕弑君者，红具有出色的嗅觉追踪能力
description.en_US: Red is Kal'tsit's subordinate, assisting her in capturing the Assassin. Red has excellent scent-tracking abilities.

evidences.quote: 红：肯定没错。红闻到了。（嗅嗅）恶，假的。她不是狼。但气味是真的。这个气味，是真狼。是第一匹真狼。
evidences.context_analysis: 红通过嗅觉追踪弑君者

evidences.quote: 红：不要动。凯尔希：应该不用。
evidences.context_analysis: 红制伏弑君者时，凯尔希下达指令

evidences.quote: 红：凯尔希是不是一直想见她？现在为什么不杀她？
evidences.context_analysis: 红与凯尔希讨论如何处置弑君者

description.zh_CN: Mon3tr是凯尔希的使徒，与她共同行动，帮助她制服弑君者
description.en_US: Mon3tr is Kal'tsit's apostle, acting together with her to subdue the Assassin.

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：出来，mon3tr。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希召唤Mon3tr协助作战

evidences.quote: Mon3tr：（欢快的嘶鸣）
evidences.context_analysis: Mon3tr响应凯尔希的召唤

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：去，mon3tr。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希命令Mon3tr攻击弑君者

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：湮灭她......Mon3tr：（不满的尖啸）
evidences.context_analysis: Mon3tr执行凯尔希的命令

description.zh_CN: 大熊是雪怪小队的成员，与霜星并肩作战
description.en_US: Big Bear is a member of the Snow Squad, fighting alongside Frostleaf.

evidences.quote: 雪怪小队成员C：大熊呢？现在的火力太小了，炮火压制，搞大点！雪怪小队成员A：他说他知道了！
evidences.context_analysis: 大熊参与雪怪小队的战斗

evidences.quote: 雪怪小队成员：......啊？*乌萨斯粗口*！大熊说他也没问题。
evidences.context_analysis: 大熊同意与罗德岛休战

description.zh_CN: 陨星是罗德岛干员，与霜星在战场上达成临时休战，共同抵抗黑色雨披特殊部队
description.en_US: Meteor is a Rhodes Island operator who achieved a temporary ceasefire with Frostleaf on the battlefield to jointly resist the black-raincoat special forces.

evidences.quote: 雪怪小队成员：......啊？*乌萨斯粗口*！大熊说他也没问题。
evidences.context_analysis: 雪怪小队同意休战

evidences.quote: 阿米娅：是。感染者本来不该相互为敌的。很抱歉。
evidences.context_analysis: 阿米娅承认杀害碎骨（亚历克斯），双方达成休战

description.zh_CN: 浮士德是梅菲斯特的下属和战友，梅菲斯特的精神受到创伤，浮士德为掩护他人撤退而留下
description.en_US: Faust is Mephisto's subordinate and comrade. Mephisto's spirit was traumatized, and Faust stayed behind to cover others' retreat.

evidences.quote: 霜星：梅菲斯特怎么在你们这？他怎么了？幻影弩手：梅菲斯特他似乎......精神受到了一点创伤。
evidences.context_analysis: 幻影弩手报告梅菲斯特的状况

evidences.quote: 霜星：浮士德呢？幻影弩手：浮士德他为了让我们和其他小队顺利撤退，留在了贫民区之外。
evidences.context_analysis: 浮士德为掩护他人牺牲自己

description.zh_CN: 杰西卡是罗德岛干员，与煌共同作战
description.en_US: Jessica is a Rhodes Island operator fighting alongside Blaze.

evidences.quote: 阿米娅：杰西卡，雪怪小队的动向呢？杰西卡：正，正在向我们的位置靠近！还有五百米左右！
evidences.context_analysis: 杰西卡负责侦察任务

description.zh_CN: 霜叶是罗德岛干员，与煌并肩作战，对雪怪小队有一定了解
description.en_US: Frostleaf is a Rhodes Island operator fighting alongside Blaze. She has some knowledge of the Snow Squad.

evidences.quote: 霜叶：呼，呼......霜叶：从来......就都很低。我没事了，让我......
evidences.context_analysis: 霜叶身体状况不佳但坚持作战

evidences.quote: 霜叶：冻原的雪怪居然是这样的人。我不能接受。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜叶对雪怪小队的人性感到意外

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希观察煌与雪怪小队的互动，对煌的情感状态发表评论
description.en_US: Kal'tsit observed Blaze's interaction with the Snowcap Squad, commenting on Blaze's emotional state

evidences.quote: 凯尔希：你们的情感状态有些起伏不定。看来在切城废城，你们和这支整合运动的小队有过更深层次的交流。
evidences.context_analysis: 凯尔希观察并评论煌的情感状态，暗示对煌与雪怪小队关系的了解

description.zh_CN: 陨星作为罗德岛干员，配合阿米娅进行救援行动
description.en_US: FallingStar, as a Rhodes Island operator, cooperated with Amiya in rescue operations

evidences.quote: 陨星：阿米娅，收手吧！你的手指已经血流不止了......！
evidences.context_analysis: 陨星关心阿米娅的状态，劝说她停止过度使用能力

evidences.quote: 陨星：真不知道该说这是阿米娅她的缺点，还是她的特长......
evidences.context_analysis: 陨星评价阿米娅在博士安危面前的执着态度

description.zh_CN: 霜星将特效药赠予霜叶治疗冻伤，表达对战友的关怀
description.en_US: FrostNova gave special medicine to FrostLeaf to treat frostbite, showing care for her comrade

evidences.quote: 霜星：治疗冻伤的特效药。独家秘方。至少能缓解烧灼感和疼痛。我研究这东西很久了，刚才那一仗，你打的很不错。
evidences.context_analysis: 霜星认可霜叶的战斗表现并给予奖励，展现雪怪小队内部温情
霜叶接受霜星的心意，展现小队团结

description.zh_CN: 煌对未能救下Ace感到遗憾和后悔，展现战友之情
description.en_US: Blaze felt regret and remorse for not being able to save Ace, showing comrade bond

evidences.quote: 煌：必须。
evidences.context_analysis: 煌确认对失去Ace的遗憾，必须为其复仇

evidences.quote: 煌：当然！没机会救下他，后悔吗？
evidences.context_analysis: 煌表达对未能救下Ace的悔恨

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与弑君者在ch00(1096 TY)的互动关系。

description.en_US: Prts saves Hilda during dissolution, explains Originium and Terra relationship

quote.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯：你的死亡的确已经发生，物质向信息转译的过程我并未干预。但物质的消亡并不意味着真正的死亡。
quote.en_US: Prts: Your death did occur, I did not intervene in the material-to-information translation. But material destruction does not mean true death.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯解释如何救下崩解中的希尔达
context_analysis.en_US: Prts explains how she saved dissolving Hilda

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香操作焚化炉送霜星最后一程，她第一次遇见博士时询问霜星的名字。
description.en_US: Rosmontis operates the cremator for Frostnova and asks the Doctor for her name upon their first meeting.

quote.zh_CN: 霜星......好好听。你好，霜星。......拜拜。
quote.en_US: Frostnova... what a beautiful name. Hello, Frostnova. ...Goodbye.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香在综合生物处理室第一次遇见博士，将霜星的遗体放入焚化炉，并在告别时轻轻说出霜星的名字。
context_analysis.en_US: Rosmontis meets the Doctor in the Rhodes Island Bio-Processing Room and places Frostnova's body in the cremator, saying farewell softly.

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香在综合生物处理室第一次遇见失忆的博士，感受到博士身上的伤疤和沉重。
description.en_US: Rosmontis first meets the amnesiac Doctor in the Rhodes Island Bio-Processing Room, sensing his scars and sorrow.

quote.zh_CN: 你是，Dr.{@nickname}？......是你，没有错。我感觉到了......虽然，不太一样。
quote.en_US: You are Dr.{@nickname}? ...It's you, no mistake. I can feel... though it's different.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香第一次在综合生物处理室遇见博士，通过感知察觉到博士的独特气息。
context_analysis.en_US: Rosmontis meets the Doctor in the 综合生物处理室, sensing his unique presence through her abilities.

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香与阿米娅心灵相通，阿米娅通过额头相贴帮助迷迭香稳定情绪，两人并肩作战。
description.en_US: Rosmontis and Amiya share a soul-deep connection; Amiya helps stabilize Rosmontis by pressing their foreheads together.

quote.zh_CN: 迷迭香......我会靠近你一点。（额头相贴）过来些，再过来些。
quote.en_US: Rosmontis... I'll come closer to you. (Presses foreheads together) Come closer, come closer.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅通过额头相贴引导迷迭香稳定情绪，帮助她完成源石技艺的搜索任务。
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya helps Rosmontis stabilize by pressing their foreheads together during a critical mission.

quote.zh_CN: 但迷迭香从来不想我拿走这些感情......这些突然缠上来的情感，无论它是什么样子，它都属于迷迭香。
quote.en_US: But Rosmontis never wants me to take away these emotions... these feelings, whatever form they take, belong to Rosmontis.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅对迷迭香说，她不会干涉迷迭香的感情，只会陪伴和接受。
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya tells Rosmontis she will never interfere with her emotions, only accompany and accept them.

description.zh_CN: 煌非常担心迷迭香参与危险任务，劝她不要去核心城，但最终尊重她的选择。
description.en_US: Blaze is deeply concerned about Rosmontis participating in the dangerous core city mission, but ultimately respects her choice.

quote.zh_CN: 迷迭香！等等！你伤得好重，怎么还跑出来？快回去。快点回去。......你年纪太小了，这么危险的任务，你是不该去的！
quote.en_US: Rosmontis! Wait! You're badly injured, why are you out here? Go back. Go back quickly. ...You're way too young for such a dangerous mission!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌在07-04_end中看到迷迭香伤重出现，极力劝阻她参与核心城任务，展现战友情谊。
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze sees injured Rosmontis and tries to stop her from joining the core city mission, showing deep concern.

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希亲自引导迷迭香回归现实，用手的触感将她从精神崩溃边缘拉回。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit personally guides Rosmontis back to reality, using physical touch to pull her back from the edge of mental collapse.

quote.zh_CN: 迷迭香，看看我的手。看，医生的手。现在医生正把手放在你的脸上。凯尔希医生正托着你的脸。看我的脸。......我和阿米娅，都在这里。
quote.en_US: Rosmontis, look at my hand. Look, doctor's hand. Now doctor is placing her hand on your face. Kal'tsit is cradling your face. Look at my face. ...Amiya and I are both here.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希用手托住迷迭香的脸，将她从精神崩溃的边缘拉回，展现出母亲般的关怀。
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit cradles Rosmontis's face to pull her back from collapse, showing motherly care.

description.zh_CN: 陈宣告自己是感染者后与魏彦吾彻底决裂，扔还近卫局徽章，跳窗离开龙门。
description.en_US: Ch'en completely breaks with Wei Yanwu after declaring her infected status, returning her LGD badge and jumping out the window.

quote.zh_CN: 魏彦吾，我对你和你的城市，你这座金玉其外败絮其中的城市......已经厌倦了。在你对贫民区出手的时候，我就已经不属于这座城市了。......我是感染者，也是龙门的叛徒。只有我是适合做这个的人。
quote.en_US: Wei Yanwu, I'm tired of you and your city, this outwardly golden but inwardly rotten city... When you moved against the slums, I stopped belonging to this city. ...I'm infected, and a traitor to Lungmen. Only I am suited for this.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈在07-01_end中公开自己是感染者，与魏彦吾决裂，扔还徽章，跳窗离开。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-01_end, Ch'en publicly declares her infected status, breaks with Wei, returns her badge, and jumps from the window.

relation_label.zh_CN: 同母异父姐妹·命运对决

description.zh_CN: 陈向星熊透露塔露拉是她的姐姐，陈为了阻止塔露拉撞向龙门而离开龙门。
description.en_US: Ch'en reveals to Hoshiguma that Talulah is her sister, and departs Lungmen to stop Talulah from ramming the city.

quote.zh_CN: 你知道整合运动的领袖是谁吗？塔露拉。Missy没告诉过你？塔露拉是我的姐姐。
quote.en_US: Do you know who the Reunion Movement's leader is? Talulah. Didn't Missy tell you? Talulah is my sister.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈在07-02_beg中告诉星熊塔露拉是她的姐姐，并表示要独自去阻止塔露拉。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-02_beg, Ch'en tells Hoshiguma that Talulah is her sister, and she will go alone to stop her.

description.zh_CN: 陈告诉星熊，九也因为同一个任务感染了矿石病，后来成为陈的线人并加入了整合运动。
description.en_US: Ch'en tells Hoshiguma that Nine was also infected through the same mission, later becoming Ch'en's informant and joining Reunion.

quote.zh_CN: 至于九，她已经走了。之前她离开近卫局，是因为她也被感染了。现在想想，我和九也许是因为同个任务患上的矿石病。她后来是我的线人，表面上加入了整合运动......然后，为了整合运动，她抛弃了龙门。
quote.en_US: As for Nine, she's already gone. She left the LGD before because she was also infected. Thinking about it, Nine and I may have gotten Orypetitis from the same mission. She later became my informant, joining Reunion on the surface... then abandoned Lungmen for Reunion.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈与九曾是近卫局战友，共同因公感染矿石病，九后来成为整合运动成员。
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en and Nine were LGD comrades who both contracted Orypetitis from the same mission; Nine later joined Reunion.

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希与爱国者在核心城重逢，进行萨卡兹见证仪式，送他最后一程。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit reunites with Patriot in the Core City and performs the Sarkaz witness ritual to see him off.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希，女勋爵？你为什么......没有变老？......勋爵。我甚至没想过，能再见你。
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit, my lady? Why... haven't you aged? ...My lady. I never thought I would see you again.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者认出凯尔希，称其为女勋爵，惊讶她没有变老，回忆起在卡兹戴尔的往事。
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot recognizes Kal'tsit as 'my lady', surprised she hasn't aged, recalling their shared past in Kazdel.

quote.zh_CN: 勋爵，这个，请拿好。停下切城的秘钥。......我死在......魔王的手上。......谢谢你，勋爵。
quote.en_US: My lady, please take this. The key to stop Chernobog. ...I die... by the hand of the Demon King. ...Thank you, my lady.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者将停止核心城的秘钥交给凯尔希，并在死前感谢她的萨卡兹见证仪式。
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot gives Kal'tsit the key to stop the Core City and thanks her for the Sarkaz witness ritual before dying.

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希揭示塔露拉是科西切的继承人，向魏彦吾透露了这一信息。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit reveals to Wei Yanwu that Talulah is Koschei's heir.

quote.zh_CN: 科西切公爵知道你有什么，也知道你能做什么。塔露拉也一样能。请将这件事交给我们，魏先生。我们是最适合去解决本次事件的人。
quote.en_US: Duke Koschei knows what you have and what you can do. Talulah knows it too. Please entrust this matter to us, Mr. Wei. We are best suited to resolve this incident.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希在07-01_end中向魏彦吾透露塔露拉是科西切的继承人，并请求让他处理此事。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-01_end, Kal'tsit tells Wei that Talulah is Koschei's heir and requests to handle the situation.

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与爱国者在核心城正面对决，用魔王之力看到他两百多年的记忆，最终被爱国者认可。
description.en_US: Amiya confronts Patriot in the Core City, using the Demon King's power to see his 200+ years of memories, and is ultimately acknowledged by him.

quote.zh_CN: 爱国者先生......这么多，这么多的悔恨......从来都不说，你从来都不向任何人去倾诉吗？
quote.en_US: Mr. Patriot... so much regret... you never tell anyone, never confide in anyone?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅通过魔王之力看到爱国者两百多年所有失去的记忆，爱国者因此停步与她对话。
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya sees Patriot's 200+ years of loss through the Demon King power, causing him to pause and dialogue with her.

quote.zh_CN: 你真有能力，活着离开这里？......你真有胆识，踏进无边荒原？......也许......这一切......都属于你们。只有你们......去做。那个......整合运动的，暴君，命运......你们自己......去推翻。
quote.en_US: Do you truly have the ability to leave here alive? ...Do you truly have the courage to step into the endless wasteland? ...Perhaps... all of this... belongs to you. Only you... can do it. The tyrannical leader of the Reunion Movement, fate... you yourselves... overthrow.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者临终前认可阿米娅，将停止核心城的秘钥交给罗德岛。
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot on his deathbed acknowledges Amiya and gives the key to stop the Core City to Rhodes Island.

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香与爱国者在核心城正面交战，她的剑和源石技艺都无法真正阻止爱国者前进。
description.en_US: Rosmontis confronts Patriot head-on in the Core City; her swords and arts cannot stop his advance.

quote.zh_CN: 菲林，你很强大。你对我是威胁。......竟然能，钉穿铠甲。这副铠甲，终于到了极限。
quote.en_US: Felines, you are very strong. You are a threat to me. ...To actually pierce through my armor. This armor has finally reached its limit.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香在07-15_end中用剑钉穿爱国者的铠甲，但爱国者依然前进，最终被阿米娅的魔王之力击倒。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-15_end, Rosmontis pierces Patriot's armor with her sword, but he keeps advancing until Amiya's Demon King power stops him.

description.zh_CN: 华法琳请求凯尔希保护爱国者，凯尔希承诺尽力，这是萨卡兹同胞间的请托。
description.en_US: Walfarin asks Kal'tsit to protect Patriot; Kal'tsit promises to try, as a request between Sarkaz people.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希，听好了，其他人大概率不会和你说，但我会。他是我们里最后的几个之一了。我不是慈善家，也没那么老好人，但......我们是萨卡兹人。......萨卡兹人在这片大地上已经过得够难了。可能的话，我希望他能回到卡兹戴尔。来我们这里也行。
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit, listen carefully. Most others wouldn't say this to you, but I will. He's one of the last of us. I'm not a philanthropist, not that kind either, but... we are Sarkaz. ...Sarkaz have had it hard enough on this land. If possible, I hope he can return to Kazdel. Even to be with us.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 华法琳作为血魔，向凯尔希请求保护温迪戈爱国者，强调萨卡兹同胞的身份。
context_analysis.en_US: Walfarin, a Vampire, asks Kal'tsit to protect the Wendigo Patriot, emphasizing their shared Sarkaz identity.

description.zh_CN: 临光与守林人并肩战斗，代表卡西米尔骑士向守林人及其游击队为过去的不援救道歉。
description.en_US: Nearl fights alongside Forest, offering apologies on behalf of Kazimierz knights for past failures to aid her guerrilla team.

quote.zh_CN: 过去的我没有帮助你的机会，这一次，我们战斗。我们战斗，不为了我们的祖国，只为阻止乌萨斯的暴行。即使我们这次只做支援工作，但我也做好了准备。为信仰而战，为你而死。
quote.en_US: I had no chance to help you in the past. This time, we fight. Not for our country, but to stop Ursus's atrocities. Even if we're only doing support work, I'm prepared. Fight for faith, die for you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 临光在07-03_beg中与守林人并肩战斗，为卡西米尔骑士过去未能援救游击队道歉。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-03_beg, Nearl fights alongside Forest and apologizes for Kazimierz knights' past failure to aid her guerrilla team.

description.zh_CN: 幻影弩手们从龙门回到核心城向塔露拉汇报浮士德牺牲的消息，塔露拉沉默地接受了这一消息。
description.en_US: The Phantom Crossbowmen return to the Core City and report Faust's sacrifice to Talulah, who silently accepts the news.

quote.zh_CN: 浮士德不顾自己的命，用法术掩盖了我们所有人的踪迹，把逃出来的机会......让给了我们。......确实如此，领袖。浮士德不顾自己的命......幻影弩手们，整合运动的同胞们......我们会永远怀念浮士德。
quote.en_US: Faust disregarded his own life, using arts to cover all our traces, giving the chance to escape... to us. ...Indeed so, leader. Faust disregarded his own life... Phantom Crossbowmen, Reunion comrades... we will forever remember Faust.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 幻影弩手向塔露拉汇报浮士德的牺牲，塔露拉表示会永远怀念他。
context_analysis.en_US: The Phantom Crossbowmen report Faust's sacrifice to Talulah, who says they will forever remember him.

description.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特命令萨卡兹雇佣兵放走幻影弩手，展现了对战友的保护。
description.en_US: Mephisto orders the Sarkaz mercenaries to let the Phantom Crossbowmen go, showing protection of comrades.

quote.zh_CN: 别杀他们。让他们走。魔族人，我会给你们不知疼痛的身躯。让他们走。
quote.en_US: Don't kill them. Let them go. Mercenary, I'll give you all bodies that feel no pain. Let them go.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 梅菲斯特在07-16_end中命令萨卡兹雇佣兵放走幻影弩手，用分享生命作为交换条件。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-16_end, Mephisto orders the Sarkaz mercenaries to let the Phantom Crossbowmen go, offering shared life as payment.

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅向博士表示现在是并肩作战的状态，他们一起面对核心城的战斗。
description.en_US: Amiya tells the Doctor they are now fighting shoulder to shoulder as they face the Core City battle together.

quote.zh_CN: 博士，我们是肩并着肩了。从和你重逢开始，我就一直想找个机会，告诉博士......我长大了。我已经不用博士，凯尔希医生和......遮风挡雨。
quote.en_US: Doctor, we are now fighting shoulder to shoulder. Ever since we met again, I've been looking for a chance to tell you... I've grown up. I no longer need you, Dr. Kal'tsit, and others to shield me from the wind and rain.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅在07-03_beg中向博士表示她已经成长，不再需要别人遮风挡雨，现在是并肩作战的伙伴。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-03_beg, Amiya tells the Doctor she has grown up and no longer needs protection; they are now equals fighting together.

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香记挂已故的Ace和Scout，决心去了解他们身上发生了什么，并表示永远不会忘记他们的死。
description.en_US: Rosmontis is deeply concerned about the late Ace and Scout, determined to understand what happened to them and vowing never to forget their deaths.

quote.zh_CN: Ace和Scout都在切尔诺伯格，他们没回来。也就是说，他们已经不在了吧。我想去看看。我要明白是怎么回事。我要看看管整合运动的人，我要知道是谁做了什么。我要知道在Ace和Scout身上发生了什么。
quote.en_US: Ace and Scout were both in Chernobog, they didn't come back. Which means they're already gone, right? I want to go see. I need to understand what happened. I want to see who's leading Reunion, I need to know who did what. I need to know what happened to Ace and Scout.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香在07-04_end中查看日志发现Ace和Scout没有回来，决定去核心城了解真相。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-04_end, Rosmontis checks the logs and finds Ace and Scout haven't returned, deciding to go to the Core City to find out the truth.

description.zh_CN: Mon3tr是凯尔希的战斗力量，在核心城与爱国者的战斗中凯尔希指挥Mon3tr进行攻击。
description.en_US: Mon3tr is Kal'tsit's combat instrument. In the Core City battle against Patriot, Kal'tsit commands Mon3tr to attack.

quote.zh_CN: Mon3tr，撑住！......Mon3tr，别靠近他！把能量聚集成束......收束。再收束，收束成线，照准他的心脏部位！照射。现在！
quote.en_US: Mon3tr, hold on! ...Mon3tr, don't get close to him! Gather the energy into a beam... Focus. Focus more, into a line, aim for his heart! Fire. Now!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希在07-16_end中指挥Mon3tr对爱国者发动攻击，用能量束照射他的心脏部位。
context_analysis.en_US: In 07-16_end, Kal'tsit commands Mon3tr to attack Patriot, firing an energy beam at his heart.

description.zh_CN: 陈与塔露拉是同母异父姐妹，在核心城天台展开决战。陈手持赤霄，阿米娅使用黑色魔王之剑，两人联手对抗被科西切附身的塔露拉。最终塔露拉觉醒，驱除科西切，姐妹重逢。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Talulah are half-sisters, confronting each other atop the Core City. Ch'en wields Chi Xiao while Amiya uses the black Demon King's sword. After Talulah expels Koschei, the sisters reunite.

quote.zh_CN: 我本想这么说，但这似乎是在给你找理由。如果有理由，也等到你能活着上了法庭再说。
quote.en_US: I want to say this, but it seems I'm making excuses for you. If there's a reason, wait until you can stand trial alive.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈对塔露拉说要逮捕她，但承认没有审判塔露拉的资格——因为感染者至今没有公正的审判场所
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en says she will arrest Talulah but admits no one has the right to judge her——because no fair tribunal for the infected exists yet

quote.zh_CN: 好久不见。好久不见，姐姐。看来我救到你了。
quote.en_US: Long time no see. Long time no see, sister. Seems like I saved you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 核心城停下后，陈与塔露拉重逢。陈用小时候的游戏比喻两人过去的隔阂，承认她们各自走上了不同的路，但未来还很长
context_analysis.en_US: After the Core City stops, Ch'en and Talulah reunite. Ch'en references their childhood game, acknowledging they each walked different paths, but the future is still long

relation_label.zh_CN: 魔王与感染者领袖·天台决战
relation_label.en_US: Demon King vs. Reunion Leader · Rooftop Duel

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅以萨卡兹魔王继承者身份，与陈联手对抗被科西切附身的塔露拉。阿米娅使用黑色长剑和陈的赤霄剑联合攻击，最终塔露拉自我意识觉醒，驱除了科西切的诅咒。
description.en_US: Amiya, as the successor to the Demon King of Sarkaz, fights alongside Ch'en against Koschei-possessed Talulah. Using a black sword and Chi Xiao together, they force Talulah to expel Koschei and reclaim her identity.

quote.zh_CN: 你不是塔露拉。现在你心里的，既是塔露拉，也是科西切。我的感觉不会错。
quote.en_US: You are not Talulah. What dwells in your heart now is both Talulah and Koschei. My senses are never wrong.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅识破塔露拉被科西切附身，指出她既不完全是塔露拉也不完全是科西切
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya sees through Koschei's possession, identifying that Talulah is neither fully herself nor fully Koschei

quote.zh_CN: 我们不关心。无论你是科西切还是塔露拉......从我姐姐的身体里滚出去。
quote.en_US: We don't care. Whether you're Koschei or Talulah...... get out of my sister's body.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅和陈并肩作战，明确表示她们不在乎塔露拉的过去，只要求科西切离开塔露拉的身体
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya and Ch'en fight back-to-back, making clear they don't care about Talulah's past, only that Koschei leave her body

quote.zh_CN: 塔露拉小姐！请你记住......请你回想起来你自己是谁！
quote.en_US: Miss Talulah! Please remember...... please recall who you truly are!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅恳求塔露拉想起自己是谁，想起了霜星、浮士德、所有相信她的战士，想起她想成为的人
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya pleads with Talulah to remember who she is, recalling Frostnova, Faust, all who believed in her

description.zh_CN: 科西切公爵是塔露拉的养父，他以教育之名对塔露拉施加源石技艺的思维操控/诅咒——赌塔露拉终有一天会因为人性的丑恶而认同他。塔露拉刺杀科西切，但诅咒已在之前生效。黑蛇科西切在塔露拉成年后继续附身于她，最终在核心城决战中被陈与阿米娅联手驱逐。
description.en_US: Duke Koschei is Talulah's adoptive father. He used arts to plant a curse in her mind, betting she would one day embrace his worldview. Talulah stabbed Koschei to death, but the curse had already taken root. Koschei possessed her in later years, finally expelled by Ch'en and Amiya in the Core City battle.

quote.zh_CN: 科西切......一个孩子。安东尼奥带着他的儿子旅行，你让我栽赃他......你诱骗我去杀一个孩子。
quote.en_US: Koschei...... a child. Antonio was traveling with his son, and you had me frame him...... you tricked me into killing a child.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 塔露拉揭露科西切诱骗她杀孩子的阴谋，宣布自己故意感染矿石病以摆脱他的控制
context_analysis.en_US: Talulah exposes Koschei's scheme to trick her into killing a child, declaring she infected herself with oripathy to escape his control

quote.zh_CN: 你诅咒我？你是想......用你自己......塑造我？不，塔露拉，这不是诅咒。这是祝福。
quote.en_US: You cursed me? You want to...... shape me with yourself......? No, Talulah, this is not a curse. This is a blessing.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 科西切揭露他的诅咒本质：通过加速塔露拉对人性失望的过程，在她否定的时刻将她转化为另一个自己
context_analysis.en_US: Koschei reveals the true nature of his curse: accelerating Talulah's disillusionment to turn her into himself at the moment of her negation

quote.zh_CN: 塔露拉：我不是你的女儿......我杀你，只是为了阻止你再去作恶。
quote.en_US: Talulah: I am not your daughter...... I kill you only to stop you from doing evil again.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 塔露拉刺死科西切，但科西切死前预言她终将后悔，诅咒的种子已经种下
context_analysis.en_US: Talulah stabs Koschei to death, but Koschei predicts she will regret it——the seed of the curse was already planted

description.zh_CN: 阿丽娜是塔露拉最亲密的朋友和战友，两人一起逃离村子逃亡。在塔露拉因烧死纠察队引发村庄大火时，阿丽娜责备她不该让愤怒伤害无辜村民。阿丽娜教导塔露拉关于人性与信念的哲学思考，是塔露拉最重要的精神支柱之一。
description.en_US: Alina is Talulah's closest friend and companion, fleeing the village together. When Talulah burns down the village in anger, Alina rebukes her for harming innocent people. Alina's philosophical teachings about humanity and belief are central to Talulah's spiritual foundation.

quote.zh_CN: 你眼里有一团火。从你来这个村子的时候我就知道，你不会甘心在这个村子里呆下去的。你有你的来处，你从哪里来就要回到哪里去，这个村子容不下你。
quote.en_US: There is a fire in your eyes. I knew from when you came to this village that you would never be content to stay. You have your origins, where you come from is where you must return——this village cannot hold you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿丽娜在塔露拉烧村后与她一起逃亡，第一次表白她知道塔露拉不是普通人
context_analysis.en_US: Alina flees with Talulah after the village burning, first admitting she knew Talulah was no ordinary person

quote.zh_CN: 阿丽娜：你是在说那些精神，那些敌意，还有那些刻在乌萨斯人与我们骨子里的东西。皇帝？皇帝也只是它的一种样子吧。只要人们还不肯放下刀，那这场战争就不会结束。
quote.en_US: Alina: You are talking about those spirits, those hostilities, those things carved into the bones of the Ursus people and us. The Emperor? The Emperor is just one manifestation. As long as people refuse to put down their knives, this war will never end.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿丽娜在篝火旁与塔露拉深入讨论关于人性、命运和抗争的哲学
context_analysis.en_US: Alina and Talulah discuss philosophy about humanity, fate and resistance by the campfire

quote.zh_CN: 塔露拉：我认为我们的所作所为一定会有好的结果，原因也很简单。因为他们配得上那个结果。因为这片大地上的生灵值得那个结果。
quote.en_US: Talulah: I believe our actions will lead to good results, for one simple reason. Because they deserve those results. Because the beings on this land deserve those results.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿丽娜不相信命运是看得见摸得着的东西，塔露拉坚信感染者的未来值得奋斗
context_analysis.en_US: Alina doesn't believe in fate as something tangible; Talulah firmly believes the infected's future is worth fighting for

description.zh_CN: 爱国者（博卓卡斯替）是冻原感染者游击队的精神领袖。塔露拉在冻原遇到雪怪小队并最终与游击队合流。她想说服爱国者支持南下整合运动的计划，但爱国者始终不认同——他认为塔露拉的计划会让感染者送命，他只相信冻原上的生存方式。爱国者直到最后也没有同意塔露拉的南方计划。
description.en_US: Patriot (Batoskret) is the spiritual leader of the tundra partisan guerrilla force. Talulah met the Snowsquad and eventually integrated with the guerrillas. She tried to convince Patriot to support her southern Integration Movement plan, but he never agreed——he believed her plan would send the infected to their deaths, and he only trusted life on the tundra.

quote.zh_CN: 爱国者：你想离开雪原？你会被乌萨斯的铁甲碾碎。
quote.en_US: Patriot: You want to leave the tundra? You will be crushed by Ursus iron armor.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者第一次正式对塔露拉发表意见——否定她的南下计划
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot formally expresses his opinion to Talulah for the first time——rejecting her southern plan

quote.zh_CN: 爱国者：冻原上的感染者既不无知也不愚蠢。我们不抱幻想。所有的理念在被实践前都是幻想。
quote.en_US: Patriot: The infected on the tundra are neither ignorant nor foolish. We have no illusions. All ideals are fantasies before they are practiced.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者批评塔露拉的理念过于超前，认为冻原感染者务实，不会被假大空的学说打动
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot criticizes Talulah's ideals as too advanced, believing tundra infected are pragmatic and won't be swayed by grand doctrines

quote.zh_CN: 爱国者：我女儿也许会相信你。但我不相信一个从没因事实而失望，一直只是在陈托某种假大空的学说的人。
quote.en_US: Patriot: My daughter might believe you. But I don't believe in someone who has never been disappointed by facts, who only ever parrots some grand empty doctrine.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者承认霜星可能被塔露拉说服，但他自己坚持不信任
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot admits Frostnova might be persuaded by Talulah, but he himself remains unconvinced

relation_label.zh_CN: 罗德岛领袖与医疗总监

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅是罗德岛的领导人，凯尔希是罗德岛的医疗总监兼战略顾问。在核心城决战中，凯尔希指挥Mon3tr对抗牧群萨卡兹，最终赶到与阿米娅会合。凯尔希担忧自己无法保护好博士，也担忧阿米娅是否应该承载起不幸种族的命运。
description.en_US: Amiya is the leader of Rhodes Island, Kal'tsit is the medical director and strategic advisor. During the Core City battle, Kal'tsit commands Mon3tr against the Sarkaz Herd, eventually meeting up with Amiya. Kal'tsit worries about protecting the Doctor and whether Amiya should bear the fate of an unfortunate race.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希：阿米娅......你真的要承载起这样不幸的种族的命运吗？
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit: Amiya...... do you truly wish to bear the fate of such an unfortunate race?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希询问阿米娅的决心——面对牧群和源石粉尘感染的威胁
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit asks Amiya about her resolve——facing the threat of the Herd and originium dust infection

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希：即使是不值得，我也会这么做，理由的话，一会儿我也许有机会说给你听。
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit: Even if he's not worth it, I will do so. The reason, perhaps I will have a chance to tell you later.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希向博士表达她的守护决心，即使博士不是值得保护的人
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit expresses her determination to protect the Doctor, even if he is not worth protecting

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香（Rosmontis）与盾卫（Guard）在核心城与乌萨斯军和整合运动的混合军队战斗。迷迭香展现强大的精神力量，与盾卫和游击队并肩作战保卫罗德岛和阿米娅。
description.en_US: Rosmontis and Guard fight together against the mixed force of Ursus army and Reunion soldiers in the Core City. Rosmontis displays her immense spiritual power, fighting alongside Guard and the guerrillas to protect Rhodes Island and Amiya.

quote.zh_CN: 迷迭香：Raidian，收到信息的话，帮我干扰他们的通讯。一瞬间里让他们的耳机都爆炸就好了。
quote.en_US: Rosmontis: Radian, if you receive the message, help me jam their communications. Just make all their earpieces explode in an instant.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香指挥战术，干扰敌人通讯，配合游击队和罗德岛作战
context_analysis.en_US: Rosmontis commands tactics, jamming enemy communications, coordinating with guerrillas and Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: 盾卫：菲林，受乌萨斯盾卫和游击队战士支援的外人，你是第一个！迷迭香：不，我不是外人。我们现在是一支队伍。我们要停下这座城市。
quote.en_US: Guard: Firin, you are the first outsider supported by Ursus shield-bearers and guerrilla fighters! Rosmontis: No, I am not an outsider. We are now one force. We must stop this city.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 盾卫承认迷迭香是第一个获得游击队支援的外人，迷迭香宣称他们现在是一支队伍
context_analysis.en_US: Guard acknowledges Rosmontis as the first outsider to receive guerrilla support; Rosmontis declares they are now one force

description.zh_CN: W在核心城决战末尾找到阿米娅，揭露米莎（碎骨的姐姐）原本不需要死的真相。W请求阿米娅给她停止核心城的秘钥，帮助停止城市。阿米娅在得知W知道停止口令来自碎骨（亚历克斯）后，信任了W并交出秘钥。
description.en_US: At the end of the Core City battle, W finds Amiya and reveals that Misha (Gravelbone's sister) didn't need to die. W asks Amiya for the key to stop the city. After learning W knows the stop command from Gravelbone (Alex), Amiya trusts W and hands over the key.

quote.zh_CN: W：兔子，嗯。小兔子，你有点像她。……再见了，阿米娅。真心希望，我真心希望我这种人不会再和你见面。
quote.en_US: W: Bunny, um. Little bunny, you remind me of someone. [...] Goodbye, Amiya. I sincerely hope, I sincerely hope that someone like me will never meet you again.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W承认阿米娅有点像她认识的人，表达了对未来的祝愿后离开
context_analysis.en_US: W admits Amiya reminds her of someone she knew, expresses wishes for the future before departing

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：米莎已经死去了。我们永远没法弥补这个错误。W，以后这一切都不会再发生。我不会允许你再这样做。你要么答应我，要么，我们会把你囚禁在罗德岛。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Misha is already dead. We can never undo this mistake. W, this must never happen again. I won't allow you to do this again. Either you promise me, or we'll imprison you in Rhodes Island.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅要求W承诺不再伤害无辜者，否则将把她囚禁
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya demands W promise never to harm the innocent again, or face imprisonment

description.zh_CN: W恨塔露拉，想要把她炸成灰。W解释她是因为塔露拉才被迫杀了Scout——Scout为了保护其他人与W演了一出戏。W的萨卡兹雇佣兵被塔露拉清洗处决，W自己也受了重伤，但她发誓要再炸塔露拉一次。
description.en_US: W hates Talulah and wants to blow her to pieces. W explains she was forced to kill Scout because of Talulah——Scout performed a play with W to protect others. W's Sarkaz mercenaries were purged by Talulah, and W herself was gravely wounded, but swore to blast Talulah again.

quote.zh_CN: W：只要运气好，我们就都能活下去。祝各位好运。你们如果不信我，就试着去相信自己的运气吧。
quote.en_US: W: As long as we're lucky, we can all survive. Good luck, everyone. If you don't believe me, try believing in your own luck.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W在离开前警告盾卫和罗德岛，塔露拉不在意整合运动的死活，乌萨斯士兵穿着整合运动衣服
context_analysis.en_US: W warns Guard and Rhodes Island before departing that Talulah doesn't care about Reunion's fate and Ursus soldiers wear Reunion uniforms

quote.zh_CN: W：碎骨的父亲在死前和他这么说的。……在那之前，科西切这个老骗子骗了我们所有人。我，爱国者老爷子，霜星，浮士德，梅菲斯特，碎骨，弑君者，全都被骗了。
quote.en_US: W: Gravelbone's father told him this before he died. [...] Before that, old trickster Koschei fooled all of us. Me, old man Patriot, Frostnova, Faust, Mephisto, Gravelbone, the Assassin——we were all fooled.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W揭露塔露拉/科西切骗了所有人——整合运动只是她实现目标的工具
context_analysis.en_US: W reveals Talulah/Koschei fooled everyone——Reunion was merely a tool for her agenda

description.zh_CN: W被迫杀了Scout——Scout为了保护其他罗德岛干员与W演了一出戏。W认为Scout是萨卡兹中最有价值的战士，比她自己更有价值。罗德岛干员起初不相信W，但最终接受了她的说法。
description.en_US: W was forced to kill Scout——Scout performed a staged conflict with W to protect other Rhodes Island operators. W considered Scout the most valuable of all Sarkaz warriors, more valuable than herself. The Rhodes Island operator initially didn't believe W, but ultimately accepted her account.

quote.zh_CN: W：Scout是为你们罗德岛而死的。我是被迫取走了他的命。……Scout......你们给我听着！就算在巴别塔，Scout也是我觉得最有价值的战士。他比我贵。
quote.en_US: W: Scout died for your Rhodes Island. I was forced to take his life. [...] Scout...... listen to me! Even at Babel, Scout was the warrior I found most valuable. He was worth more than me.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W向罗德岛揭露Scout牺牲的真相，表达她对Scout的敬意
context_analysis.en_US: W reveals the truth of Scout's sacrifice to Rhodes Island, expressing her respect for him

quote.zh_CN: W：如果你们本事大点，如果你们当场干死那条龙女，怎么还会死那么多人？怎么还要我去杀Scout，去杀我看得起的人？
quote.en_US: W: If you were more capable, if you had killed that dragon lady on the spot, how many would have died? Why did I have to kill Scout, kill someone I respect?

context_analysis.zh_CN: W愤怒地责问罗德岛，如果他们能杀死塔露拉，Scout就不必死
context_analysis.en_US: W angrily质问 Rhodes Island—if they could have killed Talulah, Scout wouldn't have had to die

description.zh_CN: 鼠王（林舸瑞）拦截魏彦吾争取时间，为陈和阿米娅在核心城的战斗争取机会。鼠王认为他们的时代已经过去，不应该再让陈晖洁手足相残。魏彦吾与鼠王激战，最终鼠王阻止了魏彦吾直到核心城停下。
description.en_US: The Shrew King (Lin Gerui) intercepts Wei Yanwu to buy time for Ch'en and Amiya's battle in the Core City. The Shrew King believes their era has passed and shouldn't let Ch'en Huijie suffer fraternal conflict again. Wei Yanwu and the Shrew King fight desperately until the Core City stops.

quote.zh_CN: 鼠王：拦到我死——或者拦到核心城被停下。不管停下它的是影卫还是乌萨斯，是晖洁还是感染者。在它停下之前，你一步也走不出。
quote.en_US: Shrew King: I'll block you until I die——or until the Core City stops. Whether it stops by Shadow Guards or Ursus, by Huijie or the infected. Before it stops, you won't take another step.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 鼠王拦截魏彦吾，明确表示他会战斗到核心城停下，无论谁来完成这件事
context_analysis.en_US: Shrew King intercepts Wei Yanwu, clearly stating he will fight until the Core City stops, no matter who accomplishes it

quote.zh_CN: 鼠王：难道让陈晖洁再手足相残一次？让科西切再如愿一次？！我们的时代已经过去了，魏彦吾！
quote.en_US: Shrew King: Would you let Ch'en Huijie suffer fraternal conflict again? Let Koschei have his way again?! Our era has passed, Wei Yanwu!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 鼠王质问魏彦吾，不想让陈晖洁再次经历手足相残的悲剧
context_analysis.en_US: Shrew King questions Wei Yanwu, refusing to let Ch'en Huijie suffer another tragedy of sibling conflict

relation_label.zh_CN: 罗德岛指挥官与医疗总监

description.zh_CN: 博士是罗德岛的指挥官，凯尔希是医疗总监。凯尔希担忧自己无法保护好博士，并质疑博士是否是一个值得她去保护的人。她认为利用信息不对等施压是一种战术手段，但也承认逼急了卡特斯也会咬人。
description.en_US: The Doctor is the commander of Rhodes Island, Kal'tsit is the medical director. Kal'tsit worries she cannot protect the Doctor well enough and questions whether he is worth protecting. She sees using information asymmetry as a tactical tool, but also acknowledges that even a Cautus can bite when pushed.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希：我在担心自己会保护不好你。不，Dr.{@nickname}，总有一天我会保护不了你。……你是否的确是一个值得我去保护的人？
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit: I'm worried I won't be able to protect you well. No, Dr.{@nickname}, someday I will not be able to protect you. [...] Are you truly a person worth my protecting?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希坦白她担心无法保护博士，并质疑博士的自我价值
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit openly admits her worry about protecting the Doctor and questions his self-worth

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希揭示Mon3tr与萨卡兹牧群的变异真相。Mon3tr是凯尔希的重要战力，在核心城对抗牧群时凯尔希召唤Mon3tr战斗。她知道这种大规模感染源石粉尘的悲剧曾在过去发生过一次，发誓不让这类事件重演。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit reveals the truth about Mon3tr and the Sarkaz Herd's mutations. Mon3tr is Kal'tsit's vital combat asset; she summons it during the battle against the Herd in the Core City. She knows such a mass originium dust catastrophe happened once before and swears never to let it happen again.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希：Mon3tr，起来！我们的时间不多了。这种结局......甚至称不上是挽救。那些萨卡兹牧群的结局已经注定了。
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit: Mon3tr, rise! Our time is running out. This outcome...... cannot even be called salvation. The fate of those Sarkaz Herd members is already sealed.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希召唤Mon3tr面对源石粉尘大规模感染悲剧，知道萨卡兹牧群的命运已经无法改变
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit summons Mon3tr to face the originium dust catastrophe, knowing the Sarkaz Herd's fate is irreversible

description.zh_CN: 盾卫与幻影弩手在核心城并肩作战。幻影弩手提到浮士德队长为了他们连命都可以不要，如果罗德岛的兔子（阿米娅）真的可以为队长报仇，他们的命也确实不算什么。盾卫鼓励幻影弩手战斗到底。
description.en_US: Guard and the Phantom Crossbowmen fight side by side in the Core City. The crossbowmen mention that Captain Faust was willing to give his life for them, and if Rhodes Island's bunny (Amiya) can avenge their captain, their lives are expendable too. Guard encourages them to fight to the end.

quote.zh_CN: 幻影弩手：没了队长，我们没什么优势。……如果那个罗德岛的兔子真的可以为队长报仇，那我们的命也确实不算什么！
quote.en_US: Phantom Crossbowman: Without our captain, we have no advantage. [...] If that Rhodes Island bunny can really avenge our captain, our lives are truly not worth much!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 幻影弩手为浮士德的牺牲感到悲痛，愿将性命托付给阿米娅的复仇
context_analysis.en_US: Phantom Crossbowman grieves for Faust's sacrifice, willing to entrust their lives to Amiya's vengeance

quote.zh_CN: 盾卫：把命托付给我们的人，我们的命，当然也由她！
quote.en_US: Guard: Those who entrust their lives to us——our lives, of course, belong to her too!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 盾卫表示愿意将生命托付给迷迭香，体现游击队的战友信任
context_analysis.en_US: Guard expresses willingness to entrust his life to Rosmontis, reflecting guerrilla comrades' trust

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香在战斗中想起已故的Ace和Scout。她觉得做到了，理解了自己不是只有家人——这片大地上还有温柔的人、温暖的事。她努力记住这些温暖，哪怕伴随着痛苦。
description.en_US: Rosmontis remembers deceased Ace and Scout during battle. She feels she has done it, understood that she is not only family——there are warm and kind people on this land. She strives to remember these warmths, even if accompanied by pain.

quote.zh_CN: Ace，Scout，我好像做到了。我好像理解了。我不是只有家人的。这片大地上......还有好人。还有好多......温柔的人。很温暖。真的很温暖。温暖的事情，也许......我不会忘。
quote.en_US: Ace, Scout, I think I did it. I think I understand now. I'm not only family. On this land...... there are good people. So many...... gentle people. It's warm. Really warm. The warmth, perhaps...... I won't forget.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香在核心城战斗胜利后，向已故的战友们汇报她终于理解了什么是战友和温暖
context_analysis.en_US: Rosmontis reports to her fallen comrades after the Core City victory that she finally understood what it means to have comrades and warmth

description.zh_CN: 迷迭香在核心城誓言不让任何人干扰阿米娅与塔露拉的战斗。她和盾卫、游击队一起守卫阵线直到阿米娅完成决战。
description.en_US: Rosmontis swears in the Core City that no one will interfere with Amiya's battle against Talulah. She and Guard and the guerrillas guard the line until Amiya finishes the decisive battle.

quote.zh_CN: 迷迭香：要么我们赢了战斗结束，要么我会死去。他们谁也别想抓到阿米娅......谁也别想干扰她的战斗。
quote.en_US: Rosmontis: Either we win and the battle ends, or I die. No one will get their hands on Amiya...... no one will interfere with her fight.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香誓言要么赢得战斗要么死，不让任何人干扰阿米娅的关键之战
context_analysis.en_US: Rosmontis swears to win or die, refusing to let anyone interfere with Amiya's critical battle

description.zh_CN: 陈与阿米娅在核心城天台并肩对抗科西切附身的塔露拉。陈将赤霄剑术传授给阿米娅，阿米娅从陈心中学会全部剑术。两人用赤霄和黑色魔王之剑联合攻击，最终帮助塔露拉驱逐科西切。
description.en_US: Ch'en and Amiya fight back-to-back against Koschei-possessed Talulah atop the Core City. Ch'en teaches Amiya her sword technique; Amiya learns all of Ch'en's swordsmanship from her heart. Together they attack with Chi Xiao and the black Demon King's sword, finally helping Talulah expel Koschei.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：我知道，陈长官。她想杀你。我们面前的塔露拉心底还有一部分没被根除的记忆脉络，你是她与过去唯一的象征了。
quote.en_US: Amiya: I know, Commander Chen. She wants to kill you. The Talulah before us still has some unfading memory threads in her heart—you are the only symbol connecting her to the past.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅向陈解释塔露拉心里还有塔露拉本人的部分，陈是塔露拉与过去的唯一联系
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya explains to Ch'en that Talulah's heart still contains traces of Talulah herself, and Ch'en is the only connection to her past

quote.zh_CN: 陈：上了，阿米娅！先不要管她死活！阿米娅：啊？！真的可以吗......！陈：别想得我们好像真有得选一样！
quote.en_US: Ch'en: Let's go, Amiya! Don't worry about her life for now! Amiya: Huh?! Is that really okay......?! Ch'en: Don't pretend we have a choice!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈与阿米娅配合默契，陈催促阿米娅一起攻击，承认她们没有选择
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en and Amiya work in perfect sync; Ch'en urges Amiya to attack together, acknowledging they have no choice

relation_label.en_US: Tundra Comrades · Through Life and Death

description.zh_CN: 塔露拉在冻原遇到霜星，两人展开激烈战斗后和解。霜星后来跟随塔露拉南下参与整合运动，最终在龙门之战中牺牲。塔露拉在回忆中想起霜星咬牙切齿的悲鸣，始终无法忘记这位战友。
description.en_US: Talulah met Frostnova on the tundra; after a fierce battle they reconciled. Frostnova later followed Talulah south to join the Integration Movement, ultimately sacrificing herself in the Lungmen battle. Talulah recalls Frostnova's bitter roar in her memories, unable to forget this comrade.

quote.zh_CN: 霜星：你很强，你带着他们走了很长的路，和我们一样。……但向南方去就是种幻想。塔露拉：我们给那些感染者找一个家。
quote.en_US: Frostnova: You are strong, you brought them a long way, same as us. [...] But going south is but a fantasy. Talulah: We will find a home for those infected.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星承认塔露拉很强但质疑南下计划，塔露拉回应要为感染者找家
context_analysis.en_US: Frostnova acknowledges Talulah's strength but questions the southern plan; Talulah responds by promising to find the infected a home

quote.zh_CN: 她记得霜星咬牙切齿的悲鸣。她看见温迪戈屹立不倒的遗躯。她听过阿丽娜压抑不住的轻呼。
quote.en_US: She remembers Frostnova's bitter roar. She sees the unyielding remains of the Wendigo. She hears Alina's suppressed cry.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅在唤醒塔露拉时提到霜星和爱国者的牺牲，触动塔露拉的记忆
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya touches Talulah's memories by mentioning Frostnova and Patriot's sacrifices when awakening her

description.zh_CN: 塔露拉与爱国者和雪怪小队在冻原并肩作战。她与霜星联手对抗乌萨斯驻军时，爱国者以萨卡兹仪式布置的源石装饰帮助吓退敌军。爱国者在战斗中使用萨卡兹仪式，巨人和冻原的北风令乌萨斯军闻风丧胆。
description.en_US: Talulah fought alongside Patriot and the Snowsquad on the tundra. When she and Frostnova fought against Ursus forces, Patriot's Sarkaz ritual originium artifacts terrified the enemy. Patriot used a Sarkaz ceremony in battle; the giant and the tundra's northern wind made the Ursus army flee.

quote.zh_CN: 霜星：那是为我父亲设置的。……乌萨斯军没有再追赶我们了。他们似乎很忌惮那东西。……那是萨卡兹的东西？那是爱国者的萨卡兹仪式。
quote.en_US: Frostnova: That was set up for my father. [...] The Ursus army didn't pursue us anymore. They seemed terrified of it. [...] Is that something Sarkaz? That is Patriot's Sarkaz ceremony.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 霜星解释源石装饰是爱国者设置的萨卡兹仪式，吓退了乌萨斯军
context_analysis.en_US: Frostnova explains the originium artifacts were set up by Patriot as a Sarkaz ceremony, terrifying the Ursus army

quote.zh_CN: 爱国者站定，向冻原投出了手中长戟。只懂如何吞食活物生命的阴郁天空忽地被刺出一个空洞。
quote.en_US: Patriot stood still and threw his spear toward the tundra. The gloomy sky that only knows how to devour living things was suddenly pierced with a hole.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 爱国者以萨卡兹仪式战斗，向冻原投出长戟，象征乌萨斯压迫的终结
context_analysis.en_US: Patriot fights with a Sarkaz ceremony, hurling his spear toward the tundra, symbolizing the end of Ursus oppression

description.zh_CN: 塔露拉是科西切思维操控的受害者。科西切的源石技艺早在塔露拉逃离时就已开始施用，导致她部分记忆被扭曲（比如她误以为那个夜晚是雨天而非晴天）。科西切的诅咒在她否定自己时刻生效，最终在核心城被陈和阿米娅联手打破。
description.en_US: Talulah is a victim of Koschei's mental manipulation. Koschei's originium arts began being used when Talulah fled, twisting some of her memories (e.g., she mistakenly thought that night was rainy when it was clear). Koschei's curse activated when she negated herself, finally broken by Ch'en and Amiya in the Core City.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：不。塔露拉，科西切的源石技艺不是在他死后才生效的......他从那时候开始，就已经对你施用了这个法术了。想一想吧。你有多少思绪被扭曲了，你有多少记忆被蒙上了薄纱？
quote.en_US: Amiya: No. Talulah, Koschei's originium arts didn't only activate after his death...... from that time, he was already using this art on you. Think about it. How much of your thoughts have been distorted, how much of your memories have been veiled?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅揭露科西切的源石技艺早在塔露拉逃离时就开始施用，导致她的记忆被扭曲
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya reveals Koschei's originium arts were used from when Talulah fled, distorting her memories

quote.zh_CN: 塔露拉？：那个月夜，那个下着倾盆大雨的夜晚……你为什么心甘情愿地留在那条恶龙身边？陈：那是个晴天。我绝对不会记错……那天晚上，虽然没有月亮，没有星星——但你拉我出去的时候，是白天。
