quote.en_US: Koschei-Talulah: That moonlit night, that night of torrential rain...... why did you willingly stay by that evil dragon's side? Ch'en: It was clear. I absolutely remember...... that night, although there was no moon, no stars——when you pulled me outside, it was daytime.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 陈指出塔露拉记错了那晚的天气——是晴天不是雨天，证明她的记忆被扭曲
context_analysis.en_US: Ch'en points out Talulah misremembered that night's weather——clear, not rainy——proving her memories were distorted

description.zh_CN: 风笛是号角手下最出色的战士，号角曾用盾牌在萨尔贡雇佣兵的高爆炮弹下救过风笛一命。
description.en_US: Bagpipe is Horn's most outstanding warrior; Horn once saved her with her shield during a Saladin mercenary bombardment.

quote.zh_CN: 队长，当时你喊的不是其他人回撤吗？我判断只有我有机会完成这项任务。
quote.en_US: Captain, you called for others to retreat but not me, so I judged I was the only one with a chance to complete the task.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 风笛在仓库城事件中违背回撤命令扑向货箱保护嫌疑人，展现出号角手下最出色战士的勇气。
context_analysis.en_US: Bagpipe defied the retreat order in the warehouse city incident, lunging at a crate to protect the suspect.

quote.zh_CN: 我不是质疑队长你的盾啦……上次你在萨尔贡雇佣兵的高爆炮弹轰炸下救了我，我可不会忘。
quote.en_US: I'm not questioning your shield, Captain... Last time you saved me under a Saladin mercenary's bombardment, I won't forget that.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角用盾挡住高爆炮弹救下风笛，体现上下级之间的信任与战友之情。
context_analysis.en_US: Horn used her shield to block the high-explosive shells and save Bagpipe, showing trust and camaraderie.

description.zh_CN: 简妮每天去罗德岛驻小丘郡办事处送早餐，是办事处的常客，与奥利弗等人建立了深厚的同事关系。
description.en_US: Jeanne visits the Rhodes Island Small Hill County office every morning with breakfast, forming close collegial ties with Oliver and others.

quote.zh_CN: 简妮：大家早上好！今天天气真不错，你说是不是呀，奥利弗叔叔？
quote.en_US: Jeanne: Good morning everyone! Isn't the weather nice today, Uncle Oliver?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 简妮每天一大早来办事处送早餐和茶点，与奥利弗、碎纸机、威尔建立了如同家人般的同事关系。
context_analysis.en_US: Jeanne brings breakfast and snacks to the office daily, forming a family-like relationship with Oliver, Paper Shredder, and Will.

description.zh_CN: 简妮不似其他士兵，主动关心失去父亲克雷格的状况，展现出善良本性。
description.en_US: Unlike other soldiers, Jeanne actively cares for young Craig who lost his father, showing her kind nature.

quote.zh_CN: 简妮：你们家的苹果味道很好哦。没那么脆，但还是很甜，适合做成果泥抹面包吃。
quote.en_US: Jeanne: Your family's apples taste great! Not too crispy but quite sweet, good for making apple sauce on bread.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 简妮认出克雷格，主动关心他和母亲，用温情对待被其他士兵疏远的塔拉族孩子。
context_analysis.en_US: Jeanne recognizes Craig, actively cares for him and his mother, showing warmth toward the Talar child other soldiers avoid.

quote.zh_CN: 干员碎纸机：他父亲去世了，半年前。可怜人，得了矿石病。
quote.en_US: Paper Shredder: His father died, half a year ago. Poor man, contracted Oripathy.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 碎纸机告知简妮克雷格父亲去世的消息，而简妮并未因此疏远克雷格，反而更温柔地对待他。
context_analysis.en_US: Paper Shredder tells Jeanne about Craig's father's death, but Jeanne doesn't avoid Craig—she treats him with more warmth.

description.zh_CN: 号角作为铁公爵派系军人，对汉密尔顿上校的激进措施持保留态度，在审讯和战术上存在路线分歧。
description.en_US: Horn, as an Iron Duke faction soldier, holds reservations about Captain Hamilton's radical measures, differing in interrogation and tactical approaches.

quote.zh_CN: 号角：上校针对部分居民的措施已有过激嫌疑。万不得已的情况下，我希望我们小队能获得更多机动权。
quote.en_US: Horn: The Captain's measures against some residents have been overly radical. If necessary, I hope our squad can gain more tactical flexibility.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角向上级表达对汉密尔顿过激措施的反对意见，认为驻军行动已偏离正当执法范畴。
context_analysis.en_US: Horn expresses opposition to Hamilton's radical measures, believing the garrison's actions have deviated from legitimate law enforcement.

quote.zh_CN: 号角：您说的这些事件，听起来都很像是鬼魂部队所为。
quote.en_US: Horn: These incidents you describe sound very much like the work of the Specter Regiment.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角理性分析小丘郡局势，认为敌人是鬼魂部队而非普通塔拉居民，与汉密尔顿的种族主义判断对立。
context_analysis.en_US: Horn rationally analyzes the situation, identifying the enemy as the Specter Regiment rather than ordinary Talar residents, opposing Hamilton's racist judgment.

description.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮是深池的神秘领袖身边的首席谋臣，向领袖阐述哲学观点并在晚宴上代表深池发表意见。
description.en_US: Ahmani is the chief strategist of Deeppool's mysterious leader, articulating philosophical views and speaking for Deeppool at the banquet.

quote.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮：想看见……终点。在我们第一次相遇的时候，我就这么问过你——既然生的终点注定是死，秩序无论重建多少回都必然崩溃，那走在路上的人们，是如何忍受一次又一次无谓的选择的呢？
quote.en_US: Ahmani: I want to see... the end point. When we first met, I asked you this—if the end of life is death, and order will collapse no matter how many times it's rebuilt, how do those walking the path endure one more meaningless choice after another?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮回忆初次与领袖相遇的情景，阐述她独特的生死哲学和对秩序崩溃的思考。
context_analysis.en_US: Ahmani recalls her first meeting with the leader, expounding her unique philosophy on life and death and order's collapse.

quote.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮：所以说，拉芙希妮的事怎么处理？我的妹妹，她选了谁？
quote.en_US: Ahmani: So how do we handle Lafsine's matter? My sister, which side has she chosen?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮以谋臣身份向领袖汇报工作，讨论拉芙希妮被救走的善后事宜，展现出清晰的上下级关系。
context_analysis.en_US: Ahmani reports to the leader as a strategist, discussing the aftermath of Lafcine's rescue, showing a clear subordinate relationship.

description.zh_CN: 拉芙希妮是深池神秘领袖的妹妹，在小丘郡事变中被救出后，站在了与哥哥对立的位置，成为维多利亚方的一员。
description.en_US: Lafcine is the sister of Deeppool's mysterious leader. After being rescued during the Small Hill County incident, she stood in opposition to her brother, becoming a member of the Victorian side.

quote.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮：我的妹妹，她选了谁？救她的人身份不明，只是，他们在城里救了很多人。大概是……一个医疗方面的救援组织？
quote.en_US: Ahmani: My sister, which side has she chosen? The people who rescued her have unknown identities, but they saved many people in the city. Perhaps... a medical rescue organization?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮向领袖汇报拉芙希妮被救走的消息，揭示两人是亲姐妹关系。领袖对此持开放态度，表示有兴趣亲自见见救援者。
context_analysis.en_US: Ahmani reports Lafcine's rescue to the leader, revealing they are sisters. The leader is open, expressing interest in meeting the rescuers personally.

description.zh_CN: 蔓德拉作为深池激进派，与阿赫茉妮的谨慎路线在晚宴上激烈争吵，展现出深池内部在扩张策略上的路线分歧。
description.en_US: Mendra as Deeppool's radical faction clashes fiercely with Ahmani's cautious approach at the banquet, showing Deeppool's internal strategic divisions.

quote.zh_CN: 蔓德拉：你——！有钱人是不是都这副样子？放这么多乐器，买几本书，仿佛把门面装点得满满当当以后，别人就不会注意到那实际上空空荡荡的脑子。
quote.en_US: Mendra: You—! Are all rich people like this? Filled with instruments and books, like decorating a facade so full that others won't notice the actually empty heads inside.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 蔓德拉在晚宴上公开攻击阿赫茉妮，批评其生活方式和态度，展现两人的路线对立。
context_analysis.en_US: Mendra publicly attacks Ahmani at the banquet, criticizing her lifestyle and attitude, showing their ideological opposition.

quote.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮：什么时候——轮到你替领袖做决定了？
quote.en_US: Ahmani: When—did it become your turn to decide for the leader?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿赫茉妮当面驳斥蔓德拉的越权行为，揭示两人在深池内部权力结构中的不同地位。
context_analysis.en_US: Ahmani directly rebuts Mendra's overreach, revealing their different positions within Deeppool's power structure.

description.zh_CN: 蔓德拉作为深池激进派，对领袖重用阿赫茉妮的路线不满，渴望更快地扩张势力，甚至与领袖的规划产生冲突。
description.en_US: Mendra, as Deeppool's radical faction, resents the leader's preference for Ahmani's approach, craving faster expansion and clashing with the leader's plans.

quote.zh_CN: 蔓德拉：阿赫茉妮，阿赫茉妮……混蛋东西，你把我骗来这里，就是为了抢这个发言的机会？凭什么……凭什么你能替领袖发言，而我要在下面替你扫垃圾？！
quote.en_US: Mendra: Ahmani, Ahmani... you scoundrel, you tricked me into coming here just to steal this chance to speak? Why... why can you speak for the leader while I have to clean up your mess down here?!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 蔓德拉在通讯塔战斗中情绪崩溃，公开发泄对阿赫茉妮抢占广播发言权的不满，揭示她与领袖派系之间的深层矛盾。
context_analysis.en_US: During the communications tower battle, Mendra's emotions collapse, openly venting resentment at Ahmani stealing the broadcast opportunity, revealing deep conflicts with the leader's faction.

description.zh_CN: 风笛在通讯塔战斗中击败深池三十人小队，展现出超越常人的战斗力，是深池军队的主要威胁。
description.en_US: Bagpipe defeats a 30-person Deeppool squad at the communications tower, demonstrating superhuman combat ability and being the main threat to Deeppool forces.

quote.zh_CN: 深池士兵：破城矛……是维多利亚士兵！快，通知强盗长官，这里还有残余的维多利亚部队！敌人只有一个人！可他们有三十个人！
quote.en_US: Deeppool Soldier: Siege Lance... Victorian soldiers! Quickly, notify Captain Bandit, there's still residual Victorian troops here! The enemy is only one person! But they have thirty people!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 深池士兵震惊于风笛一人击败三十人的战斗力，连忙向上级汇报，展现风笛作为维多利亚精锐战士的恐怖战力。
context_analysis.en_US: Deeppool soldiers are shocked by Bagpipe defeating 30 alone, urgently reporting to superiors, showcasing Bagpipe's terrifying combat power as a Victorian elite warrior.

quote.zh_CN: 深池士兵：这瓦伊凡太厉害了，一矛能穿俩！让重装防御兵上，其他人回防！
quote.en_US: Deeppool Soldier: This Vaylin is too powerful, one lance can pierce two! Bring up heavy defenders, the rest fall back!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 深池士兵意识到普通战术无法对付风笛，被迫调动重装防御兵，体现风笛对深池军队的压倒性优势。
context_analysis.en_US: Deeppool soldiers realize normal tactics can't handle Bagpipe, forced to deploy heavy defenders, showing Bagpipe's overwhelming advantage over Deeppool forces.

description.zh_CN: 塔拉居民与维多利亚士兵之间存在根深蒂固的种族歧视与压迫关系，这种不公是深池崛起的根本原因。
description.en_US: Deep-rooted racial discrimination and oppression exist between Talar residents and Victorian soldiers, which is the fundamental cause of Deeppool's rise.

quote.zh_CN: 愤怒的男性：我们只配吃他们不想要的土豆和烂苹果，哪怕每一寸农用地块上都浸透了我们的汗水。我们只配在工厂里没日没夜地消耗性命，等干不动了就如他们所愿，一个个地全都染病！
quote.en_US: Angry Male: We only deserve the potatoes and rotten apples they don't want, even though every inch of farmland is soaked with our sweat. We only deserve to labor day and night in factories until we get sick, as they wish—one by one!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 愤怒的塔拉居民控诉维多利亚工厂的歧视性待遇——药品减半、防护服缺失、工资不平等等，系统性压迫导致矛盾激化。
context_analysis.en_US: Angry Talar residents accuse Victorian factories of discriminatory treatment—halved medicine, missing protective gear, unequal pay—systemic oppression fueling escalating tensions.

quote.zh_CN: 维多利亚士兵：渣滓们，再说一遍，不许聚集！！你们*维多利亚粗口*——
quote.en_US: Victorian Soldier: Scum, I'll say it again, no gathering!! You*Victorian profanity*—

context_analysis.zh_CN: 维多利亚士兵公然用种族歧视性语言辱骂塔拉居民，并威胁使用武力驱散，激化双方对立情绪。
context_analysis.en_US: Victorian soldiers openly use racial slurs against Talar residents and threaten force, escalating mutual hostility.

description.zh_CN: 风笛与Outcast在通讯塔战斗中相遇并配合作战，Outcast用石头精准击杀狙击手助风笛突破，风笛则帮助Outcast清理道路。
description.en_US: Bagpipe and Outcast meet and fight together at the communications tower. Outcast uses stones to precisely eliminate snipers helping Bagpipe advance, while Bagpipe helps clear the path for Outcast.

quote.zh_CN: 风笛：是你帮了我吗？Outcast：不客气，事实上，你也帮了我。
quote.en_US: Bagpipe: Did you help me? Outcast: Not at all, in fact, you helped me too.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 风笛和Outcast在战斗中互相配合，Outcast用石头击落敌人帮助风笛，风笛则为Outcast清理障碍物，体现战友默契。
context_analysis.en_US: Bagpipe and Outcast coordinate in battle—Outcast uses stones to take down enemies helping Bagpipe, while Bagpipe clears obstacles for Outcast, showing combat comradeship.

quote.zh_CN: 风笛：谢谢！能推到一边就行。Outcast：我来帮你。风笛：谢谢，最后一根！路终于清好啦——
quote.en_US: Bagpipe: Thanks! Just push it to the side. Outcast: I'll help you. Bagpipe: Thanks, last one! The road is finally cleared—

context_analysis.zh_CN: 风笛和Outcast合力清理路障，为Outcast抱着重伤的深池领袖撤离创造通道，体现战友间的无私合作。
context_analysis.en_US: Bagpipe and Outcast work together to clear road obstacles, creating a passage for Outcast carrying the critically injured Deeppool leader, showing selfless comradeship.

description.zh_CN: Outcast在小丘郡事变中指导简妮，帮助她从迷茫的维多利亚仪仗兵成长为有独立判断力的战士，最终简妮决定留在罗德岛。
description.en_US: Outcast guides Jeanne during the Small Hill County incident, helping her grow from a confused Victorian ceremonial soldier into a warrior with independent judgment, eventually leading Jeanne to decide to stay with Rhodes Island.

quote.zh_CN: Outcast：能主动醒过来且保持清醒，这本身就需要勇气。尤其是这个梦是整个群体编织出来的关于某种文明形态的共同想象——相信我，没有人比我更了解。
quote.en_US: Outcast: The ability to wake up and stay awake on your own requires courage. Especially when this dream is a collective illusion about a form of civilization woven by the entire group—trust me, no one understands this better than me.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Outcast向简妮讲述自己年轻时的经历和放弃拉特兰枢机职位的原因，帮助简妮理解自己为何曾认同维多利亚的「文明」幻象。
context_analysis.en_US: Outcast tells Jeanne about her youth and why she gave up the Latran cardinal position, helping Jeanne understand why she once believed in Victoria's 'civilized' illusion.

quote.zh_CN: 简妮：有人教会了我——眼前的恶，必须被阻止。这与阵营无关，我本该如此。
quote.en_US: Jeanne: Someone taught me—that evil in front of me must be stopped. This has nothing to do with which side I'm on, this is who I should be.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 简妮引用Outcast的教导，在面对深池士兵欺压塔拉居民时挺身而出，展现出从迷茫到觉醒的成长。
context_analysis.en_US: Jeanne quotes Outcast's teaching when standing up against Deeppool soldiers oppressing Talar residents, showing growth from confusion to awakening.

description.zh_CN: 简妮主动关心在报社工作的塔拉族朋友西尔莎，展现出超越种族隔阂的真挚友情，最终西尔莎为阻止更大冲突而牺牲。
description.en_US: Jeanne actively cares for her Talar friend Sylsas who works at the newspaper, showing genuine friendship beyond racial barriers. Sylsas ultimately sacrifices herself to prevent greater conflict.

quote.zh_CN: 简妮：西尔莎，你怎么了？你刚哭过吗？西尔莎：不是的，简妮，你别忙活了。他并没有再来缠着我。
quote.en_US: Jeanne: Sylsas, what happened? Have you been crying? Sylsas: No, Jeanne, don't worry about it. He hasn't come to bother me again.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 简妮在报社找到西尔莎，发现她因达米安·巴里被处决而悲伤，展现超越立场的真挚关怀。
context_analysis.en_US: Jeanne finds Sylsas at the newspaper, discovers she's grieving over Damien Barri's execution, showing genuine care that transcends faction.

description.zh_CN: Outcast在小丘郡事变中与厨子麦克马丁（点灯人）建立战友关系，信任他作为信使出城传递情报，最终厨子为保护情报献身。
description.en_US: Outcast establishes a comrade relationship with Chef McMartin (Lightkeeper) during the Small Hill County incident, trusting him as a courier to deliver intelligence out of the city. Chef ultimately sacrifices himself protecting the intelligence.

quote.zh_CN: 厨子麦克马丁：别忘了，传递消息也是我们点灯人老本行的一部分。哎，我这总算能接点像样的任务了，我的手跟腿都在兴奋地发抖。
quote.en_US: Chef McMartin: Don't forget, passing messages is also part of our Lightkeeper duties. Well, I can finally take on a real mission, my hands and legs are trembling with excitement.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 厨子麦克马丁作为点灯人接下传递情报的任务，以信使身份出城，最终在炮击中为保护情报而牺牲。
context_analysis.en_US: Chef McMartin as a Lightkeeper takes on the intelligence delivery mission as a courier, ultimately sacrificing himself protecting the intelligence during the bombardment.

description.zh_CN: 风笛与蔓德拉在通讯塔决战中正面对决。风笛以战术智慧发现蔓德拉源石技艺的破绽（同时只能做一件事），用破城矛击倒石柱破坏其防御，最终击败蔓德拉。
description.en_US: Bagpipe and Mendra face off at the communications tower. Bagpipe discovers Mendra's Originium Art limitation (can only do one thing at a time), uses her siege lance to knock down stone pillars breaking Mendra's defense, ultimately defeating Mendra.

quote.zh_CN: 蔓德拉：我是——从废水沟旁的坟墓里爬出来的人！你们这群维多利亚上等人欠我的，还没有还干净！
quote.en_US: Mendra: I am—someone who crawled out of the graves by the sewage ditch! What you Victorian aristocrats owe me hasn't been paid yet!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 蔓德拉在战斗中揭示自己悲惨的过去和对维多利亚贵族的深仇，承认风笛是很厉害的对手，展现傲气与战意。
context_analysis.en_US: Mendra reveals her tragic past and deep hatred for Victorian aristocrats during combat, acknowledging Bagpipe as a formidable opponent.

quote.zh_CN: 风笛：果然，我们的猜测是正确的，她的源石技艺虽然非常灵活，可在同一时间只能做一件事——无论是转移碎石当护盾，还是释放这些石刺，只要在施法的间隙期，她就会有破绽！
quote.en_US: Bagpipe: As we guessed, her Originium Art, though very flexible, can only do one thing at a time—whether shifting gravel as a shield or releasing these stone spikes, during the gap between casting, she'll have weaknesses!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 风笛与号角通过观察和分析发现蔓德拉源石技艺的致命破绽——同时只能做一件事。利用这一弱点，她们成功击倒蔓德拉。
context_analysis.en_US: Bagpipe and Horn discover Mendra's fatal Originium Art weakness through observation—only one action at a time. Using this gap, they successfully bring Mendra down.

description.zh_CN: 号角与风笛在通讯塔决战中并肩对抗蔓德拉。号角用残破的盾牌为风笛争取冲锋机会，风笛发现蔓德拉的源石技艺破绽，两人联手击败蔓德拉。号角重伤但坚持到最后，下令风笛用破城矛飞出城传递情报。
description.en_US: Horn and Bagpipe fight side by side against Mendra at the communications tower finale. Horn uses her broken shield to buy Bagpipe time to charge, Bagpipe discovers Mendra's Originium Art flaw, and together they defeat Mendra. Horn is severely injured but holds on, ordering Bagpipe to use the siege lance to fly out of the city and deliver intelligence.

quote.zh_CN: 号角：抱紧你的矛，启动弹射功能，从这里飞出去——带上所有情报。找到真正值得信赖的人，把鬼魂部队的消息传到外面……伦蒂尼姆必须知道小丘郡事件的真相。风笛——活着出去！
quote.en_US: Horn: Hold your lance tight, activate the launch function, fly out from here—bring all the intelligence. Find someone truly trustworthy, get the Specter Regiment's message out... Lengbury must know the truth of the Small Hill County incident. Bagpipe—get out alive!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角在通讯塔决战最后时刻，用最后的盾为风笛抵挡石刺攻击并下令风笛用破城矛的弹射功能飞离战场传递情报，体现出战友间的绝对信任与托付。
context_analysis.en_US: At the communications tower finale, Horn uses her last shield to block stone spike attacks for Bagpipe and orders Bagpipe to use the siege lance's launch function to fly out of the battlefield with the intelligence, showing absolute trust and comradeship.

description.zh_CN: Outcast在小丘郡小巷中拦截深池六名干部，以六发子弹同时射击的方式将「会计」「囚犯」「纵火家」「毒药学者」「强盗」「雄辩家」全部击杀，为保护重伤的深池领袖（拉芙希妮）献出生命。
description.en_US: Outcast intercepts six Deeppool cadres in a Small Hill County alley, simultaneously shooting six bullets to eliminate 'Accountant,' 'Prisoner,' 'Arsonist,' 'Poison Scholar,' 'Robber,' and 'Orator' to protect the critically injured Deeppool leader (Lafcine), sacrificing her life in the process.

quote.zh_CN: Outcast：你们将在这里迎来最终的审判。六发子弹从她的左轮中同时射出。六名敌人扑向她——所有动作都停在了开始的那一刻。没有惊呼，也没人来得及倒下，他们全部在神圣的光芒中化作了齑粉。
quote.en_US: Outcast: You will face final judgment here. Six bullets fired simultaneously from her revolver. Six enemies rushed at her—all actions stopped at the start. No screams, no one fell, they all turned to dust in sacred light.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Outcast以六发子弹同时射击的方式将深池六名干部全部消灭，体现了她作为审判者的绝对力量与坚定意志，最终她也化作灰烬，完成了自己的审判之路。
context_analysis.en_US: Outcast eliminates all six Deeppool cadres with six simultaneous shots, embodying her absolute power and resolve as judge. She too turns to ash, completing her path of judgment.

relation_label.zh_CN: 审判者与被审判者（六人）

description.zh_CN: Outcast以六发子弹同时射击，将深池六名干部全部击杀。
description.en_US: Outcast shoots six bullets simultaneously, eliminating all six Deeppool cadres.

quote.zh_CN: Outcast：你们将在这里迎来最终的审判。六发子弹从她的左轮中同时射出。
quote.en_US: Outcast: You will face final judgment here. Six bullets fired simultaneously from her revolver.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Outcast在生命最后时刻完成对深池六名干部的审判，以自己的生命为代价保护了重伤的深池领袖（拉芙希妮）。
context_analysis.en_US: Outcast completes her final judgment against the six Deeppool cadres at the cost of her own life, protecting the critically injured Deeppool leader (Lafcine).

description.zh_CN: 克雷格是塔拉族孩子，母亲在十七区小巷卖苹果。父亲因矿石病去世，克雷格被其他士兵疏远，但他始终紧握着父亲留下的球，简妮给予了他温暖。
description.en_US: Craig is a Talar child whose mother sells apples in the 17th district alley. His father died of Oripathy, and Craig is avoided by other soldiers, but he clings to the ball his father left him. Jeanne shows him warmth.

quote.zh_CN: 克雷格：你……你会打我吗？简妮：我为什么要打你呀？克雷格：……你的衣服脏了。
quote.en_US: Craig: You... you're not going to hit me? Jeanne: Why would I hit you? Craig: ...Your clothes are dirty.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 克雷格因为父亲是矿石病患者去世，被其他维多利亚士兵疏远，见到简妮时下意识害怕挨打，展现出塔拉族孩子所受的歧视创伤。
context_analysis.en_US: Craig, whose father died of Oripathy, is avoided by other Victorian soldiers. When meeting Jeanne, he instinctively fears being beaten, showing the discrimination trauma Talar children suffer.

quote.zh_CN: 干员碎纸机：他父亲去世了，半年前。可怜人，得了矿石病。很多人，因为这个，不敢碰他。
quote.en_US: Paper Shredder: His father died, half a year ago. Poor man, contracted Oripathy. Many people, because of this, don't dare touch him.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 碎纸机告知简妮克雷格父亲去世的消息，而简妮并未因此疏远克雷格，反而用温柔对待他。
context_analysis.en_US: Paper Shredder tells Jeanne about Craig's father's death, but Jeanne doesn't avoid Craig—she treats him with warmth instead.

description.zh_CN: 深池六名干部（会计、囚犯、纵火家、毒药学者、强盗、雄辩家）追捕被Outcast救走的深池领袖，最终被Outcast六发子弹全部击杀。
description.en_US: The six Deeppool cadres (Accountant, Prisoner, Arsonist, Poison Scholar, Robber, Orator) pursue the Deeppool leader rescued by Outcast, ultimately all killed by Outcast's six bullets.

quote.zh_CN: Outcast：你们将在这里迎来最终的审判。六发子弹从她的左轮中同时射出。
quote.en_US: Outcast: You will face final judgment here. Six bullets fired simultaneously from her revolver.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Outcast以六发子弹同时射击，将深池六名干部全部消灭，体现了她作为审判者的绝对力量与坚定意志，最终她也化作灰烬，完成了自己的审判之路。
context_analysis.en_US: Outcast eliminates all six Deeppool cadres with six simultaneous shots, embodying her absolute power and resolve as judge. She too turns to ash, completing her path of judgment.

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与推进之王在伦蒂尼姆地下通道中并肩作战，共同对抗萨卡兹侵略者。
description.en_US: Amiya and Siege fight side by side in the tunnels of Londinium against the Sarkaz invaders.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：我明白。费斯特先生，我们会跟你走。正好，我也想见见你们的指挥官。
quote.en_US: Amiya: I understand. Mr. Fist, we'll follow you. And I'd like to meet your commander too.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王认可阿米娅的指挥，阿米娅表示愿与推进之王并肩同行
context_analysis.en_US: Siege acknowledges Amiya's leadership; Amiya expresses willingness to walk alongside Siege

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：阿米娅，我们也上去！
quote.en_US: Siege: Amiya, we're going up too!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 列车撤离时，推进之王与阿米娅一同登车撤离
context_analysis.en_US: During evacuation, Siege and Amiya board the train together to escape

description.zh_CN: 因陀罗是格拉斯哥帮的核心成员，追随推进之王多年，在伦蒂尼姆地下管道中与推进之王一同行动，互相守护。
description.en_US: Indra is a core member of Glasgow who has followed Siege for years, fighting alongside her in Londinium's tunnels.

quote.zh_CN: 因陀罗：维娜，你怎么了？
quote.en_US: Indra: Vina, what's wrong?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗关心推进之王的状态，在地下管道中始终跟随她
context_analysis.en_US: Indra cares about Siege's condition and follows her throughout the tunnels

quote.zh_CN: 因陀罗：只要一闭眼，我眼前就都是当时我们一路逃出来时的事。如果遇到危险，我应该和她们在一起……不，我理应挡在她们身前。
quote.en_US: Indra: Once I close my eyes, all I see is us fleeing back then. If there's danger, I should be with them... No, I should stand in front of them.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗表达对推进之王的保护欲，誓要挡在她身前
context_analysis.en_US: Indra expresses her protective instinct toward Siege, vowing to shield her

description.zh_CN: 摩根是格拉斯哥帮的智囊，被推进之王戏称为帮派的大脑。在伦蒂尼姆地下撤退时，摩根一直陪伴在推进之王身边，协助指挥战斗。
description.en_US: Morgan is Glasgow's strategist, jokingly called the 'brain of the gang' by Siege. During the Londinium retreat, Morgan stays by Siege's side assisting with tactical command.

quote.zh_CN: 摩根：维娜，要不要趁她们不在，我们两个偷偷溜回家算了？毕竟你看，她俩就只会打打杀杀，只有我最有脑子，也最靠得住嘛。
quote.en_US: Morgan: Vina, want to sneak away just the two of us? I mean, those two only know how to fight — only I have the brains and can be relied on.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 摩根以玩笑方式表达与推进之王的亲密关系，自诩为帮派中最有头脑的人
context_analysis.en_US: Morgan jokingly expresses closeness to Siege, claiming to be the most intelligent member of the gang

quote.zh_CN: 摩根：维娜，我还没说完……你们害得我就连在被追杀的时候，都还惦记着达格达会不会又去了哪个犄角旮旯，准备着和萨卡兹同归于尽！
quote.en_US: Morgan: Vina, I still haven't finished... You made me worry about whether Dagda might go to some corner to blow herself up with the Sarkaz even when we were being hunted!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 摩根在逃亡途中仍惦记推进之王身边人的安危，展现战友间的深厚情感
context_analysis.en_US: During the escape, Morgan still worries about those close to Siege, showing deep camaraderie

description.zh_CN: 达格达原为伦蒂尼姆塔楼骑士，因萨卡兹入侵而流亡，随格拉斯哥帮一同行动。在ch10中，达格达选择离开地下，联络贵族援军，最终及时归来与推进之王重逢。
description.en_US: Dagda was a Tower Knight of Londinium who fled when the Sarkaz invaded. She joined Glasgow and later chose to leave the underground to contact noble reinforcements, returning just in time to reunite with Siege.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：达格达，我会等你做出选择。
quote.en_US: Siege: Dagda, I will wait for your choice.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王尊重达格达的选择自由，给予她决定是否离开团队去找贵族故友的时间和空间
context_analysis.en_US: Siege respects Dagda's freedom of choice, giving her time and space to decide whether to leave to contact noble contacts

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：不，你没有迟到。对我们来说，你什么时候回来，都不算迟到。
quote.en_US: Siege: No, you didn't arrive late. For us, it's never late when you return.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达带着援军归来，推进之王表示无论何时她回来都不算迟到
context_analysis.en_US: When Dagda returns with reinforcements, Siege declares it's never too late for her to return

quote.zh_CN: 达格达：以后都不会了。我发誓。
quote.en_US: Dagda: Never again. I swear.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达发誓以后不会再离开，推进之王终于与所有战友团聚
context_analysis.en_US: Dagda swears never to leave again; Siege is finally reunited with all her comrades

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与博士在伦蒂尼姆地下通道中并肩作战，相互信任。阿米娅在面对强大敌人和情感冲击时，感受到博士的陪伴给她勇气。
description.en_US: Amiya and the Doctor fight side by side in the tunnels of Londinium, with mutual trust. Amiya draws courage from the Doctor's presence when facing powerful enemies and emotional turmoil.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：博士……谢谢你，博士……仅仅只是感觉到你在身边，我就有了走下去的勇气。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Thank you, Doctor... Just feeling you by my side gives me the courage to keep going.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅向博士表达信任和依赖，感觉到博士在身边就获得了勇气
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya expresses trust and dependence on the Doctor, feeling his presence gives her courage

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：和你相处，我总是这么容易就放松下来……也许是因为……就连你得知真相的这一刻，当你看着我的时候，你的眼里依然只是我这个叫'推进之王'的干员……而不是……维多利亚。
quote.en_US: Siege: Being with you always puts me at ease... Perhaps because even now, when you know the truth, your eyes still see only me — Siege — not Victoria.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王对博士坦诚身份后，博士依然以平常心对待她，让她感到放松
context_analysis.en_US: After Siege reveals her identity to the Doctor, his unchanged attitude toward her puts her at ease

relation_label.zh_CN: 罗德岛核心·导师与继承者

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希通过通讯指导阿米娅在伦蒂尼姆的行动，提供关键情报和建议。阿米娅感受到来自凯尔希的关心和压力。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit guides Amiya through communication during the Londinium operation, providing crucial intelligence and advice. Amiya feels both care and pressure from Kal'tsit.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希：博士……无论你们在伦蒂尼姆看见什么，请和阿米娅一起面对。我知道你能做到。
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit: Doctor... whatever you see in Londinium, face it together with Amiya. I know you can do it.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希托付博士照顾阿米娅，在行动前给予信任和期望
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit entrusts the Doctor to take care of Amiya, showing trust and expectations before the operation

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：凯尔希医生说可以由她开口，但我决定自己告诉你。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Dr. Kal'tsit said she could be the one to tell you, but I decided to tell you myself.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅独自向推进之王解释身份问题，展现独立决策能力
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya independently decides to explain identity matters to Siege, showing her independent decision-making

relation_label.zh_CN: 罗德岛盟友·信任与合作

description.zh_CN: 海蒂是罗德岛在伦蒂尼姆的秘密信使，与自救军有联系。在制醇厂营救行动中，阿米娅与海蒂首次见面并成功合作。
description.en_US: Heidi is Rhodes Island's secret messenger in Londinium, connected to the Self-Rescue Army. During the refinery rescue operation, Amiya meets and successfully cooperates with Heidi.

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂：各位，晚上好。自救军的朋友，还有……未曾谋面的罗德岛的朋友。各位晚上好。
quote.en_US: Heidi: Good evening, everyone. Friends of the Self-Rescue Army, and... friends of Rhodes Island whom I've never met before. Good evening.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 海蒂在制醇厂首次与阿米娅正式会面，双方确认合作
context_analysis.en_US: Heidi officially meets Amiya for the first time at the refinery; both sides confirm cooperation

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂：阿米娅……凯尔希教会了我许多……是的，甚至包括如何战斗。
quote.en_US: Heidi: Amiya... Kal'tsit taught me a lot... yes, even including how to fight.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 海蒂透露凯尔希是她的导师，确认她与罗德岛的深层联系
context_analysis.en_US: Heidi reveals Kal'tsit is her mentor, confirming her deep connection to Rhodes Island

description.zh_CN: W是萨卡兹雇佣兵，在制醇厂战斗中协助罗德岛和自救军撤离。她与凯尔希有联系，被派来营救海蒂。
description.en_US: W is a Sarkaz mercenary who assists Rhodes Island and the Self-Rescue Army during the refinery battle. She has ties with Kal'tsit and was sent to rescue Heidi.

quote.zh_CN: W：小兔子，带上你的那个兜帽怪物，我们是时候——呃，你们愣着做什么？
quote.en_US: W: Little bunny, take your hooded monster — we're going — err, why are you all standing there?

context_analysis.zh_CN: W协助阿米娅和博士撤离，在战斗中使用炸弹掩护
context_analysis.en_US: W assists Amiya and the Doctor in evacuating, using bombs to cover their retreat

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：W小姐，我们还有许多信息没有同步。我们得先撤退……W，不要出事。我们会等你。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Ms. W, we still have much information to sync. We need to retreat first... W, don't get yourself killed. We'll wait for you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅对W表达关心和信任，等她一同撤离
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya expresses concern and trust for W, waiting for her to evacuate together

description.zh_CN: 海蒂是凯尔希的学生，受凯尔希之命在伦蒂尼姆活动，并被W营救。在制醇厂，她透露凯尔希教会了她战斗的技能。
description.en_US: Heidi is a student of Kal'tsit, operating in Londinium on Kal'tsit's orders, and was rescued by W. At the refinery, she reveals Kal'tsit taught her how to fight.

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂：是凯尔希让你来的？
quote.en_US: Heidi: Did Kal'tsit send you?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 海蒂询问W是否受凯尔希之命，确认与罗德岛的从属关系
context_analysis.en_US: Heidi asks if W was sent by Kal'tsit, confirming her subordination to Rhodes Island

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂：凯尔希教会了我许多……是的，甚至包括如何战斗。很可惜，我并不算她最好的学生。一直以来，我能帮到她的很有限。
quote.en_US: Heidi: Kal'tsit taught me a lot... yes, even including how to fight. Unfortunately, I'm not her best student. I've always been able to help her only so much.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 海蒂承认自己是凯尔希的学生，但自谦并非好学生
context_analysis.en_US: Heidi admits she is a student of Kal'tsit but downplays her own abilities

description.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德是萨卡兹摄政王特雷西斯的将军，在伦蒂尼姆指挥城防炮攻击反抗军。阿米娅在城墙上与曼弗雷德正面对决，试图阻止城防炮攻击。
description.en_US: Manfred is General of the Regent Therbeni, commanding Londinium's defense cannons against the resistance. Amiya confronts Manfred directly on the city wall, attempting to stop the artillery bombardment.

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德：不必妄自菲薄，维多利亚的白狼。你在我们萨卡兹之中，也称得上是一名英勇的战士。
quote.en_US: Manfred: No need for false modesty, white wolf of Victoria. Even among the Sarkaz, you qualify as a valiant warrior.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德对号角的表现给予认可，但在城墙上继续与反抗军交战
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred acknowledges B雕's performance, but continues fighting the resistance on the wall

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德：你想用这种剑就想与我战斗？
quote.en_US: Manfred: You think you can fight me with that sword?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德在城墙上用源石技艺攻击阿米娅，试图捕获她献给特雷西斯
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred uses Arts on the wall to attack Amiya, attempting to capture her for Therbeni

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：而我会踏碎你的牢笼！
quote.en_US: Amiya: And I will shatter your cage!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅反击曼弗雷德，展现对抗到底的决心
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya counterattacks Manfred, showing her determination to fight to the end

relation_label.zh_CN: 战场宿敌·前巴别塔雇佣兵

description.zh_CN: 赫德雷是萨卡兹雇佣兵，曾为巴别塔工作，现在为曼弗雷德效力。在制醇厂战斗中，他追捕罗德岛成员，在城墙上与阿米娅交战。
description.en_US: Hechter is a Sarkaz mercenary who worked for Babel and now serves Manfred. During the refinery battle, he hunts Rhodes Island members, fighting Amiya on the city wall.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：赫德雷。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Hechter.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅在城墙上认出赫德雷，确认其为敌人
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya recognizes Hechter on the city wall, confirming him as an enemy

quote.zh_CN: 赫德雷：又见面了，罗德岛的领导人。
quote.en_US: Hechter: We meet again, leader of Rhodes Island.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 赫德雷与阿米娅在城墙上对峙，延续战场敌对关系
context_analysis.en_US: Hechter faces Amiya on the wall, continuing their battlefield antagonism

description.zh_CN: 蔓德拉是深池术师，在出入口岸与罗德岛冲突，后被曼弗雷德的部队歼灭。她是小丘郡事件的始作俑者，罗德岛干员对她抱有强烈敌意。
description.en_US: Mandrag is a Deep Pool mage who clashed with Rhodes Island at the port, later destroyed by Manfred's forces. She was one of the instigators of the《小丘郡事件; Rhodes Island operators hold strong hostility toward her.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：根据Misery的消息和风笛的报告，她就是伦蒂尼姆这支深池部队的头目……也是小丘郡事件的始作俑者之一。
quote.en_US: Amiya: According to Misery's intel and Breeze's report, she's the commander of the Deep Pool forces in Londinium... and one of the instigators of the《小丘郡事件.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅向博士介绍蔓德拉的身份和敌意来源
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya introduces Mandrag's identity and the source of her enmity to the Doctor

description.zh_CN: W与赫德雷都是萨卡兹雇佣兵，曾在整合运动时期共事。在制醇厂战斗中，W与赫德雷激烈交战，赫德雷重伤W。
description.en_US: Both W and Hechter are Sarkaz mercenaries who worked together during the Reunion Movement. During the refinery battle, W and Hechter fight intensely; Hechter critically wounds W.

quote.zh_CN: W：施瓦布的脑袋远远不够格。你还加了多少码？呃，你该不会是把她……赫德雷：别说这样的话。W：我才不……赫德雷：是的，她死了。
quote.en_US: W: Schwarz's head is far from enough. What else did you add? Err, you wouldn't have... Hechter: Don't say such things. W: I wouldn't... Hechter: Yes, she's dead.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W与赫德雷对峙，得知伊内丝的死讯，两人曾是共事的雇佣兵
context_analysis.en_US: W and Hechter confront each other; W learns of Ines' death — they were fellow mercenaries

quote.zh_CN: W：你知道杀不掉我了，对吧？你当过我的头儿，我也当过你的头儿，可是这里有一个人，她当过我们俩的头儿。
quote.en_US: W: You know you can't kill me, right? You were my leader once, and I was yours too, but there's someone who was leader to both of us.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W揭示她与赫德雷曾是雇佣兵搭档，共同效忠于特蕾西娅（巴别塔时期）
context_analysis.en_US: W reveals she and Hechter were mercenary partners, both serving Theresa (during Babel)

quote.zh_CN: W：所以，干脆点走出来，我顺便答应让你的尸体完整一些，不好吗？……恭喜你，你惹到我了。
quote.en_US: W: So come out already, and I'll even promise to keep your corpse intact, okay? ...Congratulations, you've really angered me.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W与赫德雷在制醇厂激战，赫德雷重伤W后被阿斯卡纶阻止
context_analysis.en_US: W battles Hechter at the refinery; Hechter critically wounds W before Ascalon intervenes

description.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶是巴别塔时期的刺客，救下了被赫德雷重伤的W。她用匕首阻止赫德雷杀死W，展现了前同事之间的默契。
description.en_US: Ascalon was an assassin during the Babel era who saved the critically wounded W. She stopped Hechter from killing W with daggers, showing the默契 of former colleagues.

quote.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶：别动。赫德雷：我的剑……被挡下了？那是……匕首？从哪里飞过来的匕首？
quote.en_US: Ascalon: Don't move. Hechter: My sword... was blocked? That was... a dagger? From where did that dagger fly?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶用匕首挡住赫德雷的剑，救下濒死的W
context_analysis.en_US: Ascalon blocks Hechter's sword with a dagger, saving the dying W

quote.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶：W，你每多说一句话，血就会流得更快一些。
quote.en_US: Ascalon: W, every word you say makes you bleed faster.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶关心W的伤势，警告她少说话
context_analysis.en_US: Ascalon shows concern for W's injuries, warning her to speak less

description.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶阻止赫德雷杀死W，两人之间存在对抗关系。赫德雷称阿斯卡纶的出现让他无法完成杀死W的任务。
description.en_US: Ascalon prevents Hechter from killing W; there is antagonism between them. Hechter says Ascalon's appearance prevents him from completing the mission to kill W.

quote.zh_CN: 赫德雷：阿斯卡纶……你知道我们俩的人头在下一刻都可能落地。
quote.en_US: Hechter: Ascalon... you know both our heads could roll at any moment.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 赫德雷承认阿斯卡纶的出现让他无法完成杀死W的任务
context_analysis.en_US: Hechter admits Ascalon's appearance prevents him from completing his mission to kill W

description.zh_CN: Misery是罗德岛精英干员，在伦蒂尼姆地下使用空间源石技艺帮助众人逃脱，包括营救号角和阻挡曼弗雷德。
description.en_US: Misery is a Rhodes Island elite operator who uses spatial Arts in the Londinium underground to help everyone escape, including rescuing B雕 and blocking Manfred.

quote.zh_CN: 号角：您到底是谁？Misery：Misery。我是罗德岛的Misery。
quote.en_US: B雕: Who are you? Misery: Misery. I am Rhodes Island's Misery.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Misery向号角表明身份，确认自己是罗德岛的干员
context_analysis.en_US: Misery identifies herself to B雕, confirming she is a Rhodes Island operator

quote.zh_CN: Misery：快回去。不，转告博士和阿米娅，地下也不安全。
quote.en_US: Misery: Go back quickly. No, tell the Doctor and Amiya, the underground is not safe either.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Misery提醒众人地下也不安全，展现对同伴的关心
context_analysis.en_US: Misery warns everyone the underground isn't safe, showing concern for comrades

description.zh_CN: 食腐者之王（萨卡兹王庭之一）在伦蒂尼姆地下通道追捕推进之王等人，吞噬了十二队的战士们。号角和推进之王必须与他对抗。
description.en_US: The Warl of the Feast (a Sarkaz king) hunts Siege and others through Londinium's underground tunnels, devouring Team 12's soldiers. B雕 and Siege must fight against him.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：这脉搏声消失了……跑！！！
quote.en_US: Siege: That pulse is gone... RUN!!!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王感知到食腐者之王的存在，警告众人逃跑
context_analysis.en_US: Siege senses the Warl's presence and warns everyone to flee

quote.zh_CN: 血魔大君：那个截然不同的味道……有趣……特雷西斯知道这件事吗？你不会有机会追上去确认的。
quote.en_US: The Blood Demon: That distinctly different scent... interesting... Does Therbeni know about this? You won't get the chance to confirm it.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 食腐者之王追踪推进之王的气味，被Logos等人阻止
context_analysis.en_US: The Warl tracks Siege's scent but is blocked by Logos and others

description.zh_CN: 达格达在离开地下后，带着贵族援军及时归来，与推进之王在列车站台上重逢。
description.en_US: After leaving the underground, Dagda returns in time with noble reinforcements, reuniting with Siege at the train platform.

quote.zh_CN: 达格达：我……我很怕自己迟到。推进之王：不，你没有迟到。对我们来说，你什么时候回来，都不算迟到。
quote.en_US: Dagda: I... I'm very afraid I was late. Siege: No, you weren't late. For us, it's never late when you return.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达带着援军归来，推进之王表示欢迎
context_analysis.en_US: Dagda returns with reinforcements; Siege welcomes her

quote.zh_CN: 因陀罗：混蛋，你……你走的时候那么干脆，我都来不及揍你！达格达：嗯……现在揍也不算太晚。
quote.en_US: Indra: Damn it, you left so abruptly, I didn't even have time to beat you up! Dagda: Well... it's not too late to hit me now.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 格拉斯哥帮成员以打闹方式表达重逢的喜悦
context_analysis.en_US: Glasgow members express joy at reunion through playful fighting

relation_label.zh_CN: 伦蒂尼姆继承者与侵略者

description.zh_CN: 推进之王是伦蒂尼姆王室的继承人，曼弗雷德是萨卡兹军队的将军。推进之王回到伦蒂尼姆，收复故土是她与格拉斯哥帮的使命。
description.en_US: Siege is heir to the Londinium royal family; Manfred is the Sarkaz army's general. Siege's return to Londinium and reclaiming her homeland is the mission of her and Glasgow.

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德：没想到，除了阿斯卡纶，罗德岛还有一位顶尖的萨卡兹刺客。曼弗雷德：差一点点。
quote.en_US: Manfred: Unexpectedly, besides Ascalon, Rhodes Island has another top-tier Sarkaz assassin. Manfred: Almost.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德承认几乎抓住推进之王，展现战场上的对抗
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred admits he almost captured Siege, showing their battlefield confrontation

description.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德质疑阿米娅是否有资格号令萨卡兹战士，阿米娅反驳他的观点。两人在城墙上激战，同时进行激烈的理念交锋。
description.en_US: Manfred questions Amiya's right to command Sarkaz warriors; Amiya retorts his views. They battle on the wall while engaging in heated ideological confrontation.

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德：卡特斯，你太自负了？你不过就是一个感染者，你从来没有体验过真正属于萨卡兹的人生。仅仅是在一旁看着，你凭什么认为自己真的能理解我们的痛苦与愤恨？！
quote.en_US: Manfred: You are too arrogant, Ceth. You're just an Infected. You've never experienced what it truly means to be Sarkaz. How can you, merely watching from the sidelines, claim to truly understand our pain and fury?!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德质问阿米娅是否有资格理解萨卡兹的痛苦与愤怒
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred questions whether Amiya has the right to understand Sarkaz pain and fury

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：是的，也许我不理解。但是……烧在你们心中的那把火，它从遥远的过去一直烧到现在，从最初的卡兹戴尔烧到如今的伦蒂尼姆，至今也仍在我心中。那是滚烫的。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Yes, perhaps I don't understand. But... the fire burning in your hearts — it has burned since ancient times, from the original Kazdel to today's Londinium — it still burns within me. It is scorching hot.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅承认不理解萨卡兹的历史，但表示同样的火焰也在她心中燃烧
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya admits she doesn't understand Sarkaz history, but declares the same fire burns in her heart

description.zh_CN: 费斯特在城墙上与曼弗雷德交战，利用赫德雷的攻击造成的裂缝成功逃脱。费斯特的工匠技能在战斗中发挥了关键作用。
description.en_US: Fist fights Manfred on the city wall, using the crack caused by Hechter's attack to escape. Fist's engineering skills play a crucial role in the battle.

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特：来啊，萨卡兹，朝我砍过来！用上你的剑，你的刀，你所有的武器——
quote.en_US: Fist: Come on, Sarkaz, swing at me! Use your sword, your blade, all your weapons—

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特故意引诱赫德雷攻击，利用他的攻击破坏结构层为阿米娅和博士开路
context_analysis.en_US: Fist deliberately lures Hechter's attack, using his strikes to break through structural layers for Amiya and the Doctor

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特：麻烦更用力一些！赫德雷：又是烟雾弹？费斯特：你砍向我的每一刀，都是通往你们失败的道路！
quote.en_US: Fist: Hit harder, please! Hechter: Another smoke bomb? Fist: Every sword swing of yours is a path toward your defeat!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特利用赫德雷的攻击，牺牲自己为同伴争取机会
context_analysis.en_US: Fist uses Hechter's attacks to sacrifice himself for his comrades

description.zh_CN: 号角在城墙上与曼弗雷德进行最后的战斗，用剑与盾抵挡曼弗雷德的攻击，为罗德岛和自救军的撤离争取时间。
description.en_US: B雕 fights her final battle against Manfred on the city wall, using sword and shield to withstand his attacks and buy time for Rhodes Island and the Self-Rescue Army to evacuate.

quote.zh_CN: 号角：留在我耳朵里的死者的话语并不比你能听见的少。而且……我答应他们了。在看到我的人活着离开之前，我一定不会倒下。
quote.en_US: B雕: The voices of the dead in my ears are no fewer than what you can hear. And... I promised them. Until I see my people escape alive, I will never fall.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角表明战斗意志，在城墙上独自面对曼弗雷德
context_analysis.en_US: B雕 declares her fighting will, facing Manfred alone on the wall

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德：下次见面，我会用我的剑为你送去……配得上你的英勇的死亡。号角：下次……还会有下一次吗？
quote.en_US: Manfred: Next time we meet, I will send you... a death befitting your valor. B雕: Next time... will there even be a next time?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德承认号角是可敬的对手，但号角能否活到下次成了疑问
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred acknowledges B雕 as a formidable opponent, but whether she will survive becomes uncertain

description.zh_CN: Misery用空间源石技艺救了从城墙上坠落的号角，将她从高处拉回安全地带。
description.en_US: Misery uses spatial Arts to rescue the falling B雕 from the city wall, pulling her back to safety from great height.

quote.zh_CN: 号角：这面墙……到底有多高？为什么我好像……在往上飞？罗本：是Misery先生救了您！
quote.en_US: B雕: How high is this wall? Why does it seem like I'm... flying upward? Robben: Mr. Misery saved you!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角从城墙上坠落时被Misery救起
context_analysis.en_US: B雕 is saved by Misery when falling from the wall

relation_label.zh_CN: 伦蒂尼姆继承者与侵略者

description.zh_CN: 推进之王向博士坦白了自己的真实身份——维娜·维多利亚，伦蒂尼姆王室的继承人。她回到伦蒂尼姆是为了夺回家园。
description.en_US: Siege reveals her true identity to the Doctor — Vina Victoria, heir to the Londinium royal family. She returns to Londinium to reclaim her homeland.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：博士……我的姓氏……维多利亚？你的表情……好平静。
quote.en_US: Siege: Doctor... my surname... Victoria? Your expression... is so calm.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王向博士坦白身份，博士平静地接受了这个信息
context_analysis.en_US: Siege reveals her identity to the Doctor; the Doctor calmly accepts this information

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：我不想再看见她被推着走。她需要接纳自己的内心，然后坚定日后的道路。
quote.en_US: Siege: I don't want to see her being pushed anymore. She needs to accept her inner self, then walk her path firmly.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王谈论达格达时也暗示了自己的处境——被身份束缚，需要自己做出选择
context_analysis.en_US: When discussing Dagda, Siege also hints at her own situation — bound by identity, needing to make her own choices

relation_label.zh_CN: 继承者与侵略者的正面对决

description.zh_CN: 推进之王在地下通道中找到王宫逃生密道的开关，展现了她作为王室继承人的身份。血魔大君追踪她，认为她与维多利亚王室的联系'有趣'。
description.en_US: Siege finds the palace escape route switch in the underground, demonstrating her identity as royal heir. The Blood Demon tracks her, finding her connection to the Victoria royal family 'interesting'.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：三岁那年，她第一次被带到王宫地下。她的老师驮着她，用巨掌引着她按下了这个按钮。二十多年后——她第二次见到了它。
quote.en_US: Siege: At age three, she was first brought to the palace underground. Her teacher carried her and guided her hand to press this button. Twenty-plus years later — she sees it again.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王找到逃生密道按钮，证明她的王室血统
context_analysis.en_US: Siege finds the escape route button, proving her royal bloodline

description.zh_CN: 费斯特是自救军队长，洛洛是副队长。费斯特在制醇厂战斗中失去了强尼和加比，但他承诺会救出比尔。洛洛在战斗中受伤但坚持行动。
description.en_US: Fist is the Self-Rescue Army team leader; Lolo is his deputy. Fist lost Jonny and Gabby at the refinery but promised to rescue Bill. Lolo is injured in combat but persists.

quote.zh_CN: 洛洛：比尔在我们手上。他是为了掩护我……我不能在他生死未卜的情况下，只顾自己躺着。费斯特：我会救他回来。洛洛，我保证。
quote.en_US: Lolo: Bill is in their hands. He did it to cover me... I can't just lie here while his life is uncertain. Fist: I'll bring him back. I promise, Lolo.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特向洛洛承诺会救出比尔，展现队长的责任感
context_analysis.en_US: Fist promises Lolo he will rescue Bill, showing the team leader's sense of responsibility

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特：哈……老比尔，你看到了吗？我……洛洛：不，别想偷懒晕过去！战斗还没结束！
quote.en_US: Fist: Ha... Old Bill, did you see? I... Lolo: Don't even think about slacking off and passing out! The fight isn't over!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特想哀悼比尔，洛洛阻止他继续战斗
context_analysis.en_US: Fist wants to mourn Bill; Lolo stops him, pushing him to keep fighting

description.zh_CN: 特蕾西娅是萨卡兹的先代魔王，阿米娅继承了她的力量。在伦蒂尼姆，特蕾西娅的影像/精神出现，萨卡兹们叫她'殿下'。
description.en_US: Theresa is the past Demon King of the Sarkaz; Amiya inherited her power. In Londinium, Theresa's image/spirit appears, and Sarkaz call her 'Your Highness'.

quote.zh_CN: 一个萨卡兹走进了废墟里……她仿佛并不介意，只是静静地注视着一处残垣……她的面庞是那样温和，她的眼睛里却映满了悲哀。
quote.en_US: A Sarkaz walks into the ruins... she seems unbothered, silently gazing at some debris... her face is so gentle, yet her eyes are full of sorrow.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 特蕾西娅的白发萨卡兹身影出现在战场废墟中，萨卡兹们纷纷停下脚步注视
context_analysis.en_US: Theresa's white-haired Sarkaz figure appears in the battlefield ruins; all Sarkaz stop to watch

relation_label.zh_CN: 萨卡兹旧识·伦蒂尼姆对峙

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希与食腐者之王在伦蒂尼姆外的废弃矿场相遇，两人曾是萨卡兹的旧识。食腐者之王询问杀死博卓卡斯替的凶手，凯尔希拒绝与其战斗。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit meets the Warl of the Feast at a abandoned mine outside Londinium; the two are old Sarkaz acquaintances. The Warl asks about who killed Patriot; Kal'tsit refuses to fight him.

quote.zh_CN: 样貌奇特的老者：告诉我——杀死了最后一只纯血温迪戈的，是什麼？凯尔希：……博卓卡斯替……在最后的时刻，他想要一位相称的对手，也想要一位能够对话的故友。
quote.en_US: Elder-looking figure: Tell me — what killed the last pureblood Widgel? Kal'tsit: ...Patriot... in his final moments, he wanted a worthy opponent, and a friend he could talk to.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 食腐者之王追问爱国者的死，凯尔希以'故友'身份回答
context_analysis.en_US: The Warl asks about Patriot's death; Kal'tsit answers as an 'old friend'

quote.zh_CN: 样貌奇特的老者：特立的勋爵，我们伦蒂尼姆见。
quote.en_US: Elder-looking figure: The unaging lord, we shall meet in Londinium.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 食腐者之王放走凯尔希，相约伦蒂尼姆再见
context_analysis.en_US: The Warl lets Kal'tsit go, saying they'll meet again in Londinium

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希在伦蒂尼姆城外527公里处与华法琳、闪灵在一起，她通过W营救海蒂，并派遣Misery和Logos先行进入伦蒂尼姆。
description.en_US: Kal'tsit is with Closure and Silence at a point 527km outside Londinium; she rescues Heidi through W and sends Misery and Logos ahead into Londinium.

quote.zh_CN: W：好啦，别不情不愿的，才刚见面而已，你又没那么喜欢{@nickname}。要不是因为那个老女人……唔，就是你最喜欢的那一个，她要我来找你，我也不想来啊。
quote.en_US: W: Come on, don't be reluctant. We just met and you don't even like {@nickname} that much. If it weren't for that old woman... the one you like best, telling me to find you, I wouldn't have come either.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W透露是凯尔希（那个老女人）派她来救海蒂的
context_analysis.en_US: W reveals it was Kal'tsit (that old woman) who sent her to rescue Heidi

relation_label.zh_CN: 前巴别塔成员·雇佣兵旧情

description.zh_CN: W与赫德雷都曾是巴别塔的成员，共同效忠于特蕾西娅。在整合运动时期，W带着雇佣兵离开，赫德雷留下为特雷西斯效力。
description.en_US: Both W and Hechter were members of Babel, serving Theresa together. During the Reunion Movement, W took mercenaries and left; Hechter stayed to serve Therbeni.

quote.zh_CN: W：你当过我的头儿，我也当过你的头儿，可是这里有一个人，她当过我们俩的头儿。
quote.en_US: W: You were my leader once, and I was yours too, but there's someone who was leader to both of us.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W揭示她与赫德雷都曾效忠于特蕾西娅
context_analysis.en_US: W reveals both she and Hechter served Theresa

quote.zh_CN: W：我早就想问了，记住这些死掉的人，会让你更安心一些吗？赫德雷：你很为他们着想。
quote.en_US: W: I've been meaning to ask — does remembering all these dead people make you feel more at ease? Hechter: You care a lot about them.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W与赫德雷讨论过去的雇佣兵同伴，两人曾是共事的关系
context_analysis.en_US: W and Hechter discuss their past mercenary comrades; they were once colleagues

description.zh_CN: 食腐者之王与血魔大君都是萨卡兹王庭的成员，在伦蒂尼姆各自行动。食腐者之王在地下追捕推进之王，血魔大君在地面搜索'魔王'。
description.en_US: Both the Warl and the Blood Demon are members of the Sarkaz Court, acting separately in Londinium. The Warl hunts Siege underground; the Blood Demon searches for the 'Demon King' on the surface.

quote.zh_CN: 可露希尔：万一……万一你们撞见另一个血魔，跑，赶紧跑！在撞见他们的那一刻，你们也许已经没机会了。
quote.en_US: Closure: If... if you encounter another blood demon, run, run quickly! The moment you encounter them, you might already be out of time.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 可露希尔警告众人关于血魔大君的危险
context_analysis.en_US: Closure warns everyone about the Blood Demon's danger

quote.zh_CN: 食腐者之王：这个截然不同的味道……有趣……特雷西斯知道这件事吗？
quote.en_US: The Warl: That distinctly different scent... interesting... Does Therbeni know about this?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 食腐者之王追踪推进之王的气味，暗示萨卡兹王庭之间的信息差
context_analysis.en_US: The Warl tracks Siege's scent, hinting at information gaps between Sarkaz Court members

description.zh_CN: 推进之王、摩根、因陀罗、达格达组成的格拉斯哥帮小组，在地下管道中历经艰险，最终在列车站台上全员重逢。
description.en_US: The Glasgow team — Siege, Morgan, Indra, and Dagda — endure hardships in the underground tunnels, finally reuniting at the train platform.

quote.zh_CN: 因陀罗：我们得跟紧一点，要不然架都被她一个人打完了。
quote.en_US: Indra: We need to follow closely, otherwise she'll finish all the fights by herself.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗评价达格达冲在最前面打敌人的习惯
context_analysis.en_US: Indra comments on Dagda's habit of charging ahead to fight enemies

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王：推进之王小组，全体集合。只要等到博士他们回来，我们就能一起离开这里。
quote.en_US: Siege: Siege Squad, assemble. As long as we wait for the Doctor and the others to return, we can all leave together.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王召集格拉斯哥帮成员，准备全员撤离
context_analysis.en_US: Siege gathers the Glasgow members, preparing for group evacuation

description.zh_CN: 亚历山德莉娜（推进之王/维娜）与阿勒黛命运重逢，两人并肩对抗萨卡兹。自幼相识于坎伯兰公爵府，重逢后在自救军中再度并肩作战。
description.en_US: Alexandrina (Siege/Vina) and Aleda reunite after fate separated them as children, fighting side by side against the Sankazi in the Lungmen Self-Rescue Army.

quote.zh_CN: 维娜，你可以不用管这件事。这是殿下的命令吗？我没有资格命令你，你才是自救军奥克特里格区负责人。……但是......请给我一点时间。我会想办法解决。
quote.en_US: Vina, you don't have to bother with this. Is this an order from Her Highness? I have no right to command you... But please give me some time. I'll find a way.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王得知阿勒黛要出售蒸汽甲胄换武器，她请求阿勒黛给她时间想办法，并承诺不用卖掉甲胄。
context_analysis.en_US: When Siege learns Aleda plans to sell the steam armor, she asks for time to find another solution and promises Aleda she won't have to sell it.

quote.zh_CN: 维娜，你可以不用管这件事。……但是......请给我一点时间。我会想办法解决。……我只想看着你不用失去更多东西了。
quote.en_US: Vina, you don't have to bother with this... But please give me some time. I'll find a way... I just don't want to see you lose anything more.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王为阿勒黛包扎伤口，两人深夜谈心。推进之王说她不想看到阿勒黛失去更多东西。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege bandages Aleda's wound late at night. Siege says she doesn't want Aleda to lose anything more.

quote.zh_CN: 这么多年过去，我很难再相信奇迹了。艾尔希曾告诉我，就连我也不知道将来的自己在哪里。……让我们把那个寓言结束吧，总得画下句号。……去*维多利亚粗口*的使命。
quote.en_US: After all these years, it's hard for me to believe in miracles anymore... Let's end this fable. There has to be an ending... To hell with the mission.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿勒黛放弃窃取诸王之息，在蒸汽骑士和碎石崩塌面前选择与推进之王并肩。最终她用诸王长眠之所的石像挡住蒸汽骑士，为推进之王赢得逃脱的机会，自己留在废墟中面对梦魇。
context_analysis.en_US: Aleda abandons her mission to steal the Kings' Breath. She uses the stone monuments to block the Steam Knight, buying Siege time to escape while she faces her nightmare alone.

description.zh_CN: 推进之王与达格达（格拉斯哥帮成员）并肩作战，达格达是塔楼骑士出身，始终追随维娜。
description.en_US: Siege fights alongside Dagda (from Glasgow Gang), a Tower Knight who has always followed Vina.

quote.zh_CN: 达格达！伊莎贝尔小姐，您还执意要与她们一起行动吗？……推进之王第一天就告诉过你们，与自救军一起行动的是格拉斯哥帮，而不是亚历山德莉娜殿下与塔楼骑士。
quote.en_US: Dagda! Lady Isabelle, are you still set on acting with them? ...Vina told you on the first day that we're acting with the Glasgow Gang, not Princess Alexandrina and the Tower Knights.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达是格拉斯哥帮成员，随推进之王与自救军并肩行动。
context_analysis.en_US: Dagda is a Glasgow Gang member fighting alongside Siege and the Self-Rescue Army.

quote.zh_CN: 达格达，你们送这位战士回自救军营地吧，我们分头走。……有些时刻，请容许我站在你的身侧。……好。上前来，达格达。
quote.en_US: Dagda, you take this warrior back to camp, we split up... There are moments when I want you at my side... Alright. Come forward, Dagda.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王在战斗中说「请容许我站在你的身侧」，对达格达表示认可和亲近。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege tells Dagda 'I want you at my side' during battle, showing recognition and closeness.

quote.zh_CN: 达格达，你跟着雇佣兵离开这里。……你是最后一个向他们行过礼的人。你理应将他们的故事带回阳光下。殿下，请允许我同您并肩。……当然。
quote.en_US: Dagda, leave with the mercenaries... You were the last one to salute them. You should bring their story back into the sunlight. Your Highness, please allow me to fight at your side... Of course.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达坚持与推进之王并肩面对蒸汽骑士，推进之王允诺。
context_analysis.en_US: Dagda insists on fighting alongside Siege against the Steam Knight, and Siege agrees.

description.zh_CN: 因陀罗是格拉斯哥帮核心成员，跟随推进之王四处流浪，回到伦蒂尼姆并肩作战。
description.en_US: Indra is a core Glasgow Gang member who followed Siege through exile and returns to fight alongside her in Lonedin.

quote.zh_CN: 你*维多利亚粗口*凭什么这么说维娜？！……得了，别嘚瑟了，这点炸肉干拿去，今天算你赢。
quote.en_US: How the hell do you talk about Vina like that?! ...Here, take this jerky, you win today.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗对摩根为维娜说话，维护推进之王的尊严。
context_analysis.en_US: Indra defends Siege's honor when Morgan speaks badly of Vina.

quote.zh_CN: 因陀罗: 那可是维娜啊，拽得要命。她说是她的老师。我原来以为她的老师是诺伯特区的哪位斗殴大王。
quote.en_US: Indra: That was Vina, so damn cocky. She said it was her teacher. I thought her teacher was some street fighter from Norbert District.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗回忆初遇维娜的场景，讲述她当时以为维娜的老师是斗殴大王，后得知其贵族出身才说得通。
context_analysis.en_US: Indra recalls meeting Vina, joking about her cocky demeanor and thinking her teacher was a street fighter.

quote.zh_CN: 因陀罗: 维娜！这里！
quote.en_US: Indra: Vina! Over here!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗在巷战中引导推进之王撤退，展现默契配合。
context_analysis.en_US: Indra guides Siege to safety during the巷战, showing their teamwork默契.

description.zh_CN: 摩根是格拉斯哥帮核心成员，与因陀罗一起跟随推进之王。正在写关于维娜的回忆录《伟大的维娜陛下和她伟大的朋友们》。
description.en_US: Morgan is a core Glasgow Gang member, following Siege alongside Indra. She is writing a memoir about Vina.

quote.zh_CN: 你*维多利亚粗口*凭什么这么说维娜？！……得了，别嘚瑟了。……哈......真没想到有天你会反过来说我冲动。……摩根，你打算去哪？
quote.en_US: How the hell do you talk about Vina that way?! ...Morgan, where are you going?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 摩根对维娜被贬低感到愤怒，质问自救军战士。
context_analysis.en_US: Morgan is furious when a Self-Rescue soldier speaks down about Vina.

quote.zh_CN: 我当时觉得，陪着一位王储冒险说不定比混迹街头刺激得多。更何况，这位王储还深得我心。……然后不知不觉地，我们就跟着维娜逃出伦蒂尼姆，跟着她四处流浪，又跟着她回到这里。
quote.en_US: I thought following a royal heir might be more exciting than running the streets. Especially since I liked her... Then before I knew it, we fled Lonedin with Vina, wandered around, and came back here.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 摩根回忆跟随维娜逃离伦蒂尼姆、流浪、又回来的经历，讲述她深得摩根好感。
context_analysis.en_US: Morgan recalls fleeing, wandering, and returning with Vina, saying she liked the royal heir.

description.zh_CN: 闪灵（闪灵）在战场上与推进之王相遇，她离开赦罪师加入战斗，保护罗德岛和自救军战士免受赦罪师巫术的侵害。
description.en_US: Shining fights alongside Siege in the battlefield, having left the Inquisitors to protect Rhodes Island and Self-Rescue fighters from the Inquisitor's magic.

quote.zh_CN: 闪灵: ……所有人，退到我身后。……死亡与生命从来都是硬币的两面。不过，我能阻挡的时间很有限。
quote.en_US: Shining: ...Everyone, step behind me... Death and life are two sides of the same coin. But the time I can block is very limited.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 闪灵用剑挡住赦罪师卫兵的巫术，保护战场上的所有人。
context_analysis.en_US: Shining uses her sword to shield everyone from the Inquisitors' dark arts.

relation_label.zh_CN: 王与最后的骑士·命运对决
relation_label.en_US: Queen vs. Last Knight — Fateful Duel

description.zh_CN: 推进之王（亚历山德莉娜）与最后的蒸汽骑士在诸王长眠之所展开命运对决。蒸汽骑士在地下坚守四年，被维多利亚的背叛所伤害，将诸王之息视为最后的维多利亚。
description.en_US: Siege (Alexandrina) and the last Steam Knight have a fateful duel in the Kings' Resting Place. The Knight has been trapped underground for four years, scarred by Victoria's betrayal, treating the Kings' Breath as his last Victoria.

quote.zh_CN: 蒸汽骑士: '维多利亚。'他将这把剑称作维多利亚。他誓死守卫的维多利亚。他被宏大的维多利亚背叛，那么，他就去守卫象征的维多利亚。……他向王位继承人发起冲锋。
quote.en_US: Steam Knight: 'Victoria.' He calls the sword Victoria. The Victoria he swore to defend. Betrayed by the grand Victoria, he chooses to guard the symbol of Victoria... He charges at the heir to the throne.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 蒸汽骑士将诸王之息当作自己的维多利亚，向亚历山德莉娜发起冲锋。
context_analysis.en_US: The Steam Knight treats the Kings' Breath as his Victoria and charges at Alexandrina.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王: '骑士，它不是你的维多利亚。请让我通过这里。'……蒸汽骑士混沌的记忆中，突然闯进了一个画面。在他站起身来之前，一个女孩在为他落泪。
quote.en_US: Siege: 'Knight, it is not your Victoria. Let me pass.' ...In the Steam Knight's chaotic memory, a sudden image emerged. Before he rose, a girl was crying for him.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王试图唤醒蒸汽骑士，在他混沌的记忆中出现了阿勒黛为他落泪的画面。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege tries to awaken the Steam Knight. In his fragmented memory, a scene emerges: Aleda crying for him before he rose.

description.zh_CN: 阿勒黛与侍女艾尔希自幼相伴，从公爵府到沦陷的伦蒂尼姆，艾尔希始终陪伴在阿勒黛身边，是她最亲近的人。艾尔希最终在坎伯兰公爵府的大火中牺牲。
description.en_US: Aleda and her servant Elise have been together since childhood. From the Duke's manor to occupied Lonedin, Elise remained at Aleda's side as her closest companion. Elise ultimately sacrificed herself in the fire at Cumberland Manor.

quote.zh_CN: 侍女艾尔希: 我永远支持您的决定。……不过，您至少留意着脚下，别被花草绊倒了，否则园丁吉姆又会因为弄伤您而羞愧得吃不下饭。
quote.en_US: Elise: I will always support your decisions... But do watch your step, or gardener Jim will be so ashamed he won't eat.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 艾尔希从小陪伴阿勒黛，对她的照顾无微不至。
context_analysis.en_US: Elise has cared for Aleda since childhood, her devotion meticulous and unwavering.

quote.zh_CN: 管家艾尔希: 小姐......请再让我巡视一次这片花园吧。……就算只是些往日的碎片......它仍是我最珍视的东西。
quote.en_US: Elise: My lady... please let me tour this garden one more time... Even if only fragments of the past... it is what I treasure most.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿勒黛想留住一切，艾尔希请求最后一次巡视花园，表现出对过去的珍视。坎伯兰公爵府随后陷入火海，艾尔希留在火中。
context_analysis.en_US: Before Cumberland Manor burns, Elise asks to tour the garden one last time, then stays behind in the flames.

description.zh_CN: 阿勒黛受某位公爵指使执行"使命"，在诸王长眠之所窃取诸王之息。最终公爵的真实意图被揭露——以诸王之息威慑其他公爵加入自己的阵营。
description.en_US: Aleda was ordered by a certain Duke to carry out a 'mission' — stealing the Kings' Breath in the Royal Tomb. The Duke's true intent was to use the sword to coerce other Dukes into joining his faction.

quote.zh_CN: 阿勒黛: '她......很心急。'……艾尔希，我早就不再等待了。
quote.en_US: Aleda: 'She... is very impatient.' ...Elise, I stopped waiting long ago.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿勒黛收到幕后公爵的第二封信，她说自己"早就不再等待"，暗示她长期被公爵操控。
context_analysis.en_US: Aleda receives the second letter from the Duke behind the scenes. Her comment 'I stopped waiting' reveals she's long been manipulated.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王: '这就是唯一的方法吗？'……阿勒黛，我很清楚她的目的，但这与我无关。我只负责做到，我只关注那些......我能把握的事。
quote.en_US: Siege: 'Is this the only way?' ...Aleda, I know her purpose very clearly, but that has nothing to do with me. I just need to get it done.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王指出阿勒黛背后的人想以诸王之息威慑公爵，阿勒黛承认知道但说"与她无关"。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege exposes that someone is behind Aleda, using the sword to intimidate Dukes. Aleda admits knowing but says it doesn't concern her.

description.zh_CN: 铅踝是阿勒黛雇佣的佣兵，负责护送武器入城。阿勒黛最终用诸王长眠之所的石像挡住蒸汽骑士，铅踝目睹了这一切。
description.en_US: Qianjiao is a mercenary hired by Aleda to escort weapons into Lonedin. Aleda ultimately uses the Royal Tomb's statues to block the Steam Knight while Qianjiao watches.

quote.zh_CN: 铅踝: 嗯，货箱是有些闷。……出来以后......好像也差不多。……哈哈，欢迎来到伦蒂尼姆。
quote.en_US: Qianjiao: Yeah, the cargo boxes are a bit stuffy... After coming out, seems about the same... Welcome to Lonedin.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 铅踝率雇佣兵护送最后一批武装到达，与阿勒黛会面。
context_analysis.en_US: Qianjiao leads mercenaries delivering the final shipment of weapons, meeting with Aleda.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王: '就是你们吗？在阿勒黛身后的人？不，不是你们，懦弱的公爵可不敢亲自在这里露面。'……铅踝: '最后一枚烟雾弹了，我们还有机会。'
quote.en_US: Siege: 'Are you the ones behind Aleda? No, the cowardly Duke wouldn't dare show his face here.' ...Qianjiao: 'Last smoke bomb, we still have a chance.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王直接质问铅踝等人是阿勒黛背后的人。铅踝最后用烟雾弹掩护撤退。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege directly confronts Qianjiao's group as those behind Aleda. Qianjiao uses his last smoke bomb to cover the retreat.

relation_label.zh_CN: 被操控的棋子与操控者

description.zh_CN: 阿勒黛被幕后公爵操控执行"使命"窃取诸王之息。她自己也知道这个任务的本质，但在命运面前选择顺从。最终她放弃使命，在最后关头选择牺牲自己保护推进之王。
description.en_US: Aleda was manipulated by a Duke into 'completing her mission' to steal the Kings' Breath. She was aware of its true nature but chose to comply. She ultimately abandons the mission and sacrifices herself to protect Siege.

quote.zh_CN: 阿勒黛: '你可以在告诫我，可以斥责我，可以试图打倒我，我全部接受。但我会带着这把剑离开。这是我在伦蒂尼姆的......"使命"。'
quote.en_US: Aleda: 'You can warn me, scold me, try to strike me down — I'll accept it all. But I will take this sword. This is my 'mission' in Lonedin.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿勒黛称窃取诸王之息是她在伦蒂尼姆的"使命"，这是幕后公爵的操控。
context_analysis.en_US: Aleda calls stealing the Kings' Breath her 'mission' — revealing she's been commissioned by someone else.

quote.zh_CN: 阿勒黛: '去*维多利亚粗口*的使命，我已经足够累了。无论是扮演一个贵族，扮演一个领袖，还是扮演一个朋友。'
quote.en_US: Aleda: 'To hell with the mission. I'm already tired enough. Whether playing a noble, playing a leader, or playing a friend.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿勒黛在最后关头彻底放弃所谓的"使命"，宣布不再做被操控的棋子。
context_analysis.en_US: Aleda at the last moment abandons her 'mission,' declaring she's done being a puppet.

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅（魔王继承者）与凯尔希在指挥塔战斗中并肩对抗特雷西斯和血魔大君。凯尔希以Mon3tr拦截特雷西斯的剑，为博士和阿米娅争取撤退时间，身受重伤。
description.en_US: Amiya (Demon King successor) and Kal'tsit fight together against Theresa and the Blood Demon Lord. Kal'tsit uses Mon3tr to block Theresa's sword, buying time for the Doctor and Amiya to retreat, getting grievously wounded in the process.

quote.zh_CN: Mon3tr: （极度痛苦的嘶吼）凯尔希！……Dr.{@nickname}......带着阿米娅......撤退。
quote.en_US: Mon3tr: (Screaming in agony) Kal'tsit! ...Doctor... take Amiya... retreat.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希用Mon3tr挡住特雷西斯对阿米娅的致命攻击，身受重伤。
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit uses Mon3tr to block Theresa's fatal strike against Amiya, sustaining severe injuries.

quote.zh_CN: 凯尔希: '特雷西斯......你只是在加快毁灭的进程。'特雷西斯: '你已经没有力气说话了。你拦截了巫妖的信使，了不起。'
quote.en_US: Kal'tsit: 'Theresa, you are only accelerating destruction.' Theresa: 'You have no strength left to speak. You intercepted the Wraith's messenger — impressive.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希与特雷西斯正面对决，她此前拦截了巫妖的信使，为罗德岛争取了时间。
context_analysis.en_US: Kal'tsit faces Theresa directly. She had previously intercepted the Wraith's messenger, buying Rhodes Island time.

relation_label.zh_CN: 魔王与女妖之主·并肩抗敌
relation_label.en_US: Demon King &女妖之主 — Side by Side

description.zh_CN: 逻各斯（女妖之主）与阿米娅在指挥塔并肩对抗血魔大君。他用咒术保护罗德岛干员们，并发表"见过黎明光辉之人怎可能再度回到永夜之中"的宣言。
description.en_US: Logos (女妖之主) fights alongside Amiya against the Blood Demon Lord on the command tower. He uses sorcery to shield the Rhodes Island operators and declares that those who have seen the dawn's light cannot return to eternal night.

quote.zh_CN: Logos: '我追随的并非魔王的冠冕。令我前行至此的正是特蕾西娅殿下的理想。你们夺走且亵渎了她的生命，却无法熄灭她在我们眼前燃起的炬火。见过黎明光辉之人，怎可能再度回到永夜之中？'
quote.en_US: Logos: 'What I follow is not the Demon King's crown. What drives me here is Queen Theresa's ideal. You took and desecrated her life, but you cannot extinguish the flame she kindled before us. Those who have seen the dawn's light—how could they return to eternal night?'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 逻各斯在阿米娅身边对抗血魔大君，宣告自己追随特蕾西娅的理想而非魔王冠冕。
context_analysis.en_US: Logos stands beside Amiya against the Blood Demon Lord, declaring his allegiance to Theresa's ideal rather than the crown.

relation_label.zh_CN: 魔王继承者与前任魔王·灵魂共鸣
relation_label.en_US: Demon King Heir & Former Demon King — Soul Resonance

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅在战斗中听到特蕾西娅的声音，感受到萨卡兹万年的回忆。戒指上并无裂纹，是她在颤抖。她的意识被萨卡兹的历史洪流所冲击。
description.en_US: During battle, Amiya hears Theresa's voice and feels the weight of ten thousand years of Sarkaz memory. The rings on her fingers show no cracks — it is she who trembles. Her consciousness is overwhelmed by the tide of Sarkaz history.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅: '凯尔希......医生......'……戒指上并没有裂纹，也没有变色。它们只是在颤抖。因为她在颤抖。
quote.en_US: Amiya: 'Kal'tsit... Doctor...' ...The rings showed no cracks and did not change color. They were trembling. Because she was trembling.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅在血魔大君和特雷西斯的双重压力下几乎失控，戒指颤抖是因为她自己在颤抖。
context_analysis.en_US: Under pressure from the Blood Demon Lord and Theresa, Amiya nearly loses control. The rings tremble because she trembles.

relation_label.zh_CN: 罗德岛指挥官与干员·生死相护

description.zh_CN: 博士与阿米娅在伦蒂尼姆并肩作战。博士在阿米娅快要坠地时抓住她的手将她抱在怀中，在特雷西斯出现时呼叫凯尔希。
description.en_US: The Doctor and Amiya fight together in Lonedin. The Doctor catches Amiya as she falls and holds her when Theresa appears, calling for Kal'tsit.

quote.zh_CN: 在阿米娅的身体快要触到地面之前，你抓住了她的手，将她抱在怀中。……凯尔希！
quote.en_US: Before Amiya's body could hit the ground, you grabbed her hand and held her in your arms... Kal'tsit!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 博士在阿米娅几乎坠地时抓住她抱在怀中，并呼叫凯尔希。
context_analysis.en_US: The Doctor catches Amiya as she falls, holding her in their arms, and calls for Kal'tsit.

description.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶与曼弗雷德（军事委员会将军）在指挥塔激战。阿斯卡纶揭露曼弗雷德四年前参与杀害特蕾西娅，曼弗雷德则质问阿斯卡纶为何背叛萨卡兹。
description.en_US: Ascalon and Manfred (Military Committee General) battle fiercely on the command tower. Ascalon reveals Manfred was involved in Theresa's death four years ago, while Manfred questions why Ascalon betrayed Kazdel.

quote.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶: '四年前，是你们杀死了她。现在，你们又用这种毫无荣耀的方式玷污了她的死亡。真正的背叛者，是谁？'
quote.en_US: Ascalon: 'Four years ago, you killed her. Now you desecrate her death with this honorless method. Who is the true traitor?'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶揭露曼弗雷德参与杀害特蕾西娅，并指责军事委员会的做法没有荣耀。
context_analysis.en_US: Ascalon exposes Manfred's role in Theresa's death four years ago and condemns the Military Committee's dishonorable actions.

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德: '阿斯卡纶，你准备把我们的情报交给维多利亚人吗？交给......一群曾经践踏过卡兹戴尔的异族人？你背叛了你自己曾经许下的诺言，背叛了卡兹戴尔。'
quote.en_US: Manfred: 'Ascalon, are you handing our intelligence to Victorians? To the very outsiders who trampled Kazdel? You betrayed your own oath, betrayed Kazdel.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德质问阿斯卡纶为何将萨卡兹情报交给罗德岛（维多利亚人），指控她背叛萨卡兹。
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred accuses Ascalon of betraying Kazdel by sharing intelligence with Rhodes Island/Victorians.

relation_label.zh_CN: 闪灵与赦罪师卫兵·战场对决
relation_label.en_US: Shining vs. Inquisitor Elite Guards — Battlefield Duel

description.zh_CN: 闪灵离开赦罪师后在战场上与曾经的同僚（赦罪师卫兵）正面对决。她用剑斩杀了多名卫兵，并揭示自己"痛恨的从来不是他（赦罪师首领），而是我自己"。
description.en_US: Shining, having left the Inquisitors, faces her former colleagues (Inquisitor Elite Guards) in battle. She slays multiple guards with her sword and reveals 'what I hate is never him — it's myself.'

quote.zh_CN: 闪灵: '假如我的行动依旧要受他辖制，那我的离开岂不是失去了意义？'……闪灵: '不。我痛恨的从来不是他。我痛恨的是我自己。'
quote.en_US: Shining: 'If my actions still answer to him, what meaning would my leaving have?' ...Shining: 'No. What I hate is never him. What I hate is myself.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 闪灵斩杀了赦罪师卫兵并揭示内心——她离开赦罪师是因为无法接受自己的无力，而非恨赦罪师首领。
context_analysis.en_US: Shining slays the Inquisitor guard and reveals her inner torment — she left because she couldn't bear her own helplessness, not because she hated the Inquisitor Master.

relation_label.zh_CN: 城防军指挥官与高卢遗民公爵
relation_label.en_US: City Defense Commander & Gaul Descendant Duke

description.zh_CN: 莱托中校（城防军指挥官，高卢遗民）与某位公爵合作，以"高卢遗民"身份与特雷西斯谈判，承诺在维多利亚乱局中让高卢城市回归。
description.en_US: Colonel Ledou (City Defense Commander, Gaul descendant) cooperates with a certain Duke, negotiating with Theresa as 'Gaul descendants,' promising that Gaul cities will return to Gaul in Victoria's chaos.

quote.zh_CN: 莱托中校: '摄政王殿下，如今没有一座城市属于那个名为高卢的国家。站在您面前的，并不是一名高卢人，而是高卢遗民。'
quote.en_US: Ledou: 'Your Highness Regent, no city bears the name of Gaul today. Before you stands not a Gaul man, but a Gaul descendant.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 莱托中校向特雷西斯表明自己是高卢遗民的身份背景。
context_analysis.en_US: Ledou introduces himself to Theresa as a Gaul descendant, explaining his background.

quote.zh_CN: 莱托中校: '我们是高卢遗民会全力支持卡兹戴尔军事委员会在伦蒂尼姆的一切行动。而我们所希望的，只是在之后维多利亚的乱局中，让那几座原本属于高卢的城市回到高卢。'
quote.en_US: Ledou: 'The Gaul Descendants will fully support all actions of the Kazdel Military Committee in Lonedin. What we hope for is simply that, in the chaos to come in Victoria, those cities originally belonging to Gaul will return to Gaul.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 莱托中校以高卢遗民身份与萨卡兹军事委员会合作，交换条件是重建高卢的城市。
context_analysis.en_US: Ledou trades cooperation with the Kazdel Military Committee in exchange for Gaul cities.

relation_label.zh_CN: 工人代表与城防军指挥官

description.zh_CN: 凯瑟琳（十一号军工厂老工人代表）与莱托中校在交接仪式和工厂管理中多次打交道。莱托中校对她心存敬意，称她"不愧是曾被选为工人代表的女杰"。凯瑟琳则讽刺他"您的勋章也越来越多了"。
description.en_US: Cathleen (veteran worker representative of Factory No.11) interacts with Colonel Ledou during handover ceremonies and factory management. Ledou respects her as 'a true worker representative heroine,' while she sarcastically notes his growing medal collection.

quote.zh_CN: 莱托中校: '我听说过你的事迹，凯瑟琳女士。不愧是曾被选为工人代表的女杰，令人敬佩。'凯瑟琳: '长官，就像你听说过我一样，我也听说过一些你的事情。高卢。'
quote.en_US: Ledou: 'I've heard of your deeds, Miss Cathleen. A true worker representative heroine — admirable.' Cathleen: 'Sir, just as you've heard of me, I've heard some things about you. Gaul.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 莱托中校和凯瑟琳互相了解对方的背景。凯瑟琳提到莱托的高卢血统，莱托承认家父是高卢遗民。
context_analysis.en_US: Ledou and Cathleen recognize each other's backgrounds. Cathleen mentions his Gaul bloodline; Ledou confirms his father was a Gaul remnant.

description.zh_CN: 凯瑟琳和费斯特是祖孙关系。费斯特是蒸汽甲胄工匠出身，后加入自救军。凯瑟琳为保护工厂工人向萨卡兹妥协，费斯特则选择反抗。凯瑟琳最终被费斯特和工人们救出。
description.en_US: Cathleen and Fust are grandmother and grandson. Fust is a steam armor craftsman who joined the Self-Rescue Army. Cathleen compromises with the Sankazi to protect workers; Fust chooses resistance. Fust and the workers ultimately rescue Cathleen.

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特: '我不想帮萨卡兹对付自己人！'凯瑟琳: '抓住他们。'……费斯特: '奶奶，听我说。我收到了一些消息，有一个反抗组织正在萨迪恩区活跃。他们管自己叫伦蒂尼姆市民自救军——我要去找他们！'
quote.en_US: Fust: 'I don't want to help the Sankazi fight our own people!' Cathleen: 'Catch them.' ...Fust: 'Grandma, listen. I received word that a resistance group is active in Sadine District — the Lonedin Citizens' Self-Rescue Army. I'm going to find them!'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特想反抗萨卡兹，凯瑟琳抓住他。费斯特告诉奶奶他加入了自救军。
context_analysis.en_US: Fust wants to resist Sankazi; Cathleen catches him. Fust tells her he's joined the Self-Rescue Army.

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特: '奶奶，三年前，我不理解你做出的决定。而现在，我愈发感觉到，我肩上的担子有多重。我很害怕我又会做蠢事。但是——我不能因此而停下。'凯瑟琳: '......你还太嫩了，臭小子。'
quote.en_US: Fust: 'Grandma, three years ago I didn't understand your decision. Now I feel the weight on my shoulders. I'm afraid I'll do something foolish. But—I cannot stop.' Cathleen: '...You're still too green, you rascal.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特和凯瑟琳和解。凯瑟琳将暗格里的情报交给费斯特，支持他的行动。
context_analysis.en_US: Fust reconciles with Cathleen, who gives him hidden intelligence and supports his mission.

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特: '你知道这样的老工人，他们的经验有多宝贵吗？很抢手的。'萨卡兹雇佣兵队长: '你以为你能打赢我？'费斯特: '不能，但是她也许可以。'……凯瑟琳: '谢了，乔治。起码出了口恶气。'
quote.en_US: Fust: 'Old workers like her are invaluable. Very much in demand.' ...Cathleen: 'Thanks, George. At least that felt good.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特和工人们冲入刑场救出凯瑟琳。凯瑟琳用扳手打了萨卡兹雇佣兵队长，和乔治一起出了口恶气。
context_analysis.en_US: Fust and workers storm the execution site and rescue Cathleen. She smacks the mercenary captain with a wrench, venting her anger alongside George.

relation_label.zh_CN: 老工人与年轻雇佣兵·意外的善意
relation_label.en_US: Veteran Worker & Young Mercenary — Unexpected Kindness

description.zh_CN: 凯瑟琳在刑场上与年轻的萨卡兹雇佣兵明椒（曾与格林一起执行任务）交谈。她将格林留下的指套还给明椒，并说"你还不理解战争是什么"。明椒最终无法执行处决命令。
description.en_US: Cathleen talks with young Sankazi mercenary Peper (who worked with Grane) at the execution site. She returns Grane's finger guard to Peper and says 'you still don't understand war.' Peper ultimately cannot carry out the execution order.

quote.zh_CN: 明椒: '他死了。'凯瑟琳: '......你不难过吗？'明椒: '格林告诉过我，对我们雇佣兵来说，生离死别是很正常的事。'凯瑟琳: '接着，孩子。'
quote.en_US: Peper: 'He's dead.' Cathleen: '...Aren't you sad?' Peper: 'Grane told me, for mercenaries, parting and death are normal.' Cathleen: 'Here, take this, child.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯瑟琳将格林的指套交给明椒，格林把它藏在烟盒里当作烟钱留给了凯瑟琳。凯瑟琳让明椒接住。
context_analysis.en_US: Cathleen hands Grane's finger guard to Peper. Grane had hidden it in his cigarette case and left it as payment to Cathleen.

quote.zh_CN: 萨卡兹雇佣兵队长: '今天，要么你杀了这个老东西，要么，放下武器，但我会了结你。'明椒: '我......我做不到！'
quote.en_US: Mercenary Captain: 'Today, either you kill this old woman, or put down your weapon — and I'll end you.' Peper: 'I... I can't do it!'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 明椒在行刑前无法对凯瑟琳下手，队长威胁她但她坚持无法执行命令。最终费斯特等人冲入救场。
context_analysis.en_US: Peper cannot execute Cathleen. When the captain threatens her, she refuses. Fust and the workers storm in to rescue Cathleen.

relation_label.zh_CN: 教育者与背叛者·信念对立

description.zh_CN: 戈尔丁（圣马尔索学校教师）代表信念与良知，与莱托中校（城防军指挥官）形成对立。莱托曾是她信任的学生，如今成了"协助萨卡兹"的人。她坚持"只要有光，我们就会向光而行"。
description.en_US: Goldin (Saint-Marso School teacher) represents belief and conscience, in stark opposition to Colonel Ledou (City Defense Commander). Ledou was once her trusted student but now collaborates with the Sankazi. She insists 'where there is light, we will walk toward it.'

quote.zh_CN: 戈尔丁: '我十分感谢你的父亲，他多年来一直资助着这所学校。……我曾以为你是和他一样的人......而你，却亲手熄灭了那点本就微弱的火光。'
quote.en_US: Goldin: 'I deeply thank your father, who funded our school for years... I thought you were like him... But you extinguished that faint flame yourself.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戈尔丁曾信任莱托，但发现他选择了与萨卡兹合作，痛心地指出他辜负了自己的信任。
context_analysis.en_US: Goldin once trusted Ledou, but now sees him collaborating with the Sankazi and feels he has betrayed her trust.

quote.zh_CN: 戈尔丁: '我必须相信。……我只能相信。只要有光，我们就会向光而行。'莱托中校: '那我羡慕你，戈尔丁女士。看看头顶的阴云吧，暴风雨就快来了。'
quote.en_US: Goldin: 'I must believe... I can only believe. Where there is light, we will walk toward it.' Ledou: 'Then I envy you, Miss Goldin. Look at the clouds above — the storm is coming.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戈尔丁坚持信念，莱托中校则表示羡慕她的信念，暗示自己已经放弃了希望。
context_analysis.en_US: Goldin clings to belief while Ledou admits he envies her conviction, implying he has given up hope.

relation_label.zh_CN: 文学知己·跨越阵营的友情

description.zh_CN: 戈尔丁与海蒂是通过读书会结识的文学界朋友。海蒂是情报工作者，为伦蒂尼姆市民的生存而战。戈尔丁为学校和孩子们坚守。海蒂称赞戈尔丁是"伦蒂尼姆最有眼光的评论家"。
description.en_US: Goldin and Hedy met through a reading club as literary friends. Hedy is an intelligence operative fighting for Lonedin citizens' survival. Goldin holds firm for her school and children. Hedy calls Goldin 'the most discerning critic in Lonedin.'

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂: '戈尔丁，你怎么注意到有什么了吗？'戈尔丁: '不是什么紧要的。茉莉，你先回学校，把孩子们都集合起来，别让他们跑到街上。'
quote.en_US: Hedy: 'Goldin, did you notice something?' Goldin: 'Nothing urgent. Mo莉, go back to school first, gather all the children, don't let them onto the streets.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戈尔丁发现受伤的海蒂，将她带到学校缝合伤口，并让她留在学校躲避追兵。
context_analysis.en_US: Goldin finds wounded Hedy, brings her to the school to treat her, and hides her from pursuers.

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂: '你当时可真是毫不留情。说我的新书是"被流行文化牵着鼻子走的媚俗之作"……可我也说了，作者的才华远不止于此。'戈尔丁: '我能读懂你写下来的每一个句子，也能读懂你没有写出来的另外一百句——海蒂，这是你亲口说的。'
quote.en_US: Hedy: 'You were so merciless back then, calling my book 'pop-culture-driven drivel.' But you also said the author's talent is far more than that.' Goldin: 'I can read every sentence you wrote, and the hundred you left unwritten — Hedy, these are your own words.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戈尔丁和海蒂回忆读书会上的交往，她们是互相理解的文学知己。
context_analysis.en_US: Goldin and Hedy recall their literary friendship from the reading club — mutual understanding between kindred spirits.

relation_label.zh_CN: 情报工作者与城防军指挥官·对立
relation_label.en_US: Intelligence Operative vs. City Defense Commander — Opposition

description.zh_CN: 海蒂是情报工作者，为伦蒂尼姆的和平和市民生存而战，与莱托中校（城防军指挥官）形成对立。她与戈尔丁的对话揭示萨卡兹即将进攻。
description.en_US: Hedy is an intelligence operative fighting for Lonedin's peace and citizens' survival, opposing Colonel Ledou. Her conversation with Goldin reveals the Sankazi are about to attack.

quote.zh_CN: 海蒂: '戈尔丁，你也注意到了，今夜的伦蒂尼姆即将迎来又一次剧变。斯塔福德公爵的军队正在对议会广场发起进攻。……战火随时会蔓延到其他城市，所有维多利亚人都需要做好准备。'
quote.en_US: Hedy: 'Goldin, you noticed too — tonight Lonedin faces another upheaval. The Stafford Duke's forces are attacking the parliament square... Flames will spread to other cities. All Victorians must be prepared.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 海蒂警告戈尔丁伦蒂尼姆即将发生剧变，萨卡兹和公爵军队的战争即将来临。
context_analysis.en_US: Hedy warns Goldin that Lonedin faces upheaval, with the Sankazi and Duke forces on the brink of war.

relation_label.zh_CN: 前任魔王与"特蕾西娅"·真相揭露

description.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德提到收到"殿下的信号"，称它"已经准备好了"。这个"特蕾西娅殿下"是特雷西斯的傀儡/复制品/利用品。真正的特蕾西娅的灵魂存于阿米娅体内。特雷西斯宣称"特蕾西娅回到了我们身边"（指这个傀儡）。
description.en_US: Manfred mentions receiving 'the signal from Her Highness' — this 'Theresa' is Theresa's puppet/doppelganger. The real Theresa's soul resides in Amiya. Theresa claims 'Theresa has returned to us' (referring to the puppet).

quote.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德: '将军，我刚刚收到殿下的信号。它已经准备好了。'特雷西斯: '很好。那么，该开始了。'
quote.en_US: Manfred: 'General, I just received Her Highness's signal. It is ready.' Theresa: 'Good. Then, let us begin.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德报告特蕾西娅的信号已准备好。特雷西斯说"该开始了"，暗示特雷西斯控制的傀儡特蕾西娅已准备就绪。
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred reports that 'Theresa' is ready. Theresa says 'let us begin,' suggesting the puppet controlled by Theresa is prepared.

relation_label.zh_CN: 公爵之女与蒸汽骑士甲胄·童年理想
relation_label.en_US: Duke's Daughter & Steam Knight Armor — Childhood Dream

description.zh_CN: 阿勒黛从小梦想成为蒸汽骑士，公爵府的阁楼上保存着初代坎伯兰蒸汽骑士的残缺甲胄。她在26年前的宴会上躲在甲胄后偷听，被甲胄中的幻象所救。蒸汽甲胄对她象征着坎伯兰的荣耀与理想。
description.en_US: Aleda dreamed since childhood of becoming a Steam Knight. The attic of the Duke's manor holds the damaged armor of the first Cumberland Steam Knight. As a child, she hid behind it at a banquet and was saved by the phantom within. The armor symbolizes Cumberland's honor and her ideal.

quote.zh_CN: 阿勒黛: '他们都说......那个下午是一个奇迹。'……'我会像曾曾曾曾祖母一样，让坎伯兰这个名字永远闪耀。艾尔希，我保证，我会让你看见的！'
quote.en_US: Aleda: 'They all said... that afternoon was a miracle.' ...'I will be like my great-great-grandmother, making the Cumberland name shine forever. Elise, I promise — I will show you!'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 幼年阿勒黛在26年前的宴会上躲在阁楼甲胄后，向艾尔希保证会成为伟大的蒸汽骑士。
context_analysis.en_US: Young Aleda hides behind the attic armor at the banquet 26 years ago, promising Elise she will become a great Steam Knight.

quote.zh_CN: 阿勒黛: '它们都忘了，您才是最厉害的蒸汽骑士！……要是您能有二分之一，不，三分之二个您这么厉害，也就满足了。'
quote.en_US: Aleda: 'They all forgot — you are the mightiest Steam Knight! ...If I could be half — no, two-thirds — as great as you, that would be enough.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿勒黛对蒸汽甲胄说话，将其视为最厉害的蒸汽骑士，希望自己能有其三分之二的能力。
context_analysis.en_US: Aleda speaks to the steam armor, treating it as the mightiest Steam Knight, hoping to have two-thirds of its prowess.

quote.zh_CN: 管家艾尔希: '这具甲胄！您的先祖——那位高贵的老公爵的鲜血流淌在甲胄里。它是维多利亚赐予坎伯兰家的荣耀，是坎伯兰家"永远高洁"的象征。'
quote.en_US: Elise: 'This armor! The noble Duke's blood flows through it. It is the honor Victoria bestowed on Cumberland, the symbol of Cumberland's 'eternal purity.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 艾尔希说蒸汽甲胄是坎伯兰家荣耀和"永远高洁"的象征。阿勒黛最终决定卖掉它换取武器，艾尔希反对。
context_analysis.en_US: Elise says the steam armor is Cumberland's honor and 'eternal purity.' Aleda ultimately decides to sell it for weapons, against Elise's wishes.

description.zh_CN: 26年前，阿勒黛在公爵府花园遇到带着诸王之息归来的幼年亚历山德莉娜（推进之王）和黄金狮子。她们的命运从此交织。26年后重逢，最终以悲剧告终。
description.en_US: Twenty-six years ago, young Aleda met young Alexandrina (Siege) returning with the Kings' Breath and the golden lion in the Duke's garden. Their fates intertwined from that moment. They reunite 26 years later, only to end in tragedy.

quote.zh_CN: 之后的二十多年里，她常常梦见这一幕，梦见那些金黄色的威严的存在，梦见和他们在一起的女孩——直到她如兽主所预言的那样，与那个名为维娜之人重逢。
quote.en_US: For the next twenty-plus years, she often dreamed of this scene — the golden majestic beings, the girl with them — until, as the Beast Lord prophesied, she reunited with the one called Vina.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 26年前阿勒黛在公爵府花园遇到带着诸王之息归来的幼年亚历山德莉娜和黄金狮子，命运预言她们终将重逢。
context_analysis.en_US: Twenty-six years ago, Aleda met the young Alexandrina returning with the Kings' Breath and golden lion. A prophecy foretold their reunion.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王: '我们很小的时候就见过，是吗？'阿勒黛: '我原以为你忘记了。'推进之王: '我几乎忘了......那时，我和高文在一起。'阿勒黛: '那时，那只太阳一般的生物告诉我，终有一日，你我会再次相逢。'
quote.en_US: Siege: 'We met when we were very young, didn't we?' Aleda: 'I thought you'd forgotten.' Siege: 'I almost did... at that time, I was with Gavin.' Aleda: 'At that time, the sun-like creature told me — one day, you and I would meet again.'
