context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王和阿勒黛确认26年前的相遇——黄金狮子预言她们的命运重逢。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege and Aleda confirm their meeting 26 years ago — the golden lion prophesied their fated reunion.

relation_label.zh_CN: 血魔大君与摄政王·萨卡兹王庭核心
relation_label.en_US: Blood Demon Lord & Theresa's Regent — Sarkaz Royal Court Core

description.zh_CN: 血魔大君与特雷西斯在指挥塔协同作战。特雷西斯称血魔"从不滥杀无辜"，血魔则评价莱托"不像那种对萨卡兹感到好奇的人"。两人共同为萨卡兹军事委员会效力。
description.en_US: The Blood Demon Lord and Theresa Prime coordinate on the command tower. Theresa calls him 'never one to kill innocents recklessly'; the Blood Demon Lord evaluates Ledou as 'not the type to be curious about Sarkaz.' Both serve the Kazdel Military Committee.

quote.zh_CN: 血魔大君: '莱托，他说得对。我还没尝过他珍藏的酒。我们该去尝尝的，不是吗？'莱托中校: '......我会协助您的审查，确保......不漏过一个叛徒。'
quote.en_US: Blood Demon Lord: 'Ledou, he's right. I haven't tasted his vintage wine yet. We should go try it, shouldn't we?' Ledou: '...I will assist your review, ensuring... no traitor slips through.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 血魔大君当着莱托的面处决贵族，莱托配合审查。血魔评论说"我们对血液汽化的声音没兴趣"并以之为乐。
context_analysis.en_US: The Blood Demon Lord executes nobles before Ledou, who cooperates with the 'review.' The Blood Demon Lord savors the sound of blood vaporizing.

relation_label.zh_CN: 自救军指挥官与工人士兵

description.zh_CN: 克洛维希娅（自救军指挥官）与费斯特（工人代表）共同制定突袭城防军指挥塔的计划。费斯特利用自己对工厂的熟悉度引导罗德岛无人机作战。
description.en_US: Clouzing (Self-Rescue Army Commander) and Fust (worker representative) coordinate the raid on the City Defense Command Tower. Fust uses his knowledge of the factories to guide Rhodes Island drone operations.

quote.zh_CN: 费斯特: '按照你说的，我们都准备好了。工程小组会确保无人机畅行无阻。……这些都是我们用自己的双手造出来的东西。我们知道该怎么瞄准它们的弱点。'
quote.en_US: Fust: 'As you said, we're all ready. The engineering team will ensure the drones have clear passage... These are things we built with our own hands. We know how to target their weak points.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 费斯特带领工程小组配合可露希尔的无人机，利用自己对工厂设备的了解帮助控制自行源石炮。
context_analysis.en_US: Fust leads the engineering team supporting的可露希尔's drones, using his knowledge of factory equipment to help control the mobile source stone artillery.

relation_label.zh_CN: 起义领袖与城防军指挥官·生死对决
relation_label.en_US: Rebel Leader vs. City Defense Commander — Life-and-Death Showdown

description.zh_CN: 克洛维希娅指挥自救军突袭城防军指挥塔，试图说服城防军士兵不要为萨卡兹而战。她指出莱托背叛了维多利亚，士兵们"只是士兵"。
description.en_US: Clouzing commands the Self-Rescue Army's assault on the City Defense Command Tower, trying to persuade soldiers not to fight for the Sankazi. She exposes Ledou's betrayal and insists 'you're just soldiers.'

quote.zh_CN: 克洛维希娅: '你是维多利亚人，没错吧？两万城防军官兵遍布整座城市。除了已经战死的和被俘的那些，全都被同一个命令死死绑在原地，变成了萨卡兹的帮凶。……让开吧。'
quote.en_US: Clouzing: 'You're Victorian, aren't you? Twenty thousand city defense soldiers across the city. All bound in place, turned into Sankazi accomplices... Step aside.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 克洛维希娅向城防军士兵喊话，指出他们被迫成为萨卡兹帮凶的事实，请求他们让开。
context_analysis.en_US: Clouzing addresses the city defense soldiers, pointing out they've been forced into being Sankazi accomplices, and asks them to step aside.

relation_label.zh_CN: 阿斯兰王与蒸汽骑士的背叛悲剧
relation_label.en_US: Aslan Queen & Steam Knight Betrayal Tragedy

description.zh_CN: 推进之王（亚历山德莉娜）在诸王长眠之所发现32具蒸汽骑士残骸——他们全部死于26年前萨卡兹的伏击。蒸汽骑士被议会调离后返回，却发现整个维多利亚背叛了他们。推进之王哀悼"由贪婪、野心与欲望拼接成的维多利亚，杀死了它自己"。
description.en_US: In the Kings' Resting Place, Siege discovers 32 Steam Knight corpses — all killed 26 years ago in a Sankazi ambush. The Steam Knights had been recalled by Parliament, returned, only to find all of Victoria had betrayed them. Siege mourns: 'Victoria, stitched together from greed, ambition and desire, killed itself.'

quote.zh_CN: 达格达: '三十，三十一，三十二......这么多......这么多甲胄。他们全部死在了这里。'……推进之王: '背叛他们的——是整个维多利亚。'
quote.en_US: Dagda: 'Thirty, thirty-one, thirty-two... So many... all these armor. They're all dead here.' ...Siege: 'What betrayed them — was all of Victoria.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王在诸王长眠之所发现32具蒸汽骑士甲胄，揭露维多利亚背叛蒸汽骑士的历史真相。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege discovers 32 Steam Knight corpses in the Royal Tomb, exposing the historical truth of Victoria's betrayal of its own knights.

quote.zh_CN: 推进之王: '由贪婪、野心与欲望拼接成的维多利亚，杀死了它自己。'
quote.en_US: Siege: 'Victoria, stitched together from greed, ambition and desire, killed itself.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 推进之王对蒸汽骑士的悲剧下了一个定论——维多利亚自己杀死了它的守护者。
context_analysis.en_US: Siege delivers her verdict on the tragedy — Victoria itself killed its own guardians.

relation_label.zh_CN: 教师与助手·教育的传承

description.zh_CN: 戈尔丁与茉莉是圣马尔索学校的同事，共同照顾战争中的孩子们。茉莉是戈尔丁的助手，戈尔丁信任她并让她照顾孩子们。茉莉后来被变形者（伪茉莉）替换。
description.en_US: Goldin and Mo莉 are colleagues at Saint-Marso School, caring for children amid war. Mo莉 is Goldin's assistant; Goldin trusts her with the children. Mo莉 is later replaced by a Shapeshifter (fake Mo莉).

quote.zh_CN: 戈尔丁: '茉莉，刚才的事让我有了个新主意。……对年幼的孩子们而言，扮演其他角色就和玩游戏差不多。'茉莉: '但愿您是对的。'
quote.en_US: Goldin: 'Mo莉, what just happened gave me a new idea... For young children, playing other roles is just like a game.' Mo莉: 'I hope you're right.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戈尔丁和茉莉讨论用戏剧教育孩子远离街头粗制滥造的影响。
context_analysis.en_US: Goldin and Mo莉 discuss using drama to educate children away from street influences.

quote.zh_CN: 茉莉: '孩子们，都到我身后来。'莱托中校: '茉莉小姐，很遗憾，看来你已经忘记我了。'茉莉: '......忘记？'
quote.en_US: Mo莉: 'Children, come behind me.' Ledou: 'Miss Mo莉, it seems you've forgotten me.' Mo莉: '...Forgot?'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 莱托中校来到学校，发现茉莉不记得他了——但这个茉莉是变形者假冒的。真正的茉莉已被关押。
context_analysis.en_US: Ledou visits the school; Mo莉 doesn't remember him — but this Mo莉 is a Shapeshifter in disguise. The real Mo莉 has been captured.

relation_label.zh_CN: 变形者与茉莉·身份替换

description.zh_CN: 变形者伪装成茉莉，混入戈尔丁身边获取情报。真正的茉莉被关押。变形者对戈尔丁的学校表示兴趣，想"更好地理解自己……理解萨卡兹"。
description.en_US: The Shapeshifter impersonates Mo莉 to infiltrate Goldin's school and gather intelligence. The real Mo莉 is imprisoned. The Shapeshifter expresses interest in the school, wanting to 'better understand itself... understand Sarkaz.'

quote.zh_CN: 变形者集群: '把这位茉莉小姐带回去吧，中校先生。看好她。我们会留在戈尔丁女士身边，为接下来的战争取得更多情报。'
quote.en_US: Shapeshifter Collective: 'Take Miss Mo莉 back, Colonel Ledou. Watch her. We will stay beside Miss Goldin to gather more intelligence for the coming war.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 变形者（伪茉莉）指示莱托中校把真正的茉莉带走，它自己则留在戈尔丁身边收集情报。
context_analysis.en_US: The Shapeshifter (fake Mo莉) orders Ledou to take the real Mo莉 away while it stays beside Goldin to gather intelligence.

relation_label.zh_CN: 变形者与教育者·潜伏的观察者

description.zh_CN: 变形者（伪茉莉）潜伏在戈尔丁身边，声称"我们对你们很感兴趣。透过你们，我们能更好地理解自己……理解萨卡兹"。它对人类世界的教育与情感感到困惑。
description.en_US: The Shapeshifter (fake Mo莉) infiltrates Goldin, claiming 'We find you very interesting. Through you, we can better understand ourselves... understand Sarkaz.' It is puzzled by human education and emotion.

quote.zh_CN: 变形者集群: '我们对你们很感兴趣。透过你们，我们能更好地理解自己……理解萨卡兹。莱托，你并不像那种对萨卡兹感到好奇的人。'
quote.en_US: Shapeshifter Collective: 'We find you very interesting. Through you, we can better understand ourselves... understand Sarkaz. Ledou, you're not the type to be curious about Sarkaz.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 变形者对戈尔丁和人类世界的教育、情感表达感到好奇，表达了想要"理解萨卡兹"的目的。
context_analysis.en_US: The Shapeshifter is fascinated by Goldin and human expressions of education and feeling, seeking to 'understand Sarkaz' through her.

relation_label.zh_CN: 格拉斯哥帮与阿斯卡纶·同一战场

description.zh_CN: 因陀罗和摩根（格拉斯哥帮成员）与阿斯卡纶（罗德岛干员）在战场上并肩作战对抗萨卡兹。
description.en_US: Indra and Morgan (Glasgow Gang) fight alongside Ascalon (Rhodes Island operator) on the battlefield against the Sankazi forces.

quote.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶: '阿米娅，无人机已经切断了通讯。他们应该没有发现我们。……博士，无人机成功抵达操控区域。'
quote.en_US: Ascalon: 'Amiya, the drones have cut communications. They shouldn't have noticed us... Doctor, the drones successfully reached the control area.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶通过无人机支援战场，与格拉斯哥帮在同一战区作战。
context_analysis.en_US: Ascalon supports the battlefield via drones, fighting in the same zone as the Glasgow Gang.

relation_label.zh_CN: 博士与变形者·地下剧场的观众
relation_label.en_US: Doctor & Shapeshifter — Audience at the Underground Theatre

description.zh_CN: 变形者（伪茉莉）邀请博士加入戈尔丁学校的话剧演出，博士走上舞台扮演"神秘观众"。变形者对博士在舞台上发表的反战宣言感到困惑。
description.en_US: The Shapeshifter (fake Mo莉) invites the Doctor to join the school's play as 'the mysterious audience.' The Doctor takes the stage and delivers an anti-war monologue that confuses the Shapeshifter.

quote.zh_CN: 茉莉: '既然舞台还在，我们能不能重新演一遍呢？从第一幕开始。'？？？: '所有人都总是在幻想，如果一切没有发生会怎样。推演没有意义。'
quote.en_US: Mo莉: 'Since the stage is still here, can we perform it again? From the first act?' ??? 'Everyone always wonders what would happen if everything had been different. No point in speculation.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 变形者（伪茉莉）邀请博士加入演出，博士走上舞台扮演"神秘观众"说出"推演没有意义"。
context_analysis.en_US: The Shapeshifter (fake Mo莉) invites the Doctor onto the stage. The Doctor takes the role of 'the mysterious audience' and says 'no point in speculation.'

relation_label.zh_CN: 工人代表与工友们·集体的觉醒
relation_label.en_US: Worker Representative & Fellow Workers — Collective Awakening

description.zh_CN: 费斯特带领海布里区的工人们集体行动，救出凯瑟琳和其他老工人代表。乔治、帕特、汤米、戴等工人在费斯特的感召下选择反抗而非继续妥协。
description.en_US: Fust leads the workers of Heburi District in collective action, rescuing Cathleen and other veteran worker representatives. Workers like George, Pat, Tommy, and Dai choose resistance over continued compromise under Fust's inspiration.

quote.zh_CN: 伦蒂尼姆工人们: '噢！'……费斯特: '去把我们的老工头们救回来。'伦蒂尼姆工人们: '噢！'
quote.en_US: Lonedin Workers: 'Ooh!' ...Fust: 'Go rescue our old foremen!' Lonedin Workers: 'Ooh!'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 工人们集体跟随费斯特冲向刑场，高呼口号救回老工头们。
context_analysis.en_US: Workers collectively follow Fust to the execution site, cheering to rescue the veteran foremen.

relation_label.zh_CN: 食腐者之王与阿斯卡纶·王庭内战
relation_label.en_US: Warl vs. Ascalon — Royal Court Civil War

description.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶提到"食腐者的大军提前回来了"——食腐者之王（Warl）率萨卡兹大军抵达伦蒂尼姆。阿斯卡纶曾在王庭内战中站在特蕾西娅一方，与Warl为敌。
description.en_US: Ascalon notes 'Warl's reinforcements have returned early' — the King of Scourges (Warl) leads the Sarkaz army to Lonedin. Ascalon sided with Theresa in the Royal Court civil war, making her an enemy of Warl.

quote.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶: '阿米娅，食腐者提前到了。……凯尔希医生的速度已经够快，拖延巫妖的脚步已是极限。食腐者麾下军士的凝聚力远胜任何萨卡兹势力。'
quote.en_US: Ascalon: 'Amiya, the Scourges arrived early... Kal'tsit's speed is already maximized, delaying the Wraith is the limit. The cohesion of Warl's forces surpasses any other Sarkaz faction.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 食腐者之王率军提前抵达，阿斯卡纶警告他的军队凝聚力极强。阿斯卡纶曾与之在王庭内战中为敌。
context_analysis.en_US: Warl's army arrives early; Ascalon warns their cohesion is unmatched. Ascalon fought against Warl in the Royal Court civil war.

relation_label.zh_CN: 特雷西斯与凯尔希·宿敌重逢
relation_label.en_US: Theresa Prime vs. Kal'tsit — Foe Reunion

description.zh_CN: 特雷西斯与凯尔希在指挥塔天台正面对决。特雷西斯宣称"我会再杀死你一次"，凯尔希则说她"只是在加快毁灭的进程"。两人有着两百年的恩怨纠葛。
description.en_US: Theresa Prime and Kal'tsit face off on the command tower rooftop. Theresa declares 'I will kill you again,' while Kal'tsit says she 'is only accelerating destruction.' Theirs is a grudge spanning two hundred years.

quote.zh_CN: 特雷西斯: '两百年前，我看着你重生在特蕾西娅的身边。一度毁灭卡兹戴尔的罪魁祸首，一个驯化古老的不灭之人。……我会再杀死你一次，凯尔希。'
quote.en_US: Theresa: 'Two hundred years ago, I watched you reborn beside Theresa. The culprit who once destroyed Kazdel, an ancient immortal tamed... I will kill you again, Kal'tsit.'

context_analysis.zh_CN: 特雷西斯揭露凯尔希的历史——她曾是毁灭卡兹戴尔的"罪魁祸首"（泰拉文明联军），如今重生为特蕾西娅的同伴。特雷西斯宣布要再次杀死她。
context_analysis.en_US: Theresa reveals Kal'tsit's history — she was once part of the coalition that destroyed Kazdel, now reborn as Theresa's companion. Theresa vows to kill her again.

relation_label.zh_CN: 格拉斯哥帮战友·生死与共

description.zh_CN: 摩根是推进之王的格拉斯哥帮战友，共同经历诺伯特区的沦陷与撤离，在战友贝尔德牺牲后彼此支撑。
description.en_US: Morgan is Siege's Glasgow Gang comrade; together they survived the Norbeton collapse.

quote.zh_CN: 维娜，亚历山德莉娜·维娜·维多利亚殿下，带着诸王之息回来了！
quote.en_US: Vina Alexandria Vina Victoria, with the King's Breath, has returned!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 摩根在混乱中揭示推进之王的真实身份，以国王的名义团结民众
context_analysis.en_US: Morgan reveals Siege's identity to rally the people during chaos

quote.zh_CN: 战争会结束的，对吧。
quote.en_US: The war will end, right?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 战后，摩根与推进之王互相扶持，对未来抱有微弱的希望
context_analysis.en_US: After the battle, Morgan and Siege support each other with fragile hope for the future

relation_label.zh_CN: 格拉斯哥帮战友·街头的家人

description.zh_CN: 贝尔德是推进之王最信任的格拉斯哥帮战友，负责守护拳馆，被麦克拉伦误杀牺牲。
description.en_US: Beld was Siege's most trusted Glasgow Gang comrade, guarding the gym; killed by McLaren in panic.

quote.zh_CN: 维娜，能看到你回到这里，我也......很高兴。
quote.en_US: Vina, I'm glad to see you back here.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 贝尔德与推进之王重逢，表达真挚的战友之情
context_analysis.en_US: Beld expresses genuine joy at reuniting with Siege

quote.zh_CN: 贝尔德死了。
quote.en_US: Beld is dead.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 摩根向因陀罗确认贝尔德的死讯，推进之王无言承受
context_analysis.en_US: Morgan confirms Beld's death to Indra; Siege accepts in silence

relation_label.zh_CN: 格拉斯哥帮战友·街头岁月

description.zh_CN: 因陀罗是推进之王的格拉斯哥帮战友，性格火爆，贝尔德牺牲后悲愤交加。
description.en_US: Indra is Siege's volatile Glasgow Gang comrade; devastated by Beld's death.

quote.zh_CN: 维娜，难道连你也要抛下贝尔德？那可是贝尔德！
quote.en_US: Vina! Are you going to abandon Beld too?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗得知贝尔德死讯后悲愤，要求推进之王采取行动
context_analysis.en_US: Indra rages upon learning Beld's death, demanding action

quote.zh_CN: 为了格拉斯哥帮！！
quote.en_US: For Glasgow Gang!!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 因陀罗最后选择信任推进之王，带领众人冲向封锁墙
context_analysis.en_US: Indra ultimately trusts Siege and charges toward the blockade wall

description.zh_CN: 达格达（伊莎贝尔·孟塔古）是推进之王的格拉斯哥帮战友，曼彻斯特伯爵家的小姐。
description.en_US: Dagda (Isabelle Montague) is Siege's Glasgow Gang comrade from a noble house.

quote.zh_CN: 无论是谁，让他们放马过来。
quote.en_US: Whoever it is, let them come.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达与推进之王并肩，表示愿意共同应对挑战
context_analysis.en_US: Dagda stands with Siege, ready to face whatever comes

quote.zh_CN: 恕我冒昧，公爵阁下，您会如何运用这种力量呢？
quote.en_US: Forgive my intrusion, Duchess, how will you wield this power?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 达格达战后质问温德米尔公爵，展现骑士的质疑精神
context_analysis.en_US: Dagda questions the Duchess after the battle, showing her knightly spirit

relation_label.zh_CN: 格拉斯哥帮战友·复杂的信任

description.zh_CN: 卡铎尔是推进之王的格拉斯哥帮战友，因战争的残酷和无力感而愤怒，最终选择去寻找贝尔德。
description.en_US: Cador is Siege's Glasgow Gang comrade, angry and disillusioned by the war, chooses to find Beld.

quote.zh_CN: 这里没有你的格拉斯哥帮。你什么都不是！
quote.en_US: There is no Glasgow Gang here. You're nothing!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 卡铎尔向推进之王表达愤怒，质疑她的王族身份
context_analysis.en_US: Cador explodes at Siege, questioning her royal identity

quote.zh_CN: 贝尔德是我的人，当然也只能我罩着她。
quote.en_US: Beld is mine, I'll take care of her myself.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 贝尔德死后，卡铎尔选择独自去找她，展现帮派兄弟情谊
context_analysis.en_US: After Beld's death, Cador chooses to go find her, showing gang brotherhood

description.zh_CN: 戴菲恩·温德米尔是温德米尔公爵的女儿，与推进之王在诺伯特区共同经历危机，广播计划失败后依靠母亲救援。
description.en_US: Daphne Windmira is Duchess Windmere's daughter; fought alongside Siege in Norbeton.

quote.zh_CN: 温德米尔公爵的高速军舰会在日出后不久靠近这里。
quote.en_US: The Duchess Windmere's warships will approach shortly after dawn.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戴菲恩解释温德米尔公爵的支援计划
context_analysis.en_US: Daphne explains the Duchess Windmere's support plan

quote.zh_CN: 他们已经全部登舰，接下来他们会暂时受温德米尔公爵的庇护。
quote.en_US: They've all boarded; they'll be under Duchess Windmere's protection for now.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戴菲恩协助推进之王安置诺伯特区难民
context_analysis.en_US: Daphne helps Siege settle the Norbeton refugees

relation_label.zh_CN: 母女·温德米尔公爵与戴菲恩

description.zh_CN: 温德米尔公爵是戴菲恩的母亲，派遣军舰接应诺伯特区难民，接回了女儿戴菲恩。
description.en_US: Duchess Windmere is Daphne's mother; sent warships to rescue Norbeton refugees and her daughter.

quote.zh_CN: 我得在那风暴形成之前，找到戴菲恩！
quote.en_US: I must find Daphne before that storm forms!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 温德米尔公爵发现飞空艇将引来风暴后，第一优先是找到女儿
context_analysis.en_US: Duchess Windmere prioritizes finding her daughter upon discovering the airship threat

quote.zh_CN: 她刚刚在房间里大哭了一场。
quote.en_US: She just had a good cry in her room.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 温德米尔公爵向博士解释女儿经历的一切
context_analysis.en_US: The Duchess explains to the Doctor what Daphne went through

description.zh_CN: 伊内丝救了被困于萨卡兹酒店的戴菲恩·温德米尔，戴菲恩承诺欠伊内丝一次，并联系母亲提供援助。
description.en_US: Ines saved Daphne trapped in the Sari hotel; Daphne promised a favor and contacted her mother for help.

quote.zh_CN: 伊内丝女士，你救了我一命，这确实......很感谢你。
quote.en_US: Ms. Ines, you saved my life. Thank you sincerely.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戴菲恩坦诚承认欠伊内丝一次
context_analysis.en_US: Daphne openly acknowledges owing Ines a favor

quote.zh_CN: 我们会试着在你们需要的方面帮忙，我需要联络我的母亲。
quote.en_US: We'll try to help you. I need to contact my mother.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 戴菲恩承诺联络温德米尔公爵提供援助
context_analysis.en_US: Daphne promises to contact Duchess Windmere for aid

relation_label.zh_CN: 萨卡兹佣兵搭档·老战友重逢
relation_label.en_US: Sarkaz Mercenary Partner · Old Friends Reunited

description.zh_CN: 伊内丝与赫德雷是萨卡兹佣兵时代的老搭档。伊内丝从飞空艇坠落时，赫德雷和W用余烬网接住了她。
description.en_US: Ines and Hoederer are old mercenary partners; they caught Ines with ashes when she fell from the airship.

quote.zh_CN: 赫德雷，算了，直接埋了吧。
quote.en_US: Hoederer, forget it, just bury her.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W与赫德雷早已在下方布置余烬网接应伊内丝
context_analysis.en_US: W and Hoederer had prepared an ash net below to catch Ines

quote.zh_CN: 你伤得不轻。/怕。/你老是把自己弄得灰头土脸，是不是这个副作用啊？
quote.en_US: You're hurt badly. / I was scared. / Is being covered in ash a side effect?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 三人重逢后互相关照，伊内丝与老搭档赫德雷和W叙旧
context_analysis.en_US: The three reunite and catch up; Ines with old partners Hoederer and W

description.zh_CN: 伊内丝与Misery在诺伯特区撤离行动中并肩作战，共同掩护撤退。
description.en_US: Ines and Misery fought together during the Norbeton evacuation, covering the retreat.

quote.zh_CN: Misery，博士，敌人使用了新式的萨卡兹巫术装置。
quote.en_US: Misery, Doctor, the enemy used new Sarkaz wraith devices.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Misery在撤离战斗中向博士汇报战场情况
context_analysis.en_US: Misery reports the battlefield situation to the Doctor during the evacuation

quote.zh_CN: Misery，保护好他们，你们还要继续往前走。
quote.en_US: Misery, protect them. You need to keep moving.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 号角让Misery掩护伤员继续撤离
context_analysis.en_US: Exusia tells Misery to protect and escort the wounded to continue the evacuation

relation_label.zh_CN: 巴别塔旧友·信任与合作
relation_label.en_US: Babel Old Comrades · Trust and Cooperation

description.zh_CN: 伊内丝是巴别塔（Babel）组织成员，与Logos、凯尔希等人共同见证了萨卡兹王庭的兴衰。Logos吹响骨哨促使变形者新生。
description.en_US: Ines was a Babel member alongside Logos and Kal'tsit; Logos blew the bone whistle causing the Shifter to be reborn.

quote.zh_CN: 赫德雷有个敏锐的好搭档，我该为他高兴吗？
quote.en_US: Hoederer has a sharp partner. Should I be happy for him?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 曼弗雷德称赞伊内丝的洞察力，伊内丝曾报告深池/伦蒂尼姆动向
context_analysis.en_US: Manfred praises Ines's insight; she had reported Deep Pool/Lundonium movements

quote.zh_CN: 骨哨声...... Logos视骨哨为旧王庭可悲的传统......但这确实是丧钟之主的骨哨。
quote.en_US: Bone whistle... Logos always refused to blow it... but this is indeed the bone whistle of the Lord of丧钟.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Logos吹响骨哨，导致变形者的集群在同一刻凋零并新生为两个初生的变形者
context_analysis.en_US: Logos blew the bone whistle, causing the Shifter cluster to wither and be reborn as two new entities

description.zh_CN: Logos作为王庭女妖一直在追猎变形者，最终通过吹响骨哨（丧钟之主的声音）促使变形者的亘古统一的集群凋亡并新生为两个独立的个体。
description.en_US: Logos the Court Witch had long hunted the Shifter; blew the bone whistle causing the ancient unified cluster to die and be reborn as two.

quote.zh_CN: 我会奏响你的挽歌，全部的你。
quote.en_US: I will play your requiem, all of you.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Logos在幻境中与变形者对话，表明追杀决心
context_analysis.en_US: Logos declares her intent to destroy every fragment of the Shifter in the illusory realm

quote.zh_CN: 变形者死去了，最为恒久的王庭就此崩塌。......还是两个新生？
quote.en_US: The Shifter is dead. The most enduring Court has collapsed... Or is it two new births?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 特雷西斯确认变形者的集群在骨哨声中凋亡并产生两个新生体
context_analysis.en_US: Therasis confirms the Shifter's cluster died at the bone whistle, producing two new entities

relation_label.zh_CN: 对话·异族魔王与变形者
relation_label.en_US: Dialogue · Non-Sarkaz Demon King & The Shifter

description.zh_CN: 变形者作为最古老的萨卡兹王庭之主，与非萨卡兹的魔王阿米娅对话，对她产生了兴趣并发出邀请，希望见证她独特的存在。
description.en_US: The ancient Shifter, oldest of the Court Lords, dialogued with non-Sarkaz Demon King Amiya and invited her to prove herself unique.

quote.zh_CN: 尊敬的魔王，请给我们漫长的生命一次惊喜。
quote.en_US: Respected Demon King, please give our long lives a surprise.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 变形者向阿米娅发出邀请，表达对她独特性的好奇
context_analysis.en_US: The Shifter invites Amiya, expressing curiosity about her uniqueness

quote.zh_CN: 你总会在未来的某一刻明白，你是无法战胜时间的。
quote.en_US: You will one day realize that you cannot defeat time.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 变形者以古老智慧提醒魔王，最终暗示她可能会走出一条不同的路
context_analysis.en_US: The Shifter reminds the Demon King with ancient wisdom, hinting she may forge a different path

relation_label.zh_CN: 心灵对峙·非萨卡兹魔王面对萨卡兹众魂
relation_label.en_US: Spiritual Confrontation · Non-Sarkaz Demon King Faces Sarkaz Souls

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅在飞空艇船坞中面对死魂灵（萨卡兹古代飞空艇/亡魂容器），看到了萨卡兹三千年的苦难史。虽然理解了仇恨的根源，但她拒绝以仇恨回应仇恨的道路。
description.en_US: Amiya faced the Soul-Summoner (ancient airship/host of the dead) and saw 3420 years of Sarkaz suffering; understood the roots of hatred but rejected the path of revenge.

quote.zh_CN: 我看见了泪水......您一直与这些悲伤在一起吗？您用愤怒的火焰灼烧伤口。这......很痛苦。
quote.en_US: I see tears... Have you been carrying this sadness all along? You burn wounds with angry fire. This... hurts.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅面对死魂灵的巨大阴影，与萨卡兹众魂的痛苦产生共情
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya empathizes with the Soul-Summoner's massive shadow and the pain of the Sarkaz souls

quote.zh_CN: 可是......我仍拒绝这条路。
quote.en_US: But... I still reject this path.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅看到了萨卡兹的痛苦，但她拒绝以仇恨作为出路，选择继续寻找自己的道路
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya saw Sarkaz suffering but rejected hatred as an answer, choosing to find her own path

description.zh_CN: W在诺伯特区战场出现，用炸药救出被困的可露希尔等人，展现了萨卡兹佣兵的实用主义风格。
description.en_US: W appeared at the Norbeton battlefield and rescued trapped Closure et al. with explosives, showing her mercenary pragmatism.

quote.zh_CN: 我在伦蒂尼姆城外倒是有几个好去处，要来瞧瞧吗？
quote.en_US: I have some nice spots outside Lundonium. Want to take a look?

context_analysis.zh_CN: W用炸药炸开出路，邀请众人去她的安全屋
context_analysis.en_US: W blasts an escape route and invites everyone to her safehouse

quote.zh_CN: 我听说凯尔希被揍得很惨，于是就百忙之中抽空来看看咯。
quote.en_US: I heard Kal'tsit got beaten up pretty bad, so I figured I'd drop by despite being busy.

context_analysis.zh_CN: W以典型的玩世不恭方式关心凯尔希的伤势
context_analysis.en_US: W shows characteristic nonchalance about Kal'tsit's injuries

description.zh_CN: 博士与普瑞赛斯曾共同创造了源石，后博士失去部分记忆，两人分道扬镳。在Abyss中重逢，博士拒绝与普瑞赛斯同行。
description.en_US: The Doctor and Prtser co-created Originium, then the Doctor lost part of his memory. They parted ways. They reunited in Abyss, and the Doctor refused to follow Prtser.

quote.zh_CN: 这是我们共同的创造，只属于你我二人的结晶，是希望的种子。
quote.en_US: This is our shared creation, a crystal that belongs only to the two of us, a seed of hope.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯对博士说源石是他们共同创造的，博士不记得但本能感到亲切
context_analysis.en_US: Prtser tells the Doctor that Originium is their shared creation; the Doctor doesn't remember but feels instinctively close

quote.zh_CN: 你没有留在唤醒室等待我，与我一同分享第一次看见这个新世界的喜悦。
quote.en_US: You didn't stay in the awakening room to wait for me, to share the joy of seeing this new world together.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯表达了对博士先于她醒来的遗憾，暗示他们曾共同计划
context_analysis.en_US: Prtser expresses regret that the Doctor woke before her, hinting they had planned together

quote.zh_CN: 我无意与你辩论你信奉的价值......我很遗憾，要将你当作这个误差来抹除。
quote.en_US: I have no intention of debating the values you believe in... I regret having to eliminate you as this error.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯视博士为实验中的'误差'，意图消灭
context_analysis.en_US: Prtser regards the Doctor as an 'error' in the experiment and intends to eliminate him

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希在Abyss中向博士坦白真相后，为保护博士和阿米娅牺牲自己。博士与凯尔希有着超越记忆的信任。
description.en_US: Kaltsit revealed the truth to the Doctor in Abyss, then sacrificed herself to protect the Doctor and Amiya. Their trust transcends memory.

quote.zh_CN: 你为什么这样看着我，Dr.{@nickname}？——接受检查的并不是我——你也很信任我？——现在依旧如此，你已经证明过自己。
quote.en_US: Why are you looking at me like this? The one being examined isn't me... You also trust me? — Still, as always. You have proven yourself.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希回应博士的目光，表达对博士信任的确认
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit responds to the Doctor's gaze, confirming her trust in him

quote.zh_CN: Dr.{@nickname}，你应当已经知道，为泰拉同时带来生机与威胁的源石......是在预言家和普瑞赛斯的手中，终于得以完成。'预言家'，是你曾经的代号。
quote.en_US: You should know that Originium... was finally completed by the hands of the Prophet and Prtser. 'Prophet' — that was your codename.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希向博士坦白博士是'预言家'，曾与普瑞赛斯共同创造源石
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit reveals to the Doctor that he was the 'Prophet' who co-created Originium with Prtser

quote.zh_CN: Mon3tr攻击你的时候，你选择了防御。——我是在报复你，也是在反抗你。
quote.en_US: When Mon3tr attacked you, you chose to defend. — This is my revenge, and also my final rebellion.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希揭示她设计困住普瑞赛斯的计划，为最终反抗
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit reveals her plan to trap Prtser, for final rebellion

quote.zh_CN: 去找回分散在泰拉各地的办事处的干员吧，你们需要整合他们的力量，去团结更多的力量。这同样是属于这片大地的战争。
quote.en_US: Go retrieve the operators stationed across Terra. You need to consolidate their strength and unite even more forces. This too is a war belonging to this land.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希的遗言嘱托博士继续领导罗德岛战斗
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit's final words entrust the Doctor to continue leading Rhodes Island in battle

relation_label.zh_CN: 思维相连的挚友与战友

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅通过黑王冠与博士进行思维共享，深入'文明的存续'边界共同寻找真相。面对普瑞赛斯，阿米娅用法术保护博士。
description.en_US: Amiya shared her mind with the Doctor through the Black Crown, going deep into the Civilization's Continuation together. Against Prtser, Amiya used arts to protect the Doctor.

quote.zh_CN: 博士，拉紧我的手。接下来的路，我会保护你走下去的。关于魔王的一切，特蕾西娅小姐在那一天已经全部教给了我。
quote.en_US: Doctor, hold my hand tight. For the next step, I will protect you. Theresa taught me everything about the Demon King that day.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅通过思维共享引导博士，承诺保护他
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya guides the Doctor through mind-sharing, promising to protect him

quote.zh_CN: 那个人明明自己也脆弱得不行，却一定要固执地背着我跨过满是源石碎屑的小径......那是属于我的故事，是你送给我的故事。
quote.en_US: That person who was so fragile yet insisted on carrying me through paths full of Originium fragments... That is my story, the story you gave me.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅在思维中回忆博士曾给她讲的故事
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya recalls in the shared mind the stories the Doctor once told her

quote.zh_CN: 博士，退后！我必须保护Mon3tr！——我该怎么做？——连接我的思维！
quote.en_US: Doctor, step back! I must protect Mon3tr! — What should I do? — Connect to my mind!

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅再次与博士进行思维共享，用公式逆转源石信息传递
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya connects her mind with the Doctor again, using the formula to reverse Originium information transfer

relation_label.zh_CN: 造主与觉醒的造物——生死对抗
relation_label.en_US: Creator vs Awakening Creation — Deadly Confrontation

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希是被普瑞赛斯创造的AMa-10双生循环系统之一，另一半是Mon3tr。凯尔希打破普瑞赛斯的禁令，最终设计将普瑞赛斯困于身体中与其同归于尽。
description.en_US: Kaltsit is one of the two AMa-10 dual circulatory systems created by Prtser; the other half is Mon3tr. Kaltsit broke Prtser's restrictions and designed a trap to kill Prtser with her own body.

quote.zh_CN: 是你啊......AMa-10。同样好久不见了。虽然你现在的模样和诞生之初相去甚远，可我怎会不认识自己倾注了情感的造物呢？
quote.en_US: It's you... AMa-10. It's been a long time too. Though your appearance now is far from your origin, how could I not recognize my creation that I poured emotion into?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯认出凯尔希是她的造物AMa-10
context_analysis.en_US: Prtser recognizes Kaltsit as her creation, AMa-10

quote.zh_CN: 我是凯尔希，罗德岛的医生，阿米娅与博士的同伴。你对我而言，早已一文不值。
quote.en_US: I am Kaltsit, a doctor of Rhodes Island, a companion of Amiya and the Doctor. To me, you have long been worthless.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希宣告与普瑞赛斯的决裂并下达攻击命令
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit declares her break from Prtser and orders the attack

quote.zh_CN: Mon3tr，熔毁。——基于特蕾西娅对源石的研究......我对你所处的唤醒室加入了一些设计。只要你在这里醒来，你的意识，同样会困于这具身体。
quote.en_US: Mon3tr, melt down. — Based on Theresa's Originium research... I added a design to the awakening room. Once you wake there, your consciousness will also be trapped in that body.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希揭示她用特蕾西娅研究成果设计的陷阱
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit reveals the trap designed using Theresa's research

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅与凯尔希并肩面对普瑞赛斯。凯尔希多次表达对阿米娅成长和决心的信任。
description.en_US: Amiya and Kaltsit fought side by side against Prtser. Kaltsit repeatedly expressed trust in Amiya's growth and determination.

quote.zh_CN: 我相信她可以从那些庞杂的信息中找到关键点，有特蕾西娅的祝福......她可以做到。毕竟，她可是阿米娅。我亲眼看着成长起来的领袖。
quote.en_US: I believe she can find the key points in all that complex information, with Theresa's blessing... She can do it. After all, this is Amiya. The leader I watched grow up.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希向博士表达对阿米娅的信任
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit expresses her trust in Amiya to the Doctor

quote.zh_CN: 我很高兴......这是一个正确的选择。请记得罗德岛的使命......去找回分散在泰拉各地的办事处的干员吧。
quote.en_US: I am glad... this was the right choice. Remember the mission of Rhodes Island... Go retrieve the operators stationed across Terra.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希遗言嘱托阿米娅继续罗德岛使命
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit's final words entrust Amiya to continue Rhodes Island's mission

relation_label.zh_CN: 对抗源石造物主的魔王继承者
relation_label.en_US: Demon King Heir Confronting the Originium Creator

description.zh_CN: 阿米娅作为魔王继承者与普瑞赛斯正面对抗。在普瑞赛斯压制博士时，阿米娅用法术和公式逆转源石信息传递，削弱普瑞赛斯对源石的控制。
description.en_US: As the Demon King heir, Amiya confronts Prtser directly. When Prtser suppressed the Doctor, Amiya used arts and formulas to reverse Originium information transfer, weakening Prtser's control.

quote.zh_CN: 我的法术目前好像不光能挡住它们，也感知到了她的状态......她没有我想象中那样不可战胜。
quote.en_US: My arts seem to not only block them, I can also sense her state... She's not as invincible as I imagined.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅感知到普瑞赛斯的虚弱并尝试对抗
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya senses Prtser's weakness and tries to resist

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅，博士，快看天上的云层——天灾云以一种规则却诡异的姿态收缩折叠，直至完全消失。
quote.en_US: Amiya, Doctor, look at the clouds in the sky — The disaster clouds folded and collapsed in an orderly but eerie manner until completely gone.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯展示了能完全控制源石/天灾的能力，阿米娅震惊
context_analysis.en_US: Prtser demonstrates ability to completely control Originium/disasters; Amiya is shocked

description.zh_CN: 煌与迷迭香在Abyss中并肩作战，清扫源石结晶体敌人。迷迭香因善良不愿伤害失控的小车，煌帮助她。
description.en_US: Blaze and Rosmontis fought side by side in Abyss, clearing Originium crystal enemies. Rosmontis was reluctant to harm the malfunctioning robots, and Blaze helped her.

quote.zh_CN: 煌，迷迭香已经回应了他们，增援不会拖延太久。
quote.en_US: Blaze and Rosmontis have responded, the reinforcement won't be delayed.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌和迷迭香增援阿斯卡纶和Misery
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze and Rosmontis reinforce Ascalon and Misery

quote.zh_CN: 迷迭香，迷迭香已经回应了他们。煌说小猫，这次让我先动手如何？
quote.en_US: Rosmontis, they've already responded. Blaze says, Rosmontis, this time let me go first?

context_analysis.zh_CN: 煌和迷迭香在Abyss中配合作战
context_analysis.en_US: Blaze and Rosmontis fight together in Abyss

quote.zh_CN: 小猫，这应该怎么处理？——我不想伤害他们。Friston-3，两位，把这几辆昏了头的车引到特定的轨道上来。
quote.en_US: Little cat, how should we handle this? — I don't want to hurt them. Friston-3, both of you, lead these confused cars onto specific tracks.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 迷迭香不愿伤害被PRTS控制的小车，Friston-3帮助恢复正常
context_analysis.en_US: Rosmontis is reluctant to harm the PRTS-controlled robots; Friston-3 helps restore them

relation_label.zh_CN: 医疗部同事与默契战友

description.zh_CN: 华法琳在罗德岛覆灭后继续照顾病人、协助撤离、传承凯尔希的遗志。凯尔希牺牲后，华法琳主动维护凯尔希的办公室。
description.en_US: After Rhodes Island's fall, Warfarin continued caring for patients, assisting evacuation, and carrying on Kaltsit's legacy. After Kaltsit's death, Warfarin took initiative to maintain Kaltsit's office.

quote.zh_CN: 华法琳对此应该会很开心。——医疗中心至关重要......我们对矿石病的所有认知——独一无二的病例，或许是矿石病的新变化。
quote.en_US: Warfarin should be very happy about this. The medical center is crucial... all our knowledge of Originium disease — a unique case, perhaps a new variation.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希安排华法琳负责将医疗中心转移到阿戈尔
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit arranges for Warfarin to handle transfer of medical center to Aegir

quote.zh_CN: 她的办公室......就按原貌重建就行，医疗部会负责维护凯尔希的办公室。
quote.en_US: Her office... just rebuild it as it was, the medical department will take care of maintaining Kaltsit's office.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 华法琳主动承担维护凯尔希办公室的责任
context_analysis.en_US: Warfarin proactively takes responsibility for maintaining Kaltsit's office

description.zh_CN: 华法琳与Touch在罗德岛覆灭事件中共同照顾重伤员，Touch负责战场急救。华法琳最终完成了与克洛伊共同撰写的源石病研究论文。
description.en_US: Warfarin and Touch worked together during Rhodes Island's fall to care for seriously wounded operators. Touch handled battlefield first aid. Warfarin eventually completed the Originium disease research paper co-authored with Chloe.

quote.zh_CN: Touch，我需要你的协助！——尽量把所有的伤员都集中过来，剩下的交给我。——好，这样的话，医疗中心的接收准备也差不多安排妥当了。
quote.en_US: Touch, I need your assistance! — Try to gather all the wounded here, leave the rest to me. — In that case, the medical center's receiving preparations are almost settled.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 华法琳与Touch协同处理伤员和医疗中心转移
context_analysis.en_US: Warfarin coordinates with Touch on treating wounded and medical center transfer

relation_label.zh_CN: 咒术与工程的协同战友

description.zh_CN: Logos与Mechanist在Abyss中协同作战。Logos用咒言延缓引擎，Mechanist负责破解PRTS核心。
description.en_US: Logos and Mechanist fought together in Abyss. Logos used sorcery to delay the engines; Mechanist was responsible for cracking the PRTS core.

quote.zh_CN: Logos：'别离'。机械躯壳亦有足以令言语通过的缝隙。我会延缓引擎中参与反应的燃料供给速度。——Logos：'挽留'。我之言辞，将拥抱罗德岛。
quote.en_US: Logos: 'Separation'. There are gaps in mechanical shells enough for words to pass through. I will slow the fuel supply in the engines. — Logos: 'Retention'. My words will embrace Rhodes Island.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Logos用咒言延缓引擎运转，为本舰减速争取时间
context_analysis.en_US: Logos uses sorcery to slow the engines, buying time for the ship to decelerate

quote.zh_CN: Mechanist：和可露希尔交流后，我们都断定这是一个非常特殊的石棺。它不仅是休眠设备，同时也是PRTS真正的数据库和供能设备。
quote.en_US: Mechanist: After discussing with Closure, we both determined this is a very special sarcophagus. It's not only a sleep device, but also the PRTS core database and power supply.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Mechanist负责解析PRTS核心并下载数据
context_analysis.en_US: Mechanist is responsible for analyzing and downloading PRTS core data

quote.zh_CN: Logos的咒言帮同事的搬运省了大部分力，Raidian干员排查全舰电路也替我们省下了很多时间。
quote.en_US: Logos's sorcery saved most of the effort in carrying; Raidian's inspection of the ship's circuits also saved us a lot of time.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Logos协助重建工作，众人各显其能
context_analysis.en_US: Logos assists in reconstruction work; everyone contributes their skills

relation_label.zh_CN: 萨卡兹战友与生死搭档

description.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶与Misery是最近Abyss位置的突破者，两人配合突破源石敌人的包围。Misery表示这次不想再慢一步。
description.en_US: Ascalon and Misery were the closest to Abyss and broke through Originium enemy encirclements together. Misery says this time he doesn't want to be one step behind again.

quote.zh_CN: Misery：该死，这些鬼东西怎么源源不断——阿斯卡纶：你出刀慢了。现在你有机会撤退。——得到的情报远远不够。目前这里已经是最接近Abyss的地方。
quote.en_US: Misery: Damn, where do all these things keep coming from — Ascalon: Your blade was slow. You have a chance to retreat now. — The intelligence is far from enough. This is currently the closest to Abyss.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶和Misery在Abyss边缘并肩战斗
context_analysis.en_US: Ascalon and Misery fight side by side at Abyss's edge

quote.zh_CN: Misery：阿斯卡纶......我好像看到了Outcast？——阿斯卡纶：不能一直被动留在原地，要先找到这些东西的来源。
quote.en_US: Misery: Ascalon... I seem to have seen Outcast? — Ascalon: We can't stay passive, we need to find the source of these things first.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿斯卡纶认为应找到异常根源而非被动防守
context_analysis.en_US: Ascalon believes they should find the root cause rather than stay passive

relation_label.zh_CN: 预言家与源石——过去的创造者与现在的对立
relation_label.en_US: The Prophet & Originium — Past Creator vs Present Opponent

description.zh_CN: 博士（预言家）曾与普瑞赛斯共同创造源石，后因普瑞赛斯将'另一种未来的认同'强加于博士，博士做出了违背本心的选择。
description.en_US: The Doctor (Prophet) co-created Originium with Prtser. Later, when Prtser forced 'recognition of another future' onto the Doctor, the Doctor made a choice against his true nature.

quote.zh_CN: 源石指向了这片大地的两种未来......预言家希望将源石当做留给后来文明的礼物、指引他们前进的信标。
quote.en_US: Originium points to two possible futures for this land... The Prophet hoped to leave Originium as a gift for future civilizations, a beacon guiding them forward.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希解释预言家的初衷是将源石作为礼物而非毁灭工具
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit explains the Prophet's original intent: Originium as a gift, not a weapon of destruction

quote.zh_CN: 曾经的你，也的确为此痛苦过。有人将对另一种未来的认同强加于你。也因此......你做出了那个违背本心的选择。
quote.en_US: You did indeed suffer from it... Someone imposed recognition of another future onto you. And because of that... you made that choice against your true nature.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希揭示博士曾被强加另一种未来认同并违背本心
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit reveals the Doctor was forced to accept another future and acted against his nature

relation_label.zh_CN: 巫术与战术协同的精英战友

description.zh_CN: Logos与Pith在Abyss中协同指挥精英干员群战。Pith负责战术协调，Logos用咒言提供防护和支援。
description.en_US: Logos and Pith coordinated elite operators in Abyss. Pith handled tactical coordination; Logos provided protection and support with sorcery.

quote.zh_CN: Pith：就这样解决了？通讯依旧被屏蔽。——Pith：我们就继续执行我们的任务——确定异变的根源。
quote.en_US: Pith: Is it settled like this? Communications are still blocked. — Pith: Then we continue with our mission — determine the source of the anomaly.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Pith指挥精英干员继续执行任务确定异常根源
context_analysis.en_US: Pith commands elite operators to continue the mission to identify the anomaly's source

quote.zh_CN: Pith：清扫地面的工作已经完成。——Touch：伤员我来处理，不过月见夜又变得过于亢奋了。
quote.en_US: Pith: Ground clearing is complete. — Touch: I'll handle the wounded, but Moonlight got too excited again.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Pith和Touch协调处理战场和伤员
context_analysis.en_US: Pith and Touch coordinate on battlefield and casualty handling

description.zh_CN: 阿兰娜是温米的监护人，罗德岛覆灭时负责阻止'小嘟嘟'伤害其他人并保护温米安全。
description.en_US: Alanna is Wumi's guardian; during Rhodes Island's fall she stopped 'Little DuDu' from hurting others and protected Wumi's safety.

quote.zh_CN: 阿兰娜：抱歉了，小家伙。可不能再让你伤到其他人了。——阿兰娜：而且，本舰的构造好像在持续发生变化......就像是......就像是这艘船——活过来了。
quote.en_US: Alanna: Sorry, little one. I really can't let you hurt anyone else. — Alanna: And the ship's structure seems to be constantly changing... like... like this ship — has come alive.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿兰娜阻止'小嘟嘟'伤人并注意到本舰异常
context_analysis.en_US: Alanna stops 'Little DuDu' from hurting people and notices the ship's anomaly

description.zh_CN: 克洛伊是华法琳照顾的特殊矿石病人，其病情产生了前所未见的病征。在罗德岛覆灭事件中，克洛伊主动尝试与源石结晶体沟通，为华法琳提供研究突破的关键数据。
description.en_US: Chloe was a special Originium disease patient under Warfarin's care, showing unprecedented symptoms. During Rhodes Island's fall, Chloe proactively tried communicating with Originium crystals, providing key data for Warfarin's research breakthrough.

quote.zh_CN: 按理来说，这个体细胞与源石融合率，病人根本不可能还有生命迹象。——可是那些源石的确以一种无法预料到的方式维持着病人的生命。感染程度越深，她似乎......越健康，也越痛苦。
quote.en_US: Normally, with this cell-Originium fusion rate, the patient couldn't possibly have vital signs. — But those Originium do maintain the patient's life in an unpredictable way. The deeper the infection, the healthier she seems... and the more pain she feels.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 华法琳和Touch发现克洛伊病情异常，研究源石新变化
context_analysis.en_US: Warfarin and Touch discover Chloe's unusual condition and research new Originium changes

quote.zh_CN: 克洛伊：可、可我能听到他在......哀嚎？那些痛苦的声音，就像刻在我的脑子里一样......同类？——我们的一切努力都不会白费。他们会收到你的礼物，我保证。
quote.en_US: Chloe: I-I can hear it... lamenting? Those painful sounds, like engraved in my mind... kindred? — All our efforts will not be in vain. They will receive your gift, I promise.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 克洛伊感知源石结晶体的痛苦，主动提供帮助
context_analysis.en_US: Chloe perceives the Originium crystals' pain and proactively offers help

quote.zh_CN: 很快我和克洛伊合著的论文也要完成了，届时各个国家的专业医学刊物都会收到我的投稿。源石的变化和矿石病新病征的研究成果是依赖她的牺牲才取得了突破。
quote.en_US: The paper Chloe and I co-authored will soon be complete, and every major medical journal will receive my submission. The breakthrough in Originium changes and new disease symptoms came from her sacrifice.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 华法琳完成与克洛伊共同撰写的论文，克洛伊牺牲换来了突破
context_analysis.en_US: Warfarin completes the paper co-authored with Chloe; Chloe's sacrifice led to the breakthrough

description.zh_CN: Mon3tr从凯尔希的茧中重生后继承了凯尔希的记忆，承诺帮助博士恢复PRTS指挥系统。她选择保留'Mon3tr'这个名字。
description.en_US: After being reborn from Kaltsit's cocoon, Mon3tr inherited Kaltsit's memories, promised to help the Doctor restore the PRTS command system. She chose to keep the name 'Mon3tr'.

quote.zh_CN: Mon3tr：博士，Mon3tr感觉......怪怪的？就像是——在重新适应新的身体。——Mon3tr：凯尔希留下了些重要信息......为了确保我们后续行动的展开，恢复指挥系统迫在眉睫。
quote.en_US: Mon3tr: Doctor, Mon3tr feels... strange? Like — adapting to a new body. — Mon3tr: Kaltsit left some important information... To ensure our follow-up actions, restoring the command system is urgent.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 新生Mon3tr表示可以帮助转译PRTS源代码
context_analysis.en_US: Reborn Mon3tr offers to help translate PRTS source code

quote.zh_CN: Mon3tr：'Mon3tr'，我会保留这个名字。这是你送给我的名字。——Mon3tr：我会尽快去找可露希尔想想办法。
quote.en_US: Mon3tr: I will keep the name 'Mon3tr'. This is the name you gave me. — Mon3tr: I'll go find Closure right away to figure something out.

context_analysis.zh_CN: Mon3tr保留凯尔希赠予的名字，主动参与重建
context_analysis.en_US: Mon3tr keeps the name Kaltsit gave her and proactively participates in reconstruction

relation_label.zh_CN: 最后的嘱托与誓言的延续

description.zh_CN: 凯尔希牺牲后，阿米娅抱紧Mon3tr化成的茧，成功保护了凯尔希最后的遗产。她承诺继续履行凯尔希的职责，保护博士。
description.en_US: After Kaltsit's death, Amiya held tight to Mon3tr's cocoon, successfully protecting Kaltsit's final legacy. She promised to continue fulfilling Kaltsit's duties and protecting the Doctor.

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：等等......还有它！阿米娅用最后的力量施展法术，用丝线缠起Mon3tr化成的'茧'，拉到了自己的怀中。
quote.en_US: Amiya: Wait... there's still it! Amiya used her last strength to cast arts, wrapped the 'cocoon' Mon3tr had become with threads, and pulled it to her chest.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅拼命保护Mon3tr的茧不被源石吞噬
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya desperately protects Mon3tr's cocoon from being consumed by Originium

quote.zh_CN: 阿米娅：我答应过凯尔希医生，会履行好自己的职责，会保护好博士。我会做到的。——这一次，在罗德岛的使命完成之前，我是不会哭的。
quote.en_US: Amiya: I promised Dr. Kaltsit, I will fulfill my duties and protect the Doctor. I will do it. — This time, until Rhodes Island's mission is complete, I won't cry.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 阿米娅承诺履行凯尔希的职责
context_analysis.en_US: Amiya promises to fulfill Kaltsit's duties

relation_label.zh_CN: 拒绝源石同化的终极抉择
relation_label.en_US: Final Choice to Reject Originium Assimilation

description.zh_CN: 博士拒绝普瑞赛斯'回到我身边'的呼唤，坚持'我不会让源石毁灭泰拉'的立场，与普瑞赛斯彻底对立。
description.en_US: The Doctor refused Prtser's call to 'return to my side', insisting 'I will not let Originium destroy Terra' and completely opposing Prtser.

quote.zh_CN: 博士：我不会让源石毁灭泰拉。——普瑞赛斯：......？你很确信，你无法从记忆中打捞起任何与她相关的片段......那是近乎本能的反应。你不由自主地向前走了一步。
quote.en_US: Doctor: I will not let Originium destroy Terra. — Prtser: ...? You are certain, you cannot retrieve any fragment related to her from memory... It's near-instinctual. You involuntarily stepped forward.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 博士在普瑞赛斯召唤下不由自主迈步，但拒绝她的立场
context_analysis.en_US: The Doctor involuntarily steps toward Prtser's call but refuses her stance

quote.zh_CN: 你不由自主地向前走了一步。——凯尔希：Dr.{@nickname}！凯尔希在你身后，紧紧地抓住了你的手臂。
quote.en_US: You involuntarily stepped forward. — Kaltsit: Dr.{@nickname}! Kaltsit behind you tightly grabbed your arm.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 凯尔希阻止博士被普瑞赛斯拉近
context_analysis.en_US: Kaltsit prevents the Doctor from being pulled closer to Prtser

description.zh_CN: 希尔达是来自泰拉的卡特斯女孩，在源石崩解后被普瑞赛斯以信息形式记录并保存在'文明的存续'中。她是第二个与普瑞赛斯交流的生命，正在寻找泰拉的答案。
description.en_US: Hilda is a Kel'ta girl from Terra who was recorded and preserved in the Civilization's Continuation by Prtser after Originium dissolution. She is the second being to communicate with Prtser, searching for answers about Terra.

quote.zh_CN: 希尔达：'宇宙'？'深潜'？您所描述的，还有我所看到的......都太过超越想象。——屈光者：这是一艘在坟墓中打捞死亡的航船。
quote.en_US: Hilda: 'Universe'? 'Deep Dive'? What you describe and what I see... are all too beyond imagination. — The Refractor: This is a ship that捞死亡in graveyards.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 希尔达进入屈光者的舰船，了解宇宙
context_analysis.en_US: Hilda enters the Refractor's ship and learns about the universe

quote.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯：希尔达，你和你的同类很特殊。你们被源石塑造成了如今的模样，与源石产生了如此奇妙的交互。你们的历史，你们的文明，都是因源石而存在。
quote.en_US: Prtser: Hilda, you and your kind are special. You were shaped by Originium into your current form, creating such wondrous interaction with it. Your history, your civilization, all exist because of Originium.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 普瑞赛斯向希尔达解释泰拉人因源石而特殊
context_analysis.en_US: Prtser explains to Hilda that Terra people are special because of Originium

quote.zh_CN: 希尔达：我想念泰拉了。
quote.en_US: Hilda: I miss Terra.

context_analysis.zh_CN: 希尔达在宇宙舰船上思念故乡泰拉
context_analysis.en_US: Hilda, aboard the cosmic ship, yearns for her homeland Terra
